chapters.title: Detailing their interpretation of the incarnation of the Word of God in Christ and that it is a union free from mixing and the like, and the answer to that
paragraphs: [Chapter: Their interpretation of the incarnation of the Word of God in Christ and that it is a union free from mixing and the like, and the answer to that]

They said: As for the incarnation of the creative word of God, by which He created all things, and its incarnation in a created human being, which was taken from the Virgin Mary. The Chosen One, who was favored over the women of the worlds, and the Word was united with Him in a pure union without confusion, change, or impossibility. And He addressed the people. Just as God spoke to the prophet Moses from the thorn tree, he performed the miracle with his divinity, and demonstrated the inability to do so with his humanity, and the two actions are of Christ. The One and the Answer: There are many types of lies, disbelief, and contradiction in this speech, and this appears in two ways: The first:

Their saying: The creative word of God, by which He created everything, is contradictory, for the Creator is the Creator God, and He created things. With His words, which is His saying: Be, for the Creator did not create things by Him, but rather He created them, and the words by which things were created are not He is the Creator of them. Rather, the Creator created things, and the difference between the Creator and the created thing and what the Creator created with is reasonable.
These people made the Creator the One by whom the creatures were created, so they made the Word the Creator, and they made the creatures created by it.

The clarification of this is that if the word is merely an attribute, then the attribute is not a creator, and if the attribute is with what is described, then this is the Creator. This is not the one with which it was created. The second: Their saying: Her incarnation with a created human being, and their saying: The incarnation of the Word of God, for their saying Being incarnated and incarnated implies that the Word became flesh and a body through the created man, and that requires its transformation into flesh and body. This requires its impossibility and change, and they said: a land union of change and impossibility.

Third: Their saying: The word was united with it in a wild union through confusion, change, or impossibility, is also contradictory, for the union He makes the two one, so it is said that before the union: Divinity was one essence and humanity was another essence.
If you wish, you can say:

This was something and this was something, or this was a spring standing by itself, and this was a spring standing by itself, so after the union they could either be Two as they were, or the two became one. If they were two as they were, then they are not united. Rather, they are multiple as they were multiple. They have become one thing, so if this one is one of them, then the other has ceased to exist, and this is the non-existence of one of them, not its unity. This one that became one is not one of them, so they must change and become impossible. Otherwise, if after the union there were two remaining By their qualities, there was no union.

If it is said: It united in a wild union through mixing, change, or impossibility, then this is contradictory statements, some of which contradict each other, for this It only happens with expansion and contrast, not with union. This makes it clear that if water and milk are united, or water and wine, and the like This was the result of their union, a third thing, which is neither pure water nor pure milk, but rather a third type, and both water and milk have It became impossible, changed, and mixed, and a union without that is unreasonable.

For this reason, the great disturbance of the Christians in this place, and their differences increased, and each of them began to respond to what the other said and said. It is a statement that would be rejected, so all their statements were invalid and rejected, since they had participated in a corrupt principle that required one of the matters. They are all invalid, so anything that was taken from those supplies was invalid, and he must have them, so this person takes some of the supplies and the other returns them, The other takes another refrain, and the other returns it.

This is the case with all false articles, if a sect participates in it and requires false requirements, and the corruption of what is required indicates the corruption of what is required. If the necessary is fulfilled, the necessary is fulfilled, and if the necessary is absent, the necessary is absent.
This becomes clear in the fourth aspect: which is to say: Many Christians say: After the union, they are of one essence and nature. One, and one will, and this saying is added to the Yaqubiyyah.

They say: Divinity and humanity are mixed and blended, just as water and milk are mixed, and water and wine, and this saying is the truth. Union, union can only be understood in this way, but its corruption is apparent to people’s minds, so if this is necessary for what the Christians say and its corruption is apparent, The corruption of the necessary indicates the corruption of the required, for the truth of this saying is that the one who used to eat, drink, urinate, and defecate, and the one who He was beaten, spit on in his face, and thorns were placed on his head. He is the Lord of the Worlds.

The same interpretation of this saying is something that necessitates knowledge of its falsehood and God’s disavowal of it, and that its speaker is one of the greatest slanderers against God, the Almighty said: {And they say: The Most Gracious has taken a son} [Maryam: 88] (88) {You have certainly come to something bitter} [Maryam: 89] (89) {The heavens are almost bursting with water from Him. And the earth will split open, and the mountains will fall down in ruins.} [Maryam: 90] (90) {Indeed, they called for the Most Merciful a son} [Maryam: 91] (91) {And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful to take sons} [Maryam: 92] (92) {Indeed, everyone in the heavens and the earth except one who comes to the Most Gracious is a servant} [Maryam: 93] (93) {Indeed, He has numbered them and numbered them as a number} [Maryam:

94] (94) {And they will all come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection} [Maryam: 95] The fifth aspect: Their saying: And He addressed the people as God spoke to Moses from Al-Awsajah, it is necessary that those to whom Christ spoke should be those who believed in him and disbelieved in him, in the position of Moses ibn Imran, to whom God spoke precisely.

It is known that God speaking to Moses, peace and blessings be upon him, is what He preferred over other prophets. If one of the people was in the position of Moses ibn Imran It is necessary for each individual person to be in the position of Musa ibn Imran, and this is one of the things whose corruption is known by necessity from the religion of the Messengers.

The sixth aspect: It is known that God’s speech to His prophets and messengers is better than His speech to those who are neither a prophet nor a messenger. Christ, peace be upon him, did not speak to all the prophets and messengers. Rather, he only spoke to people, some of whom believed in him and some of whom disbelieved in him.

The truth is that he did not speak to any of God’s messengers, but the Christians claim that the disciples are God’s messengers, and this is false, and if he was greeted and did not speak Except for twelve messengers, and God had sent many messengers before him, and it was narrated in the hadith of Abu Dharr that their number was three hundred and three. Ten.

God has said in the Qur’an: “And We have certainly sent into every nation a messenger, saying, ‘Worship God and avoid the tyrant.’ And among them are those whom God has guided, and among them are those. Misguidance has befallen him.} [An-Nahl: 36] And God Almighty said: {And there is not a nation but a warner has passed over it.} [Fatir: 24]

And in the hadith in the Musnad, on the authority of Bahz ibn Hakim, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “You You will give birth to seventy nations, of which you are the best and most honorable in the eyes of God Almighty. And these seventy, whether they are the ones He guided or they are all of them. It indicates the large number of messengers, and God did not speak to any of these human beings. If the one speaking to the people about Jesus was God, it would have been God’s speech to those to whom Jesus spoke, from the unbelievers and the believers, is more complete than His speech to the messengers of God whom He sent.

The seventh aspect: The humanity of Christ is of the same type as all other humanity, and man cannot see God in this world as he was told. Thus, Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, so if he was not able to see him, then he would not be able to contact him and touch him, as well. It is better and more important to unite with Him.

The eighth aspect: When God spoke to Moses, peace be upon him, from the tree, the words heard were different from what was heard from the words of the people, and for this reason she could not bear The children of Israel heard that voice, but they said to Moses: Describe that for us, and this is what they have in the Torah.

As Al-Khallal narrated in the Book of Sunnah, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Hanbal, in what he narrated from the hadith of Al-Zuhri, he said: “When Moses heard the words of God, he said: O Lord Are these words that I hear your words? He said: Yes, O Moses, they are my words, but I spoke to you with the power of ten thousand tongues, and the power of tongues is mine. All of it, and I am stronger than that. I only spoke to you as much as your body can handle, and if I had spoken to you more than this, you would have died. When Moses returned To his people, they said to him: Describe the words of your Lord for us. He said: Glory be to God, and can I describe it to you? They said: So he made it similar to us. He said:
Have you heard the sounds of the lightning bolts coming in the sweetest sweetness you have ever heard? It is as if it were like him.”

As for Christ, peace be upon him, everyone heard his voice like the voice of all other people, and it was not distinguished from them in a way that required that they heard the word of God. As Musa bin Imran heard it.
The ninth aspect:

If the jinn resides in the human language as it does in the masculine, and speaks in its own language, then the speech changes, and those present know that it is not It is the speech of a human being, even though he speaks with the human tongue and the movement of his limbs. It is known that the sound occurred through the movement of the human body, along with Knowing that he has changed in a way that deviates from what is usual for human speech, and the person in whom the jinn has descended is lost from his mind and does not He feels what the genie spoke on his tongue, for the Lord of the Worlds, Glory be to Him, if He resided within a human being and united with Him and spoke His words, and the speech was What is heard is the word of God from which it is heard. It would be apparent from the difference between that and the usual human speech that it is extremely apparent. The condition of the human being would change greatly, for when the Lord Almighty and Majestic appeared to the mountain, He caused it to collapse, and Moses fell down in shock. The human being is not established because of his manifestation of the mountain, so how can he be established because of his abode in it and his speaking on his tongue without any change in the body?

When the revelation and the angels descended upon the prophets, the change would appear in their inner beings, so the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was When the revelation descends upon him, he greets him with such a weight that the camel can bless him, even if his thigh is heavy with someone, so much so that it almost flatters him.

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Aisha, “Al-Harith bin Hisham said: “O Messenger of God, how does revelation come to you? He said: Sometimes it comes to me in a similar way.” The ringing of the bell is the hardest thing for me, so he leaves me and I realize what he said. Sometimes the angel appears to me as a man and speaks to me, and I understand what he says. Aisha said: I saw him descending on him on a very cold day and then he was separated from him, and his forehead was dripping with sweat.”

And Moses, peace be upon him, when he heard the word of God, he abhorred humans, because the word of God settled in his hearing, and the light appeared on his face until it was He wears a veil, and according to the Christians, Christ has been united with divinity since the time Mary was attached to him, and he was still united with him while he was pregnant in her womb. His union with him increased as he grew older. Then he was united with him when he was a boy until he was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of his father when he was To them, he was united with him, divinity, and humanity, and yet the body of Christ did not change in a manner commensurate with that, and no one appeared. The lights are not appropriate for that. Rather, according to them, before Christ (John) baptized him and saw what looked like a dove descending upon him, he did not appear Rather, it was like one of the people, and the first of the signs that appeared was turning water into wine.
And Moses, peace be upon him, as soon as he heard the words, light appeared upon him, and where did he hear the words from being united with them?

And when Moses heard the words and God spoke to him from the tree, the angels descended and some of the signs of God and His greatness appeared to him, appropriate to the speech of God Almighty. Glory be to Him.
For Christians, the Lord is always united with the body of Christ, and He has not shown signs of lordship and greatness except those that appear more than that to some. The prophets.

The tenth aspect: If the person addressing the people is the sum of divinity and humanity, then his words are clear in that he is a created being to be loved and called upon. And he asks, and the aggregate is not a created being that asks God and worships Him, even if it is divinity alone as their words require, then it is Farther and farther, and if He was humanity alone, then divinity was not addressing people, and God did not speak to people from humanity, as God spoke to Moses from The tree.
Also, there was no difference between the truth of the words of humanity and the words of theology.

The clear words of Christ are that he is a great created being and they acknowledge that, but they say that is the words of humanity. Then it will be said to them: The one who is addressing the people is humanity and not the divinity, and you said: God addressed the creation from the body of Christ as He spoke to Moses from the tree.

The speech that Moses heard from the tree was all the speech of theology, and the speech that was heard from Christ did not contain anything related to theology, but rather Its generality is clear that it is human speech.

The eleventh aspect: When God spoke to Moses from the tree, the words were the words of God alone. The tree had no words at all in any way. Faces. If this parable is consistent, then the one who speaks to people about the humanity of Christ is the divinity alone.
It is known that there is evidence in the Bible and other explicit texts that the human being was the speaker, which shows the clear difference between this And this.
The twelfth aspect: The one who called to Moses from the tree did not speak except the words of divinity, and said: {Indeed, I am God, Lord of the worlds} [Al-Qasas: 30]

{Indeed, I am God, there is no god but Me, so worship Me and establish prayer in remembrance of Me - Indeed, the Hour is coming - I will almost hide it, so that every soul may be rewarded for what it seeks - So do not turn you away from it who does not believe in it and follows his own desires, and you are deceived.} [Ta-ha: 14-16].

And everything else that he spoke implies that it is the speech of the Lord of the worlds, and as for the one speaking on the tongue of Christ, he did not say a word of this at all, but rather There was in his speech an acknowledgment that he is a messenger, that he is a creature in need, that he is the son of mankind, and other things that contradict him in every way. The words of the caller to Moses from the tree: Whoever equates this with that has equated the Lord of the worlds with a human being, and he is more astray than About whom God said: {By God, if we are in clear error - when We make you equal to the Lord of the worlds} [Al-Shu’ara’: 97-98].

These misguided people made this man The one who speaks is the Lord of the worlds who spoke to Moses from the tree, and they said: This who spoke to the servants is the one who called to Moses from the tree. The thirteenth aspect: to say:

It is known that God is more majestic, greater, and greater than His messengers in ways that no created being can appreciate. If He were the one who spoke to creation through the tongue of Christ, and the disciples were his messengers who heard his words from him without intermediary. The disciples would have been either like Moses or greater.

It is known that Christ himself did not have signs like the signs of Moses, let alone the disciples. The greatest signs of Christ, peace be upon him, were the revival of The dead, and this verse was shared by other prophets, such as Elias and others.

The People of the Book have in their books that other than the Messiah, God brought the dead to life at his hands, and Moses bin Imran was among his disobedient signs. Which turned over and became a clear serpent until it swallowed the ropes and the staffs of the magicians. More than once he would throw them and they would become a serpent and then He catches it and it becomes a stick.

It is known that this is a sign that was not intended for anyone else, and it is greater than reviving the dead, for man was life, so if he lives, he It returned to its previous state, and God Almighty revives the dead by raising them from their graves, and He has revived more than one of the dead in this world. As for a piece of wood overturning and becoming an animal and then returning to a piece of wood again and again and swallowing ropes and sticks, this is more amazing than life. And also, God has informed that he who was raised from the dead by the hand of Moses and other prophets of the children of Israel is greater than the one who brought them back to life. At the hands of Christ, the Almighty said:

{And when you said, “O Moses, we will not believe in you until we see God plainly.” Then the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on. Then We resurrected you after Your death that you may be grateful.” [Al-Baqarah: 55-56]
. And God Almighty said: {So We said, “Strike him with part of it. Thus does God bring to life the dead” [Al-Baqarah: 73]

And God Almighty said: {Have you not seen those who went out from their homes, and they were thousands, for fear of death, and God said to them, “Die, and then He brought them back to life” [Al-Baqarah: 243].

Also, Moses, peace and blessings be upon him, used to leave his hand white without any harm, and this is greater than healing the effects of the leprosy that Christ had done to him. Peace be upon you, for leprosy is a common disease, but what is astonishing is that it is cured of it, and as for the whiteness of the hand without leprosy and then its return to its original state, There are two wondrous things in it, the likes of which are not known.

Also, for Moses, God divided the sea for him so that the children of Israel crossed it, and Pharaoh and his soldiers drowned in it, and this is an amazing matter of greatness. This verse, and part of God’s destruction of the enemy of Moses, was not the same for the Messiah.

Also, God used to feed them manna and quails at His hand, despite the large number of the children of Israel, and He would bring punishment for them by striking stones every day. Twelve springs are enough for them.
This is greater than Christ, peace be upon him, coming down to the table, or turning water into wine, or other things that are mentioned in the prayers of God. And his peace be upon them all.

And Moses had lice, frogs, blood, and other signs in his enemy that Christ did not have the like of. If the Apostles had been messengers, they would have God spoke to them just as He spoke to Moses from the tree. They were like Moses, so how come it is when Christ himself did not have signs like the signs of Moses, even if he had Christ is the Divinity who spoke to Moses in order to show His power greater than what He had shown at the hands of Moses, for He did not reside in the body of Moses, nor was Theology speaks to creation from Moses, as these people claim about Christ, and along with these are the verses with which He supported His servant Moses, those verses Great, so what would be his signs if it was the same one who dwelt in the body of Christ, and he was the one speaking to the people through the tongue of Christ?

The fourteenth aspect: That it should be said: Their saying: God spoke to the people in Christ, just as He spoke to the Prophet Moses from the brambles of the thorns. Falsehood, for God, by agreement of all the nations, did not dwell in the tree, and was not united with it, as they claim that He resided in Christ and was united with it. Because, according to them, he resided in the interior of Christ, and even in his outward appearance, and was united with him inwardly and outwardly. The Lord Almighty was not in the interior of the tree, nor He resided within it, but was not united with it, and God’s saying that He spoke to him from it and called him from it is like His saying:
He was called from the right shore of the valley, and this is like his saying:
{Has the hadith of Moses reached you - when his Lord called him in the holy valley Tuwa} [Al-Nazi’at: 15-16].

And in the Blessed Spot and the like, and it is not in any of that that the Almighty Lord resided in the interior of the Holy Valley, or the Spot. The Blessed One, or the right side, nor was it united with anything of that, nor did it and any of that become a single entity, nor a person. One, as some Christians say: Divinity and humanity became one essence, and some of them say: They became one person, and no one even said: It is permissible in any of that, like the solution of water in milk, or fire in iron, as some of them say: Divinity is permissible in humanity.

Likewise, if it were assumed that some people had said something that is not indicated by the divine scriptures and is not known by reason, it would not have been His statement is an argument, as it cannot be used as evidence except by a proven quotation from the prophets, or by what is known by reason.

The fifteenth aspect: The one who spoke to Moses and called him is God, Lord of the worlds, and His speech to him from the tree is of the kind that informed of his descent. To the lowest heaven, and His descent on the Day of Resurrection to account for creation, and the discussion of that is simple elsewhere than in this place.
As for its penetration into human beings or its union with them, it is denied in many ways, both by reason and hearing, even though it was not reported by a prophet.

What the Christians say is extremely contradictory, for they claim that Christ is the Word and He is the Creator, because the Word and the essence are one thing. One, so they do not differentiate between the attribute and the thing described, then they say: The one united with Christ is the Word without the essence that they call the Father, and they say However: it was not dispersed or divided.

It is known with clear reason that the word that is the adjective cannot be separated from what is described, so it does not unite with or replace the thing described, especially According to them, the one entity is the Creator, so He must be the Father. They do not say: the one entity is the Father, but rather He is The son, and if they say: The son is the one who is united without the father, then the one who is not united is not the one who is not united, and the son is united and the father is not He united.

And they say: The united Jesus took a veil under which he was hidden, and a dwelling place in which he lived, and he addressed the people in it. They say in that: He united. The Father did not veil himself with it, did not dwell in it, and was not united with it, so it was absolutely necessary that there be something from Him that was united and something from Him that was not united. The father was not united, and the son was united, and this contradicts their saying, “He was not separated,” and invalidates their representation of the person being addressed by the tree. That is God, Lord of the worlds. He is not the Son apart from the Father, despite the many clear differences mentioned that show the invalidity of the representation. This with this.

The sixteenth aspect: When the Lord Almighty speaks, he speaks the words of divinity. If Christ had had in him the divinity that sent Moses and others, he would not have He submits to Moses and his Torah, and remembers that he only came to complete it, not to abolish it, nor was he to fulfill its laws, for the Lord of the worlds Greater and more honorable than that. Indeed, if he were one of the angels, he would not have done the like of that, so how about the Lord of the worlds?

And if the Christians say: He did that out of fear of the Children of Israel, or out of fear that they would deny him, their excuse is uglier than their sin. Of the worlds, who does the Almighty fear? ! .

And Moses, when Pharaoh used to deny him, used to show signs by which he humiliated Pharaoh and his people, despite his arrogance and the arrogance of his people, and there were no children. Israel is more powerful than Pharaoh and his people. If he were the Lord of the worlds, the signs with which he supported himself would be greater than what he supports himself with. His servant Moses.
One of the wonders of the Christians is that they claim divinity in him, while claiming extreme inability in him, until he was crucified.

As for the Muslims, they say: He is a supported messenger, he was not crucified, and this is the law of God, Glory be to Him, regarding His messengers, for He supports them. And he helps them against their enemy, just as he supported Noah, Abraham, and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them. If he is not permitted to be a messenger Defeated, so how can a defeated Lord be crucified? ! .

The seventeenth aspect: They say that He performed miracles through His divinity, and revealed the inability through His humanity. So it is said to them: Indeed, God has performed miracles. What is greater than the miracles that appeared at the hands of Christ, peace be upon him, and he was not united with any human being? What necessity was there for him to To unite with humans if He performs miracles other than that? !

The eighteenth aspect: That miracles appeared at the hands of Christ, as appeared to all other messengers, and the miracles of some of them were greater than His miracles. However, the miracles were not evidence of the unity of divinity with the Prophet at whose hands they appeared, so it is known that the inference With the appearance of miracles at his hands in the utmost corruption.

The nineteenth aspect: If divinity is united with humanity, its action is not distinguished from the action of humanity, for if they become one thing Everything he did of the inability and miracle was that one person, like the examples that they set for God Almighty, for they represent That is by fire with iron, and water with milk and wine.

It is known that if a piece of iron is put into the fire until it becomes white like white fire, then its action is one action, it does not have two actions. They are distinct: one with iron, and the other with fire. Rather, it contains the power of iron and the power of fire. Rather, it contains a third power that is not the power of iron. Nor the power of fire, as it is neither pure iron nor pure fire.

Likewise, if water is mixed with milk and wine, then what is united between them is one thing, its effect is one action, some of it is neither pure water nor Pure milk. No rational person would say: It has two actions that distinguish one from the other: an action in that it is pure milk, and an action in that it is water. Purely, their statement of unity necessitates the impossibility of divinity through humanity, and that the act of the united person becomes one thing.

And if divinity is not united with it, then they are two persons, two essences, two natures, and two wills, and this is not the religion of the Christians, although the coming of the Lord God Almighty is incapable of human beings, as has been explained in another topic.
Likewise, if they represent it as a soul with a body, then the soul’s attributes change as it separates from the body, and likewise the body’s attributes change. By the spirit departing from him.
The human being into whom the spirit was breathed and it became a body in which the spirit is is a third type in which there is neither a pure body nor a pure spirit, so much so that it is said:

He does such-and-such with his body, and such-and-such with himself. Rather, his actions involve the soul. When he eats and drinks, the soul enjoys it. By eating and drinking, and with it he becomes an eater and a drinker, otherwise the dead body does not eat or drink, and when he looks and infers and hears and sees And you know, the soul did that to the body, and that is evident in the body, and the soul alone does not do that, and according to them, the act Divinity after the union is like its action before it, and so is the action of humanity, and this contradicts the union.

To say this while being united is the utmost contradiction and corruption, and it is inconceivable to compare this to any of the existing things, and the same speaker of this is one of Christians cannot imagine what he is saying, nor can he represent it with anything reasonable.

chapters.title: A chapter that contradicts their claim is that the Qur’an established divinity and humanity in Christ
paragraphs: [Chapter: Refuting their claim that the Qur’an established divinity and humanity in Christ]

They said: And it came in this book that this man brought, saying: {The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, is only the Messenger of God, and his word he delivered To Maryam and a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa: 171]

. This agrees with our statement: since he testified that he is a man like us, that is, by the humanity that was taken from Mary, and the word of God and his united spirit. In it, God forbid that the Word of God and His creative spirit should be like us created beings. And also He said in Surat An-Nisa: {And they did not kill them, nor did they crucify them. But it is likened to them.} [An-Nisa: 157]

. With this statement, he referred to the theology, which is the Word of God, to which no pain or symptom entered, and he also said: {O Jesus, I will cause you to die. And I will raise you up to Me and purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection.” [Al Imran: 55]

. And he said in Surat Al-Ma’idah on the authority of Jesus that he said: “And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them. But when You took me to death, you were the watcher over them, and you were the Everything is a witness” [Al-Ma’idah: 117].
By his death, he meant the death of the humanity that was taken from the Virgin Mary.
He also said in Surat An-Nisa: “And they did not kill him of certainty, but rather God raised him to Himself” [An-Nisa: 157].

By this he referred to the divinity, which is the creative word of God, and by this analogy we say: Christ was crucified and suffered in His humanity, and did not He will be crucified and will not suffer because of His divinity.

The answer is in a number of ways: One of them is to say: Their claim against Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is that he proved divinity and humanity in Christ, just as What these Christians claim about it is a clear and well-known lie against Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, who is known for his religion by necessity. It is also known from his religion that he believed Christ, peace be upon him, and confirmed his message. If the Jews claimed that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was He denies Christ and denies his message. It was like the Christians’ claim against him, as he used to say:

He is the Lord of the worlds, and divinity is united with humanity, and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, reported what was conveyed to him about God Almighty with disbelief. Who said that, and with something that contradicts that in other places, such as the Almighty’s saying:

{Indeed, those who said, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have disbelieved.” Say, “Then who can have any power over God if He wanted to destroy the Messiah, the son of Mary, and his mother?” And whoever is on the earth, to Allah belongs all dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He creates whatever He pleases, and Allah has power over all things.” [Al-Ma’idah: 17].
And the Almighty said:

{Indeed, those who say, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, son of Mary” have disbelieved. And the Messiah said, “O Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord. Indeed, it is he who associates others with God.” By God, God has forbidden to him Paradise, and his abode is the Fire, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. - Indeed, those who say that God is the third of three have disbelieved, and there are no There is no god but one God, and if they do not desist from what they say, a painful punishment will certainly befall those who disbelieve among them - so will they not repent to God? And they seek His forgiveness, and God is Forgiving, Merciful - The Messiah, the son of Mary, is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and his mother is a truthful one. They used to eat Food: See how We make clear to them the signs, then see how they are misled - Say, “Do you worship besides God that which possesses for you no harm or benefit, and God is He The All-Hearing, the All-Knowing - Say, “O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the desires of a people who went astray before, and have misled many, and gone astray.” On the straight path} [Al-Maeda:
. And the Almighty said:

{And the Jews said, “Uzair is the son of God,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of God.” That is what they say with their mouths, imitating the words of those who disbelieve. Before God killed them, how could they be judged? - They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God, and the Messiah, the son of Mary, and they were not commanded to do anything except To worship one God; there is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate - they want to extinguish the light of God with their mouths, but God refuses to do anything except His light will be perfected, even if the disbelievers hate it - It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to make it prevail over all religions, even if the polytheists hate it - O you who have believed, many rabbis and monks devour people’s wealth unjustly and avert from the path of God and those who They hoard up gold and silver, but do not spend them in the way of God. So give them good tidings of a painful punishment.} [Repentance:
And the Almighty said:

{And when the son of Mary was given as an example, behold, your people turned away from it - and they said, “Are our gods better or are they?” They did not present it to you except as an argument. Rather, they are a people. Our adversaries - He is nothing but a servant upon whom We have bestowed a blessing and made him an example to the Children of Israel - and if We had willed, We could have made of you angels on earth. They will succeed - and indeed it is knowledge of the Hour, so do not be tempted by it, and follow this a straight path - and do not let Satan stop you, for he is your clear enemy - and when Jesus came with clear proofs. He said, “I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that about which you differ. So fear God and obey me - for God is He.” My Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path. Then the parties differed from among them. So woe to those who do wrong from the torment of a painful Day.} [Al-Zukhruf:

And God Almighty said: {And when God said, “O Jesus, son of Mary, did you say to the people, ‘Take me and my mother as two gods besides God?’” He said, “Glory be to You, what shall I have?” To say what I have no right to say. If I had said it, you would have known it. You know what is in my soul, and I do not know what is in Yourself. Indeed, You are the Knower of the unseen - What I said Except what you commanded me to do: “Worship God, my Lord and your Lord,” and I was a witness over them as long as I was among them. But when you took me to death, you were the watcher over them. And You are a witness over all things.} [Al-Ma’idah: 116-117]

So he told about the Messiah that he did not say to them except what God commanded him to do, by saying: “Worship God, my Lord and your Lord,” and it was upon them He was a martyr as long as he was among them, and after his death, God was the watcher over them, so if some of them had made a mistake in quoting him or in interpreting Christ, peace be upon him, was not affected by his words, or he deliberately changed his religion, but he was a messenger, upon whom was the clear message.

God Almighty told us that the first thing that Christ spoke was that he said: {He said, “Indeed, I am a servant of God. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.” And He made me blessed wherever I am, and He commanded me to pray and to give alms as long as I live - and to be dutiful to my mother, and He did not make me a wretched tyrant” [Maryam: 30-32].
Then he asked for peace for himself and said: {And peace be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am resurrected alive} [Maryam: 33].
The Christians say: (Peace be upon us from him), just as the Ghaliyas say about those in whom they claim divinity, such as the Nusayriyyah regarding Ali, and the Hakimiya regarding Ali. The ruler.

The second aspect: That it is said: God did not mention that the Messiah died or was killed, but rather said: {O Jesus, indeed I will cause you to die, and I will raise you up to Me, and I will purify you from Those who disbelieve} [Al Imran: 55]
And Christ said: {So when you took me, you were the watcher over them and you are a witness over all things} [Al-Maeda: 117]
And the Almighty said:

{Because they broke their covenant and disbelieved in the verses of God and killed the prophets unjustly and said, “Our hearts are uncircumcised.” Rather, God has set a seal upon them. Because of their disbelief, they will not believe except a few - and because of their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander - and their saying: We killed the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary. The Messenger of God, nor did they kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was made to appear to them, and indeed those who differ concerning it are in doubt. They have no knowledge of it except the following of conjecture. And they did not kill him of certainty - but God raised him to it, and God is Mighty, Wise - and there is not one of the People of the Book who will not believe in him before his death and on the day of his death. On the Resurrection, he will be a witness over them - because of injustice on the part of those who were Jews, We prohibited from them good things that were lawful for them, and because they turned away from the path of God much - And they took usury from them, although they had forbidden it, and devoured people’s wealth unjustly, and We have prepared for the disbelievers among them a painful punishment.} [An-Nisa:

So God condemned the Jews for some things, including: their uttering of a great slander against Mary; Where they claimed that it was transgression, including: Their saying: {Indeed, We killed the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, the Messenger of God} [An-Nisa: 157].
God Almighty said: {And they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was likened to them} [An-Nisa: 157].
He added this statement to them and condemned them for it.

He did not mention the Christians. Because those who crucified the one who was crucified were the Jews, and none of the Christians witnessed this with them, rather it was The disciples were afraid and absent. None of them witnessed the crucifixion. Rather, the Jews witnessed it, and they were the ones who told the people that they had crucified Christ. And those who reported that Christ was crucified from among the Christians and others only reported it from those Jews, who were a group of the agents of the oppressors. They were not It is a great character that prevents them from colluding to lie.

God Almighty said: {And they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was likened to them} [An-Nisa: 157]. He denied killing him, then said: “And there is not one of the People of the Book who believes in him before his death” [An-Nisa’: 159].

According to most scholars, this means before the death of Christ, and it has been said that before the death of the Jew while he was weak, just as it was said: that before The death of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, while he was weaker. If he had believed in him before death, his belief in him would have benefited him, for God accepts his repentance. The servant unless he gargles.

If it is said: What is meant is the faith that occurs after the gargling, there is no benefit in this, because every person after his death believes in the unseen. Whoever denied it, Christ has no authority over it, and because he said it before his death, and he did not say it after his death, and because there is no difference between his belief In Christ and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them, and the Jew who dies adhering to Judaism dies as a disbeliever in Muhammad, and Christ’s prayers be upon them both. And peace, and because He said: {And there is not one of the People of the Book except that he believes in him before his death} [An-Nisa: 159]
And His saying: “Let them believe in Him” [An-Nisa’: 159]

An act that is sworn to, and this will only happen in the future, so this indicates that this faith is after God was informed of this, even if it was intended. Before the death of the Book, he would have said: “And among the People of the Book are those who believe in it.” He did not say: “Let them believe in it.” [An-Nisa: 159]

Also, he said, “And of the People of the Book,” and this applies to Jews and Christians. This indicates that all of the People of the Book are Jews. The Christians believed in Christ before the death of Christ, and that is when he descended. The Jews and Christians believed that he was the Messenger of God and not a liar as he The Jews say, “He is not God,” as the Christians say.

Maintaining this generality is more appropriate than claiming that every writer will believe in him before the writer dies, for this It requires the faith of every Jew and Christian, and this is contrary to reality, and it is because he said: And there is not one of the People of the Book who does not believe in it before... His death indicates that what is meant by their belief before his death is him. It is known that what is meant in general is the generality of those who were present at the time of his revelation. That is, none of them will fail to believe in Him, not the faith of one of them who is dead.

This is as it is said: There will not remain a country without the Antichrist entering it, except Mecca and Medina, that is, from the cities existing at that time, and the reason for faith The People of the Book will then be clear about him, for it will appear to everyone that he is a supported Messenger, not a liar, nor is he the Lord of the Worlds.

God Almighty mentioned their faith in him when he descended to earth. When He Almighty mentioned, He raised him up to God by saying: {Indeed, I will cause you to die. And I will raise you to Me.” [Al Imran: 55]
He will descend to earth before the Day of Resurrection and die. At that time, he was informed of their belief in him before his death, as God Almighty said in a verse: Other:

{He is nothing but a servant upon whom We have bestowed a blessing and made him an example to the Children of Israel - and had We willed, We could have made from among you angels on earth to succeed you - And it is a sign of the Hour, so do not be tempted by it, but follow this is a straight path - and do not let Satan deceive you. Indeed, he is yours an open enemy - and when Jesus came With clear proofs. He said, “I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that about which you differ. So fear God and obey me.” Indeed, God is my Lord. And your Lord, so worship Him. This is the path
Straight - Then the parties differed from among them, so woe to those who wronged from the torment of a painful Day} [Al-Zukhruf: 59-65].

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said: “The son of Mary is about to descend among you as a just arbitrator and a just imam, and he will be defeated.” cross, and he kills the pig, and imposes the tax.” There is a great deal of doubt about it. They have no knowledge of it except following suspicion, and they did not kill him with certainty. Rather, God raised him to Himself, and God is Mighty, Wise.} [An-Nisa: 157] - 158].
A statement that God raised him alive and saved him from killing, and an explanation that they believed in him before he died.
And likewise His saying: And He will purify you from among those who disbelieve.
If he died, there would be no difference between him and anyone else.

The word “tawfee” in the Arabic language means: completion and capture, and there are three types: one of them: the death of sleep, and the second: the death of death, The third: He died, both the soul and the body. Thus, he departed from the situation of the people of the earth who need to eat and drink. And clothing and sleep, and excrement and urine come out of them, and Christ, peace be upon him, God took his soul while he is in the second heaven until he descends To the earth, his condition is not like the condition of the people of the earth in eating, drinking, clothing, sleeping, excrement and urine, and the like.

The third aspect: Their saying: He was on my behalf by his death, on account of the death of humanity. They should have said, according to their origin: On my behalf, on account of his death. Concerning the death of humanity, and whether it is said that he died or I died, he is nothing other than humanity, for there is nothing other than him that has not died, and God Almighty He said: {Indeed, I will cause you to die and raise you to Me} [Al Imran: 55]

The deceased is the one raised up to God, and their saying: The one raised up is divinity, is contrary to the text of the Qur’an. If there was death, then how? It was not, because they made the nominative noun not the deceased, and the Qur’an tells us that the nominative noun is the deceased. Likewise his statement in the other verse: “And they did not kill him of certainty, but rather God raised him to Himself” [An-Nisa’: 157].
It is a denial of the Jews’ statement: “Indeed, We killed the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, the Messenger of God” [An-Nisa: 157].

The Jews did not claim to kill theology, nor did they prove that God had a divinity in Christ, and God Almighty did not even mention the claim of killing him on behalf of the Christians. It is said: Their intention is to kill humanity rather than divinity, but rather on behalf of the Jews who only affirm humanity.
They claimed that they killed him, so God Almighty said: {And they did not kill him of certainty, but rather God raised him to Himself} [An-Nisa: 157].

So he confirmed that those who said that they killed him had been removed, but that he was humanity, so it was known that he was the one from whom killing was denied. He is the one who was raised, and the Christians acknowledge the elevation of humanity, but they claim that he was crucified, and he resided in the grave for either one day or three days. Then he ascended to heaven, and sat at the right hand of the Lord, humanity and divinity.
And the Almighty says: {And they did not kill him of certainty} [An-Nisa: 157]

It means: denying his killing is certain without any doubt, unlike those who disagreed, for they are in doubt as to whether he killed him, and not killing him, so they are not. We are certain that he was killed; Because there is no argument with them regarding that.

For this reason, a group of Christians were saying: He was not crucified, because those who crucified him were the Jews, and the Messiah was suspected of them. By someone else, as indicated by the Qur’an, and likewise according to the People of the Book, that someone else was suspected, so they did not know who the Messiah was from among those people until Some people said to them: I know him, so they knew him, and the statement of those who said: The meaning of the words: They did not kill him out of knowledge, but rather out of suspicion, is a weak statement.
The fourth aspect: That God Almighty said: {When God said, O Jesus, indeed I will cause you to die and raise you to Me and purify you from those who disbelieve} [Al Imran: 55].

If what is raised up were divinity, the Lord of the worlds would have said to Himself or to His Word: “I raise you to Me,” and likewise His saying: Nay, God raised him to Himself, so to them Christ is God.

It is known that He refrains from raising Himself to Himself, and if they say: He is the Word, they nevertheless say that He is God. The Creator, do not make it like the Torah and the Qur’an and the like, which are from the words of God in which He said: {To Him the good words ascend} [Fatir: 10]
Rather, with them, He is God, the Creator and Sustainer, Lord of the worlds, and raising the Lord of the worlds to the Lord of the worlds is impossible.

The fifth aspect: His saying: {And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them, but when you took me to death you were the watcher over them} [Al-Ma’idah: 117] is evidence that After his death, there was no one to watch over them except God and not Christ. His saying, “It was you,” indicates confinement, as in his saying: {If this is the case. He is the truth} [Al-Anfal: 32] and the like, so it was known that Christ after his death was not a supervisor over his followers, but rather God is the observer who is aware of them. He who counts their deeds is the one who rewards them, and Christ is not a supervisor, so He does not look at their deeds, nor count them, nor reward them for them.

chapters.title: Their claim is refuted by the occurrence of the name of Christ as creator in the Qur’an
paragraphs: [Chapter: Their claim is refuted by the occurrence of the name of Christ as Creator in the Qur’an]

They said: God also called him in this Book a Creator, where He said: {And when You created out of clay the appearance of a bird by My ear, and you blew into it, and it was A bird by My permission} [Al-Maeda: 110]

So he referred to the Creator to the word of God united with humanity taken from Mary, because this is what he said through the mouth of David the Prophet: “By the word God created the heavens and the earth. There is no creator except God, His Word, and His Spirit.

This is what agrees with our opinion and belief in the Lord Christ, because he mentioned it, because he said: {Indeed, I create for you out of clay the appearance of a bird. Then I will blow into it, and it will become a bird, God willing.} [Al Imran: 49]
That is, with the permission of the divinity of the Word united in humanity.
And the answer:

Everything that they use as evidence from these verses and others is an argument against them and not for them, and this is the case with all the people of misguidance. They used as evidence something from the Books of God and the words of His prophets. The very thing they used as evidence was evidence of the corruption of what they said, and that is due to the greatness of the Books of God. status and what His prophets spoke, for He made that a guidance and an explanation for creation and a cure for what is in the breasts, so it must be in words. The prophets, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them all, provide guidance and clarification with which God differentiates between truth and falsehood, truth and lies. But people are sent by themselves, not by the prophets of God Almighty.

Either because they did not properly reflect on what the prophets said until they understood and comprehended it, or because They take part of the truth and not part of it, such as if they believe in part of what God has revealed and not part of it, so they go astray as to what they do not believe in. As God Almighty said about the Christians: {And among those who said, “Indeed, we are Christians.” We took a covenant from them, but they forgot a portion of what they had been reminded with, so We deceived them among them. Enmity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection} [Al-Ma’idah: 14]

Either in terms of their attribution to the prophets, the sayings they did not say were lied to them, or in terms of translating their sayings into something other than It deserves a translation and an interpretation other than the interpretation it deserves that was indicated by the words of the prophets, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them. All together, the speaker’s words must be interpreted one by one, and his words should be taken here and there, and it is known what they usually mean. And he means it by that word when he speaks it, and the meanings that he knew he meant in another place are known, so if his custom and habit in it are known Its meanings and words, this was what was used to help us know what it meant.

But if his word was used in a meaning in which he was not accustomed to using it, and he abandoned using it in the meaning in which he was accustomed to use it. By using it in it, and conveying his words contrary to the meaning that was known to be intended by that word, by making his words contradictory, and abandoning its meaning. In accordance with the rest of his words, this was a distortion of his words from their proper place, a change in his intentions, and a lie against him.

This is the origin of those who go astray in interpreting the words of the prophets in a manner other than what they intended. If this is known, we say: The answer to what they mentioned here is There are several aspects: One of them is that God did not mention about Christ a general character, nor a general character, as He, Blessed and Most High, mentioned about Himself. God revealed to His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, {Read in the name of your Lord who created - He created man from a clot - Recite, and your Lord is the Most Generous - He who knows By the pen - He taught man what he did not know} [Al-Alq: 1-5]

And the Almighty said: {He is God, there is no god but He, the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful - He is God, there is no god but Him. The King, the Holy, the Peaceful, the Faithful, the Dominant, the Mighty, the Mighty, the Arrogant. Glory be to God above what they associate with Him - He is God, the Creator, the Creator, the One who created Him. The Most Beautiful Names} [Al-Hashr: 22-24]

. So he reminded himself that he is the Creator, the Creator, the Formator, and he never described any of the creatures with this, neither an angel nor a prophet, and so he said The Almighty: {Allah is the Creator of all things and He is the Disposer of All things - to Him are the reins of the heavens and the earth} [Az-Zumar: 62-63]

. And God Almighty said: {And they appointed partners for the jinn for God, and created them, and created for Him sons and daughters without knowledge. Glory be to Him, Most High, above what they describe - Badi’ The heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He has no companion? And He created everything and He is All-Knowing of all things.} [Al-An’am: 100-101]

. He described himself as the Lord of the worlds, and that he is the master of the Day of Judgment, and that to Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and that He is the Ever-Living, the Ever-Subsisting. He is overtaken by a year and no sleep, and that He is Able to do all things and Knowing of all things, and other such characteristics of divinity, and He did not describe any of it. His creatures are neither a close angel nor a prophet sent with any of the characteristics that are unique to Him, with which He described Himself, Glory be to Him, the Most High. Christ, peace be upon him, said about it:

{And when you were created out of clay like the shape of a bird by My Permission, and you breathed into it and it became a bird by My Permission, and you healed the blind and the leper by My Permission} [Al-Maeda: 110]

Christ said about himself: {Indeed, I create for you out of clay the likeness of a bird, and I breathe into it, and it becomes a bird, God willing, and I will be healed. The blind and the lepers, and I bring the dead to life by God’s permission} [Al Imran: 49] He did not mention anything except the creation of a specific thing, specifically by God’s permission, so how can this be? Is that the Creator?

The second aspect: He was created from clay in the form of a bird, and what is meant by it is to depict him in the form of a bird, and this creation is something that the general public can do. It is possible for one of them to make images of clay in the form of a bird, or an animal other than a bird, but this depiction is forbidden, unlike Depicting Christ, for God allowed him to do so.

The miracle is that the spirit is breathed into it and it becomes a bird, with the permission of God Almighty. The miracle is not merely created from clay, for this Common, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, cursed the photographers, and said: “The people who will be most tormented on the Day of Resurrection will be the photographers.”

. The third aspect: God told Christ that he only did the sounding and blowing by His Almighty permission, and He told Christ, peace be upon him, that he did it God willing, and God informed that this is one of His blessings that He bestowed upon Christ, peace be upon him, as God Almighty said: He is nothing but a servant. We bestowed blessings upon him and made him an example to the Children of Israel. And the Almighty said:

{O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessing upon you and upon your mother, when I supported you with the Holy Spirit to speak to people in your cradle and at old age, and when I taught you The Book and the wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel. And when you created out of clay the shape of a bird by My permission, then you breathed into it and it became a bird by My permission. And you healed the blind and the leper by my permission, and when you brought out the dead by my permission, and when I restrained the children of Israel from you when you came to them With clear evidence} [Al-Maeda: 110].

All of this is clear in that he is not God, but rather he is the servant of God. He did that by God’s permission, as others did like that. The Prophets, and it is clear that the caller is not the one authorized, the teacher is not the teacher, and the one bestowed upon him and his mother is not him. Nor is he his mother.
The fourth aspect: They said: By the Creator he referred to the word of God united in humanity, then they said regarding his statement:

With the permission of God, that is, with the permission of the Word that is united in humanity, and this explains their contradiction and slander against the Qur’an, because God has informed about The Qur’an states that Christ was created from clay in the form of a bird, by God’s permission, so it distinguished between Christ and God, and made it clear that God is the authorizer of Christ. These people claimed that what he meant by that was that the divinity united with the humanity of Christ is the Creator and He is the ear, so they made the Creator the ear, and He is An interpretation of the Qur’an in a way that contradicts the explicit meaning of the Qur’an.

The fifth aspect: If divinity is the Creator, it does not need to give itself permission, for they say: He is one God. He is the Creator, so how does He need to give Himself permission and bestow blessings upon Himself?

The sixth aspect: The Creator is either the essence described by speech, or the speech that is a description of the essence. If He is Speech, for speech is an attribute that would not be a creative entity existing on its own, even if it were not united with humanity, and its union with humanity is without what is described. It is impossible. If the union were possible, how come it is impossible?
It has become clear that the word cannot be a creator in any sense.

And if the Creator is the entity characterized by speech, then that is God, the Creator of all things, Lord of the worlds, and to them He is the Father, and Christ For them, he is not the Father, so he is not the creator of everything, and the Qur’an makes clear that God is the one who permitted Christ to create from clay Like the appearance of a bird, so it became clear that the one who created the appearance of a bird from clay is not God nor is one of His attributes, so the Messiah is not God nor the son of ancient God is eternal, but His servant did it by His permission.

The seventh aspect: Their saying: By the Creator he referred to the word of God united in humanity taken from Mary, because that is what He said about From the tongue of David the Prophet: “By the word of God the heavens and the earth were created.” It will be said to them: This text on the authority of David is a proof against you, just as the Torah, the Qur’an, and everything else that has been proven from the prophets is a proof against you. David, peace be upon him, said: “By the word of God the heavens and the earth were created.” He did not say: The Word of God is the creator, as you said that He referred to the Creator to the Word of God.

The difference between the Creator of the heavens and the earth and the Word by which the heavens and the earth were created is a clear and well-known matter, like the difference between the All-Powerful. And ability, for the All-Powerful is the Creator and He created things by His ability, and ability is not the creator. This is also the difference between the one who wants And will, because God created things by His will, and it is not His will that is the creator.

Likewise, supplication and worship are for the Creator God and not for any of His attributes. All people say: O God, O our Lord, O our Creator. Have mercy on us and forgive us, and let no one say: O Word of God, forgive us and have mercy on us, nor, O Power of God, O Will of God, O Knowledge of God, forgive. For us and have mercy on us, and God Almighty creates by His power, will, and words, and it is not His attributes that create.

The eighth aspect: The saying of David, peace be upon him: “By the word of God the heavens and the earth were created” agrees with what is stated in the Qur’an, the Torah, and elsewhere. This is from the writings of the prophets: that God says to a thing: “Be” and it is, and this is in the Qur’an in more than one place, and in the Torah God said: “Let it be.” Thus, let it be thus.” The ninth aspect: Their saying:

Because there is no creator except God and His Word and His Spirit, if by His word they mean His speech, and by His Spirit His life, then this is one of God’s attributes, like His knowledge. And His power, none of the prophets expressed the life of God as the Spirit of God, so whoever interpreted the words of one of the prophets in terms of the Spirit What is meant by it is the life of God, for he was lied to. Then it is said: These words and his life are among the attributes of God, like His knowledge and power. Then the Creator is God alone, and His attributes are included in Its name does not need to be made
The word "association" is attached to his name, which indicates that God has a partner in His creation, for God has no partner.
For this reason, when God Almighty said:

“God is the Creator of all things.” Everything other than Him is included in His creations, and His attributes such as His knowledge, power, will, and speech are not included, because these Included in the name of His name are not things that are distinct from Him, but rather His beautiful names are related to His holy essence, which is characterized by these attributes, not It is permissible to mean by His names an entity devoid of perfect attributes, for that has no reality, and the existence of an entity devoid of attributes is impossible. In addition to the existence of Himself, the Most High, devoid of the attributes of His perfection that are necessary for Himself, it is impossible for Himself to be realized without them, and for this reason there is no It is said:
God and His knowledge created, and God and His power created.

And if by his word and spirit they mean Christ or something that is united with the humanity of Christ, then Christ, peace be upon him, is all a created being like all the other messengers, and God He alone is the Creator, and if you wish, you can say: If by the spirit and the word I mean what is an attribute of God, then that is included in the designation of His name, and if I want What is not an attribute is something created for it, like humanity.
The tenth aspect: It is not permissible for David, peace be upon him, to mean the Messiah by the word of God. Because for all people Christ is a name for humanity.

To them, it is a name for divinity and humanity when they united, and union is a verb that occurred with them. Before the union, there was neither humanity nor anything. He is called the Messiah, so it is known that David did not want the Messiah by the word of God, but their goal was to say: He wanted the word that was united later. In Christ, but the one who was created by God’s permission is the Messiah, as the Qur’an speaks of him, saying: {He gives you good tidings of a word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Maryam is an honorable person in this world and the hereafter, and among those brought near.” [Al-Imran: 45]

The Word that he mentioned, which created the heavens and the earth, is not Christ, who was created from clay in the form of a bird, God willing. Their argument against this is false. Rather, that word by which the heavens and the earth were created. There was no humanity with it when It was created by agreement of the nations, and humanity must enter into Christ, so it is known that he did not mean Christ with the word.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the correct meaning of the Holy Qur’an likening Jesus to Adam and their interpretation of that
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the correct meaning of the Noble Qur’an likening Jesus to Adam and refuting their interpretation of that]
They said: He also said in another place: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust} [Al Imran: 59]
So what he meant by his saying: {like Jesus} [Al Imran: 59] is a reference to humanity taken from the pure Mary, because he did not mention the name here. Christ, he only mentioned Jesus.

Just as Adam was created without intercourse or intercourse, so the body of the Lord Christ was created without intercourse or intercourse, and just as Adam’s body tasted Death, so the body of Christ tasted death, and he may prove it by saying also: God delivered his word to Mary, and that was according to We Christians said: The eternal, creative word of God dwelt in Mary and was incarnated as a perfect human being. In this example we say: In The Lord Christ has two natures: a theological nature: which is the nature of the Word of God and His Spirit, and a human nature:

Which was taken from the Virgin Mary and united with him, and when the saying from God Almighty came before him on the tongue of Moses the Prophet, when he said: (Is not this The Father who created you and blessed you and acquired you) It was said: And on the tongue of David the Prophet (Your Holy Spirit shall not be taken from me) and also on the tongue of David the Prophet: (By the word The heavens were strengthened against God, and all their power was strengthened by the Spirit of His mouth.) This saying does not refer to three creators, but rather to one Creator: the Father, and its pronunciation: i.e. His word and Spirit: that is, His life.

The answer is in a number of ways: One of them is that the Almighty said: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he is} [Al- Imran: 59]

True words, for God Almighty created this human type into the possible divisions. To demonstrate the generality of His power, He created Adam without male or female, and created his wife Eve from a male without female, as God Almighty said: {And He created From her to her husband} [An-Nisa: 1]

Christ was created from a female without a male, and He created the rest of creation from a male and a female, and the creation of Adam and Eve was more amazing than the creation of Christ. Eve was created from Adam’s rib, and this is more wondrous than the creation of Christ in Mary’s womb, and the creation of Adam is more wondrous than this and that, and it is the origin of The creation of Eve.

For this reason, God likened it to the creation of Adam, which is more wondrous than the creation of Christ, since God Almighty was able to create him from dust, and dust is not Of the same sex as the body of man. Could He not have created him from a woman who is of the same sex as the body of man? And He, Glory be to Him, created Adam from dust, then said to him: Be and he is, when He breathed into him of His Spirit. Likewise, Christ breathed into him of His Spirit and said For him:

It was and it is, and Adam was not divinity and humanity through what was breathed into his spirit, but rather he was all humanity, so Christ is also all humanity, and God is blessed. And God Almighty mentioned this verse among the verses that He sent down regarding the Christians, when the Christians of Najran were presented to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. They debated with him about the Messiah, and God revealed about him what He had revealed, and in him made clear the statement of truth about which the Jews and Christians differed, so God denied. The two sects: these in their extremism regarding him, and these in their slander of him.
He said after this verse:

{So whoever disputes with you concerning it after the knowledge that has come to you, say, “Come, let us call our sons and your sons and our women and your women and our selves.” And yourselves, then we will pray and place the curse of God upon the liars - Indeed, this is the true story, and there is no god but God, and indeed God is the One. The Mighty, the Wise - But if they turn away, then surely God is All-Knowing of the corruptors - Say, “O People of the Book, come to a common word between us and you.” We worship none but Allah, and we do not associate anything with Him, and we do not take others as lords other than Allah. But if they turn away, then say, “Bear witness that we are Muslims.” [Al-Bukhari and Muslim] Imran:

. The Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, complied with God’s word and called them to the test, and they knew that if they were to perform it, God would send down His curse upon them. They agreed to pay the jizyah while they were still young. Then the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, wrote to Heraclius, king of the Romans, with the Almighty saying: {Say, O people The Book, Come} [Al Imran: 64] and its end.

Sometimes he would recite it in the second rak’ah of the two dawn rak’ahs, and he would recite it in the first: “Say, ‘We believe in God and in what has been revealed. to us and what was revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord - we make no distinction. between any of them, and to him We submit.” [Al-Baqarah: 136]

All of this makes it clear that Christ is a servant who is not a god, and that he was created just as Adam was created. He was commanded to make anyone who said that he is a god be considered as impious. Each one of the supplicants calls upon his sons, his wives, and his relative, and then the one and the other supplicate and pray to God to make His curse is upon liars. If the Christians were liars in their saying: He is God, then the curse is due upon them, even if the one who said: He is not God, but Abdullah, a liar, has been cursed, and this is fairness on the part of a person with certainty who knows that he is in the truth.

And the Christians, when they did not know that they were following the truth, shied away from deception, and He said after that: “Indeed, these are the true stories, and there is no There is no god but Allah, and indeed Allah is the Mighty, the Wise} [Al Imran: 62]

In denial of the Christians who say: He is a true God from a true God, so how can it be said that he intended that Christ contains divinity and humanity, and that this Is it humanity only, not divinity? And in this way the answer to their saying appeared. He said in another place: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like the likeness of Adam} [Al Imran: 59]

What he meant by his saying: Jesus, was a reference to humanity taken from the pure Mary, because he did not mention the name of Christ here, but rather He mentioned Jesus only, for it is said: Jesus is the Messiah, as evidenced by the fact that he said: {The Messiah, son of Mary, is no more than a messenger; messengers have passed away before him} [Al-Ma’idah: 75]

So he informed that the Messiah is nothing but a messenger, that he is not a god, and that he is the son of Mary, and he who is the son of Mary is humanity, and he said: {But The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, is the Messenger of God, and his word which he bestowed on Mary, and a spirit from him. So believe in God and His messengers, and do not say, “Three, they will end well.” For you, God is only one God, Glory be to Him, that He has a son. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And God is sufficient as a disposer of affairs - He will not deny The Messiah is not a servant of God, nor are the angels who are close to Him, and whoever refrains from worshiping Him and is arrogant - He will gather them all to Himself} [Women:

And God Almighty said: {And the Christians said, “The Messiah is the Son of God.” That is their speech with their mouths, imitating the speech of those who disbelieved before. God will kill them. How will they be saved?} [At-Tawbah: 30]

And God Almighty said: {Those who say, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have certainly disbelieved.” Say, “Then who can have power over anything with God if He wishes to destroy the Messiah, the son of Mary?” Mary and his mother and all who are on the earth} [Al-Ma’idah: 17].

The second aspect: What they mentioned of his death has shown that God did not mention that, and that Christ had not died yet, and what they mentioned of That His humanity was crucified instead of His divinity is false on two counts: His humanity was not crucified, and there is no divinity in it, and they mentioned that as an abstract claim. In response to it, it is sufficient to prevent it.

But we say in the third aspect: In the union of divinity and humanity, they sometimes liken it to the union of water and milk, and this is an analogy. Al-Yaqubiyyah, and sometimes by the union of fire with iron or the soul with the body, and this is similar to the Malakiya and others.

It is known that nothing reaches water unless it reaches milk, for it does not distinguish one from the other, and so does the fire that is in iron. Whenever iron is struck or spat on, the fire that is in it is attached to it, and if the body is struck and tortured, the pain of the beating and torture is attached to the soul. It is as if the truth of their representation necessitates that divinity has been befallen by what befell humanity in terms of the Jews’ insult, torture, and pain. And the solidity that they claimed, and this is necessary for the statement of union, for if union were to befall one of them and the other would not share it in it, it would not have occurred. Here there is unity, not pluralism.

Fourth: That it was not enough for these misguided people to make the God of the heavens and the earth united with a human being inside a woman, and to make it his dwelling place. Then they made the most infidel of God’s creation, they captured him, they spat in his face, they put thorns on his head, and they crucified him between two thieves, and in that he was crying out for help. By God, and he says: “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” And they say: The one whose words the people heard is theology, just as Moses heard the words of God from The tree, and they say: They are one person, and some of them say: They have one will and one nature.

Speech only occurs according to the will of the speaker, so it is necessary that the speaker calling for help, the crucified one, is divinity and he is the one seeking help. The supplicant, and He is the one to whom help is sought. Also, they say: Divinity and humanity are one person, while saying that they are one person, either To be seeking help, or to be sought for help, or to be a caller, or to be invited, then if they say: The caller is not The inviter must be two, not one, and if they say: They are one, then the inviter is the one invited.

The fifth aspect: It is said: It is not without either saying: The divinity was able to repel them from His humanity, or they could say: He did not He is capable. If they say, “He is not capable,” then it follows that those Jews are more powerful than the Lord of the worlds.

And for the Lord of the worlds to be subjugated and held captive with a people of the worst of the Jews, and this is among the greatest disbelief and denigration of the Lord of the worlds, and this Greater than their saying: God has a son, and that he is stingy, and that he is poor, and other such things that the disbelievers curse the Lord of the worlds.
