And if they say: He is Able, then if that is due to the aggression of the infidels against his humanity and he hates that, then the Sunnah of God is victory in such a case. His messengers who were crying out for Him, so how could His humanity not help the one who was crying out for Him? This is in contrast to whoever of the prophets was killed while he was patient, for those They were patient until they were killed as martyrs, and the people among them cried out for help and said:

“My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” And if he had done it deceitfully, as they claim that he deceived Satan and hid himself until He takes him with a just face, for his humanity is more knowledgeable of that than all of creation, so it was necessary for him not to panic or run away because of what is in that. Wisdom, and they mention that mankind’s panic, flight, and supplications indicate that everything that happened to him was without his choice, and he says Some of them: Their will is one, so how did he want that and escape from what humanity hates?
Rather, if divinity had willed what He hates, they would have differed, and they had agreed to deceive the enemy, and humanity would not have panicked, as happened to Joseph with

When his brother agreed that he would carry the coins on his journey and show that he was a thief, his brother was not alarmed when the coins appeared on his journey, just as His brothers were terrified as they did not know it, and many of the foolish people are captured and crucified while they are steadfast and patient, so why is this terrified? The great anxiety with which they describe Christ, and it entails the goal of great deficiency, along with their claim to God in Him.
The sixth aspect: Their saying that He is His Word and His Spirit is a contradiction on their part, because according to them, I am only the hypostasis of the Word, not the hypostasis of life.

The seventh aspect: Their saying: He proved it by saying: We also saw in another place saying: God delivered His word to Mary, and that According to what we Christians say: The eternal, creative word of God dwelt in Mary and was united with a perfect human being.

It will be said to them: As for what God says in the Qur’an, it is the truth, but you have gone astray in interpreting it just as you have gone astray in interpreting other words. The prophets, and what they conveyed from God,

This is because God Almighty said: {When the angels said, “O Mary, indeed God gives you good news of a word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, eminent in This world and the hereafter and among those who are close - and he speaks to people in the cradle and in old age and among the righteous - she said, “My Lord, how can I have a child when no human being has touched me?” He said Likewise, God creates whatever He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Al Imran: 45-47]

There are aspects in this speech that show that he is a created being and it is not what the Christians say: among them is that he said: (with a word from him) and his saying A word from him is insignificant in the proof that it is a word from the words of God, it is not all of His words as the Christians say.

Among them: that he clarifies what he means by saying: with a word from him, and that he is a created being, as he said: {Thus God creates what He wills when He decrees He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Al Imran: 47]
As he said in the other verse: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he is.} [Al Imran: 59]

And God Almighty said in Surat Kahi’as: {That is Jesus, son of Mary. The word of truth about which they dispute - It is not for God to take from a son. Glory be to Him when He decrees a matter. He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Maryam: 34-35]
These are three verses in the Qur’an that show that He said to it: (Be and it is) and this is the explanation for it being a word from Him.

And he said, “His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary.” He told that he is the son of Mary, and he was told that he is distinguished in this world and the hereafter, and that he is among the close ones. All of this is an attribute of a created being, and by God Almighty and His words, which are His attribute, nothing of that can be said about it. And Mary said: How can I have a son? So he explained that the Messiah, who is the Word, is the son of Mary, not the son of God, Glory be to Him, the Most High, and He said in Surat An-Nisa:

{O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion, and do not say about God except the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is the Messenger of God, and His word which He delivered to Mary and a spirit from him. Believe in God and His messengers, and do not say: “Desist is better for you.” Indeed, God is one God. Glory be to Him, to have a son from Him. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and God suffices as a disposer of affairs. The Messiah will not refrain from being a servant of God, nor will the angels who are close to Him and others. If he refrains from worshiping Him and becomes arrogant, then He will gather them all to Himself - but as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full. And He will increase them of His bounty. But as for those who disdain and were arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will find for themselves, besides Allah, no guardian or helper.} [Women:

He forbade the Christians from exaggeration in their religion, and from saying something about God that is not the truth, and made clear that the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, was the Messenger of God and His Word. He gave it to Mary and a spirit from Him, and commanded them to believe in God and His Messengers. He explained that he was His Messenger, and forbade them from saying three things, and said: {End yourselves, and it will be better for you} [An-Nisa: 171], {God is but one God} [An-Nisa: 171], and this is a denial of their saying about Christ that he is a true God from another God. True, from the essence of his father. Then he said: {Glory be to Him that He should have a son} [An-Nisa’:

171], So he exalted himself and glorified it by having a son as the Christians say, then he said: {To him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth} [An-Nisa: 171] So he informed that it belonged to him, and that there was nothing of himself in it, then he said: {The Messiah will not refrain from being a servant of God, nor will the angels. Those who are brought near} [An-Nisa: 172] meaning: They will not refrain from being servants of God, Blessed and Most High. With this clear and evident statement, does one think? Thinking that what he means by his words (and his word) is that he is a Creator God? Or is it an attribute of God that is inherent in him? And His saying: {And a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa’:
171] What is meant by this is that he is his life, or is his soul separated from himself?

Then we also say: As for His saying (and His word), He has made clear what He meant by that He created him with the word “Kun” and in the language of the Arabs in which the Qur’an was revealed, it is called The object is in the noun of the infinitive, so the creature is called a creation because of His saying: This is God’s creation, and it is said: a dirham minted by the prince, meaning: the prince’s multiplied, For this reason, the commanded is called a command, the decreed is called power and decree, the known is knowledge, and the one who is shown mercy is called, as God Almighty says: {And there was a command. God is decreed and destined} [Al-Ahzab: 38]
And His saying: “The command of God has come, so do not hasten it” [An-Nahl: 1]

The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “God says to Heaven: You are My mercy. My punishment, I punish through you whomever I wish of My servants.” And he said: “Indeed, God created mercy on the day He created it as a hundred mercies, of which He sent down one mercy. With Him are ninety-nine mercies, so when on the Day of Resurrection He will add these to those, and have mercy on creation with them.” And rain is said: “This.” Great power, and it is said:
May God forgive you for His knowledge of you, that is, His knowledge, so naming a creature with one word for another comes from this point.

Imam Ahmad mentioned in the book (The Response to the Jahmiya) and others mentioned that the Christians of the solution and the obstructing Jahmiya opposed On the Sunnis, the Christians said: The Qur’an is the word of God, not created, and Christ is the word of God, so he is not created, and the Jahmiya said: The Messiah The word of God and He is a created being, and the Qur’an is the word of God and He is a created being.

Ahmed and others answered: Christ himself is not words, for Christ is a human being born of a woman, and the words of God are not By man, nor by human being, nor born of woman, but Christ was created by speech, and as for the Qur’an itself, it is the word of God, so where does this compare? This?

It has been said: Most wise people disagree with regard to the common names, and no rational person would hear what God Almighty said about Christ, peace be upon him. It is His word that He delivered to Mary. However, it should be known that what is meant is not that Christ himself is the word of God, nor that he is an attribute of God or a Creator.

Then it is said to the Christians: If it is assumed that the Messiah is the same as speech, then speech is not a creator, for the Qur’an is the speech of God and he is not a creator, and the Torah is speech. God is not a creator, and the words of God are many and none of them are creative. If Christ had the same words, it would not have been possible for him to be a creator, so how? It is not speech, rather it was created by the word, and it was specifically named for the word, for it was not created in the usual way in which others were created, but rather He went out of the norm and was created by the Word, other than the tradition known among mankind.

And His saying: (with a spirit from Him) does not necessarily mean that it is separate from the essence of God, as the Almighty says: {And He has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and that is on the earth. From Him} [Al-Jathiya: 13]
And the Almighty says: {And whatever blessing you have is from Allah} [An-Nahl: 53]
And the Almighty said: {Whatever good befalls you is from Allah, and whatever evil befalls you is from your own soul} [An-Nisa: 79]

. {The disbelievers from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not to dissenter until clear proof came to them - a messenger from God reciting purified scriptures - in which Valuable books} [Al-Baynah: 1-3]
All these things are from God and were created, and more eloquent than that was the Spirit of God which He sent to Mary, and she was created.

So Christ, who is one of that spirit, is more deserving of being a created being. God Almighty said: {Then We sent to it Our Spirit, and He appeared to it as a normal human being - She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you, if you are pious.” He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.” [Maryam: 17-19]
The Almighty said: {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit} [Al-Tahrim: 12].
And he said: {And she who has maintained her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to the worlds} [Al-Anbiya’: 91].

So He told that He breathed His Spirit into Mary, just as He told that He breathed His Spirit into Adam, and He made clear that He sent His Spirit to her {So he imitated She has good tidings. She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you if you are pious.” He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.” She said, “How?” I will have a boy, and no human being has touched me, nor have I been a transgressor - He said, 'Thus said your Lord, 'It is easy for me, and We will certainly make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us.' And it was A decreed matter} [Maryam:

17 - 21] So she carried him, and this is the spirit that God sent to her to give her a pure, created boy, and he is the Holy Spirit from whom Christ was created and from whom Mary, if the original was a created thing, then how was the branch that came from it, which is the Holy Spirit? And his saying about the Messiah: (and a spirit from him) specifically mentioned that to the Messiah because he breathed the spirit into his mother, and she conceived him from that breath, and that is not the case. His spirit, which he shares with all other human beings, was distinguished in that it was conceived by the breath of the spirit, and for this reason it was called a spirit.

For this reason, a group of interpreters said: a spirit from Him, meaning a messenger from Him. The Messenger who breathed into it called it by the name of the spirit. Just as a word is called a “spirit.” Because he was made by the Word, not as humans create others, and he is called “spirit,” because his mother conceived him by the breath of the Spirit that was breathed into her. She is conceived by a male like other human beings. Based on this, it is said: When He was created from the breath of the spirit and from Mary, He was called “spirit” in contrast to all other Human beings are created from a male and a female, then the spirit is breathed into them after four months have passed.

The Christians say in their trustworthiness: (He was incarnated by Mary and by the Holy Spirit), even if they limited themselves to this, and interpreted the Holy Spirit as the angel who breathed In it, and He is the Spirit of God, this would have been in agreement with what God told him, but they made the Holy Spirit the life of God and made him Lord, and they contradicted in That is because, based on this, two hypostases were supposed to exist in it: the hypostasis of the Word, and the hypostasis of the Spirit, and they say: There is only one hypostasis in it. The Word, and just as Christ is called the Word because he was created by the Word, he is called “Spirit” because the Spirit descended upon him.
If it is said: Then it has been said in the Qur’an: {And those to whom We have given the Book know that it has been sent down from your Lord} [Al-An’am: 114]
And he said: {The revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise} [Az-Zumar: 1].

The imams of Muslims and the masses have said: “The Qur’an is the word of God, not created from Him.” And He said about Christ: “And a spirit from Him” [An-Nisa: 171] It was said: This is in the same position as the rest of the words added to God if it is an entity existing by itself or an attribute in it that is created, even if it is an attribute added to God, such as His knowledge and His speech, and so on, was the addition of an attribute, and the same applies to what comes from it if it is a substantive entity or an adjective that subsists with something else, as in The heavens and the earth and the blessings, and the Spirit that He sent to Mary, and said: “I am only the messenger of your Lord” [Mary:

19] “He was a created being, and if it is an attribute that does not exist by itself and is not characterized by a created being, like the Qur’an, then it is not a created being, then that is the case.” By God, and whatever is established by God cannot be a created being. What is meant here is to show the invalidity of the Christians’ argument and that they have no apparent The Qur’an, nor what is hidden within it, is a proof for all the Books of God. Rather, they stuck to similar verses and abandoned the decisive ones, as God told about them. By saying:

{It is He who has sent down to you the Book; among it are verses that are decisive, they are the foundation of the Book, and others are allegorical. As for those in whose hearts is deviation, they follow what Some of it is similar, seeking to confuse it and seeking to give it an interpretation.} [Al Imran: 7]

And the verse was revealed about the Christians, so they are definitely what was meant by the verse. Then he said: {And no one knows its interpretation except Allah and those who are firmly rooted in knowledge. They say, “We believe in it. It is all from our Lord” [Al Imran: 7].

There are two opinions and two readings in it, some of them stop at his saying: (except Allah), and say: Those who are firmly rooted in knowledge do not know its interpretation. What is similar, no one knows except God.

And among them are those who do not stop, but rather connect with that the Almighty’s saying: {And those who are firmly rooted in knowledge say, “We believe in it. It is all from our Lord” [Al Imran: 7]. And he says: Those who are well-established in knowledge know the interpretation of the similar, and both of these sayings are transmitted from a group of the Salaf, and these people say: It may be The case of the one who is kind to someone is not the one who is being treated with kindness, as in the Almighty’s saying: “And those who came after them say, ‘Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers.’” i.e. They say, and both of these statements are true, as the term interpretation means interpretation and knowing its meanings.

And those who are well-grounded in knowledge know the interpretation of the Qur’an. Al-Hasan Al-Basri said: God has not sent down a verse except that He loves to know what it was revealed about. What did he mean by it?
Interpretation may mean what God chose to know, such as the manner of what He informed about Himself and about the Last Day, and the time of the Hour. And the descent of Jesus, and so on,

This interpretation is known only to God, and as for the word interpretation, if it is intended to divert the word from its apparent meaning to something contrary to that, there is evidence It is associated with it, and the predecessors did not mean by this word interpretation, nor is it the meaning of interpretation in the Book of God Almighty, but a group of the later They singled out the word “interpretation” for this. Rather, the word “interpretation” in the Book of God means what the speech refers to, even if its apparent meaning agrees, as His saying God Almighty: {Will they wait only for its interpretation? On the Day when its interpretation comes, those who forgot it before will say.} [Al-A’raf: 53].
And from it is the interpretation of the vision, as Joseph Al-Siddiq said: {This is the interpretation of my visions before} [Yusuf: 100]
And as He said: “Unless I inform you of its interpretation” [Yusuf: 37].
And His saying: “That is better and has a better interpretation” [An-Nisa’: 59]
This is explained elsewhere.

What is meant here is that the Christians have no proof, neither on the surface of the texts, nor on their interior, as God Almighty said: {The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, is only The Messenger of God and His Word which He delivered to Mary and a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa: 171]

To them, the word is an essence, and it is a Lord, and the Creator does not create it, but rather it is the Creator of everything, as they said in their book: (Indeed The word of God, the Creator, the eternal, dwelt in Maryam), and God Almighty has informed that He, Glory be to Him, bestowed it on Maryam, and the Lord, Glory be to Him, is The Creator, and the word that He delivered is not a creator, since the Creator does not cast anything into Him, rather He casts something else, and the words of God are of two types: universal, And religious.
Universality is like saying to a thing: Be and it is.

Religious: His command and law that the messengers brought, and likewise His command, will, permission, sending, and mission are divided into these two. The two parts, and God Almighty has mentioned saying something other than this, and God Almighty has said: {And do not say to him who extends his greetings to you, “You are not a believer.”} [An-Nisa: 94]

And God Almighty said: {And when those who associate them see their partners, they say, “Our Lord, these are our partners whom we used to call upon besides you, so to them Saying, “Indeed, you are liars.” - And offer peace to Allah that Day.} [An-Nahl: 86-87]
And the Almighty said: {O you who have believed, do not take my enemy or your enemy as guardians, enveloping them with affection} [Al-Mumtahina: 1]

As for I taught him the words and taught him and he received them, that is if you wanted to memorize them unlike when you delivered them to him, for this is what he says. With regard to what he addresses him with, even if he does not remember it, it is like someone to whom you delivered a statement other than the statement that you are liars, and greeted them with greetings, and not Here, except for a speech they heard, the same characteristic of the speaker did not occur in the addressee. Likewise, Mary did when God delivered His word to her, which was the saying:

“Kun” did not necessarily mean that the same attribute that used it occurred in Maryam, just as it did not necessarily mean that the attribute that applied to it occurred in all of the other people. He delivered his words to him, just as the quality of every speaker does not occur in the one to whom his words are delivered.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the confusion and division of Christians’ speech in the chapter on the nature of Christ
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the confusion of the Christians’ speech and their division regarding the nature of Christ]
As for their saying: In this example, we say: There are two natures in the Lord Christ: a theological nature: which is the nature of the Word of God and His Spirit.
And a human nature: which was taken from the Virgin Mary and united with him.

It will be said to them: The speech of the Christians on this subject is confused, differing and contradictory, and they have no agreed upon statement on this matter, nor a reasonable statement, nor A statement that is indicated by a book. Rather, they contain sects and sects, each sect denouncing the others, such as the Jacobites, the Melkites, and the Nestorians, and we quote The statements about them on this matter are confused and differ a lot.
That is why it is said:

If ten Christians had gathered, they would have divided into eleven opinions, and that is what they believe in regarding the Trinity and the unity, as It is mentioned in their faithfulness. It was not spoken of in any of the books of the prophets, and it is not found in the words of Christ, nor of the apostles, nor of any of The prophets, but they have in the books similar words and precise words that they dispute over their understanding, then those of them who say truthfulness They are the general Christians of today, from the Melkite, Nestorian, and Jacobite groups. They differ in their interpretation, and their statement is contradictory. It is impossible to imagine it in the correct way.

For this reason, each of them began to say what he thought was closer than others. Some of them were careful to express their trustworthiness, even if they declared the disbelief that Its corruption is apparent to everyone, such as Jacobism, and some of them conceal some of it, such as Nestorianism, and many of them are the illusion of monarchy among These and those, and when they invented what they invented of the Trinity and solutions, there were those among them who disagreed with them in that.

There may be a difference in people’s quotation of their articles, and that depends on the opinion of the sect whose opinion that transmitter is quoting, and the opinion whose opinion It is narrated by many Muslim theorists, and there are many of them who disagree with it, as they quoted from them what Abu Al-Ma’ali and his companion Abu Al-Qasim Al-Ansari and others: that the Ancient One is one in essence, three are called hypostases, and by “hypostasis” they mean existence. And life and science.

They quoted from them: that life and knowledge are not additional and existing descriptions of the essence, but rather they are psychological attributes of the essence. They said: If their doctrine were represented by an example, it would be said: The hypostases, according to them, are in the same position as psychological conditions and attributes when they establish them from Muslims, because the blackness of a color and its chromaticity are two psychological characteristics of appearance. He said:

Perhaps they express the hypostases by the Father and the Holy Spirit, so by the Father they mean existence, and by the Son Christ and the Word, and perhaps they called Knowledge is a word, and the word is knowledge, and they express life through the spirit. He said: And by the word they do not mean speech, for to them speech is one of the attributes Action, and they do not call knowledge before it is armored by Christ and united with him as a son, but rather Christ is with them what is armored by a son. They said:

Among their doctrines is that the Word was united with Christ and shielded with humanity. Then they disagreed about the meaning of the union, and some of them interpreted it. By mixing and blending, and this is the doctrine of sects of the Jacobites, Nestorians, and Melkites. They said: The word is mixed with a body. Christ and mixing it just as wine is mixed with water or milk. They said: This is the doctrine of the Romans and most of them are kings. They said: So it was mixed The Word became the flesh of Christ and became one thing, and the many became few.

A group of Jacobites held that the word turned into flesh and blood, and they said: It became a fragment of every kind until what was meant Through unity, divinity appears over humanity, like the appearance of an image in a mirror and an inscription on a signet.

Among them are those who said: The emergence of divinity over humanity is like God’s standing on the throne among Muslims, and many of these sects went to What is meant by unity is solutions. They said: They also disagreed regarding essence and hypostases, so the Jacobites and Nestorians held that essence is nothing other than hypostases.
It is not said: He is She. Melkism declared that He is other than the Hypostases, and others said: He is the Hypostases.

They said: On the other hand, the Christians divided, so the Romans decided to declare that there were three gods, while the Jacobites and Nestorians abstained. From that in one aspect, and they adhered to it in another aspect, and that is because they said: The Word is God, the Spirit is God, the Father is God, and the Three Persons Of which every hypostasis is a god, one god.
They said: A group of Christians held that Jesus was a son of God in terms of dignity. Just as God took Abraham as a friend, likewise Jesus had a son.

They said: These people are called: Arianism. This is the narration of a group of Muslim theorists, and this is the saying of the Christians who said it, and there is something in it that contradicts their clear trustworthiness and what Their audience was against him, such as when he said:

They do not call knowledge before it was armored by Christ as a son, but rather Christ with what was armored by it as a son. This is contrary to what the Christian sects are upon. From Melkism, Jacobism, and Nestorianism, and contrary to what was included in their faithfulness, when they declared that the Word is an ancient and eternal Son. Born before the ages, and this is a characteristic of divinity among them, and it contains things that some Christians say, not all of them, and likewise their narration According to them, they do not mean speech by word, for to them speech is an attribute of action, and this is the view of a group of them and those who
The Jews, and many or most of them say: The word of God is not created, and they denounce those who say that it is created.

Another group of them, Abu Al-Hasan bin Al-Zaghuni, reported from them something that agrees with this in one way or another, and they said: The groups agreed The Christians said that God is not a body, and they agreed that He is one entity with three persons, and that each one of the persons is a special essence. They are united by the general essence, then they differed, and some of them said: The hypostases differ in hypostasis, but agree in essence.

Others said: They are not different in hypostasis, but rather heterogeneous, and a group of them said: Each one of them is neither the other, nor is other than it, and it is not different or different, and they claimed that the essence is not other than it, except what was mentioned by a group of angels, for they They said:

The hypostases are the essence other than the hypostases, and they claimed that the essence is the Father, and the hypostases are life, which is the Holy Spirit, and power, And knowledge, and that God united with one of the hypostases, who is the Son, with Jesus, the son of Mary, and he was a Christ at the time of the union, in terms of his divinity and his humanity. He was conceived, born, raised, killed, crucified, and buried.
They also differed, and Nestorianism said: Christ is two essences, two hypostases, ancient and new, and that his union is only by will, and that Their will is one, even if they are two substances.
Al-Yaqubiyyah said: When they united, the two substances, the old essence and the new essence, became one essence.
They differed here, and some of them said: The new essence became ancient, and others claimed that when they united, they became one ancient essence. One face is updated from another face.

Melkism said: Christ is two essences, one hypostasis. It was said about some of them that he is two persons of one essence, and Arianism said: God is not a body and has no hypostases, and that Christ did not He will be crucified and not killed, and that he is a prophet, and it was reported from some of them that he said: Christ is not the Son of God, and it was reported from some of them that he is the Son of God On naming and approximation.

They disagreed about the word delivered to Mary, and a group of them said: The word was mixed in Mary, just as water is in water. Milk mixes it and mixes it. A group of them said: It appeared in Maryam without mixing, just as the human person appears in the mirror and in the polished bodies of Unmixed.
A group of Christians claimed that humanity with divinity is like a seal with wax. It is affected by engraving, then nothing remains of it except His effect.

Abu Al-Hasan bin Al-Zaghuni and those with him said: The Christians disagreed regarding the hypostases, and some of them said: They are jewels, and some said: They are Properties, and some people said they are attributes, and some people said they are persons, and for them the Father is the unifying essence of the hypostases, and the Son is the Word Which was united at the beginning of Christ, and the spirit is life, and they agreed that the union is an attribute of an action and not an attribute of an entity.

They said: And their opinion regarding the unity differed greatly. Some of them claimed that the union was that the word that is the Son became lawful. Christ was incarnated, and it was said: This is what most of them say.

Some of them claimed that union is mixing and blending, and some of the Jacobites said: It is that the word of God has been reversed. Flesh and blood through mixing, and many Jacobites and Nestorians said: Union is that the word and humanity are mixed and mingled. Such as mixing water with wine and mixing them together, and likewise wine with milk.
Some of them said: The union is that the Word and humanity united and became one temple.

Some of them said: The union is like the appearance of a human being’s image in a mirror, and the appearance of a stamp in a printed matter, like a seal in wax, and he said Some of them: The Word was united with the body of Christ in the sense that it inhabited it without contact or mixing, as we say: God is in heaven above The Throne without contact or mixing, and as we say: The mind is a substance that resides within the soul without mixing with the soul or touching it. Melkism said: The union means that the two became one and the many became the few.

This is what Abu al-Hasan al-Zaghuni narrated from them, and this is what Judge Abu Bakr bin al-Tayyib and Judge Abu Ya`la reported from them. And others, and Abu Muhammad bin Hazm said: The Christians are a group of them who are companions of Arius, and he was a priest in Alexandria, and from his saying: Abstract monotheism and that Jesus is a created servant, and that he is the word of God by which he created the heavens and the earth, and he was in the time of “Constantine” The first one built Constantinople and the first of the Roman kings to convert to Christianity, and he followed this doctrine of Arius.

He said: Among them are the companions of Paul Al-Shamshatti, and he was a patriarch in Antioch before the emergence of Christianity, and his statement was about monotheism. The abstract and correct, and that Jesus is the servant of God and His Messenger, like one of the prophets, peace be upon them, God created him in the womb of his mother Mary, without a male, And he is a man in whom there is no divinity at all, and he used to say: I do not know what the Word or the Holy Spirit is. He said:

Among them were the companions of Macedonius. He was a patriarch in Constantinople after the emergence of Christianity in the days of Constantine ibn Constantine, the builder of Constantinople, and this king was an Arian like his father, and what Macedonius said was this abstract monotheism and that Jesus, peace be upon him, is a created servant, a human being, a prophet and a messenger like all the prophets, peace be upon them, and that Jesus is the Holy Spirit and the Word of God. And he went

Jerusalem and the Word are two created things. God created all of that. He said: And among them were barbarians, and they say: Jesus and his mother are two gods. Without God Almighty. He said: These sects have disappeared, and today they are baptized by three sects, the greatest of which is the royal sect, and this is the doctrine of all Christian kings. Where they were: Away from Abyssinia and Nubia, and it is the doctrine of the general population of the entire Christian kingdom. Away from Nubia and Abyssinia, which is the doctrine of all. The Christians of Africa, Sicily, Andalusia, and the Levant, and their saying that God Almighty is exalted by their saying three things:

Father, Son, and the Holy Spirit, all of them have not ceased, and that Jesus is a complete God and a complete human being, and neither of them is other than the other, and that man is from him. He is the one who was crucified and killed, and that God did not receive any of that from him, and that Mary gave birth to God and man, and that they are something together. One, Son of God, may God be exalted above their disbelief.

The Nestorians said the same thing equally, except that they said: Mary did not give birth to God, but rather she gave birth to man, and that God He did not give birth to man, but rather God Almighty gave birth to God out of their disbelief, and this sect prevailed over Mosul, Iraq and Persia. And Khorasan, and they are attributed to Nestorius, who was a patriarch in Constantinople.

Al-Yaqubiyyah said: The Messiah is God Himself, and that God Almighty, in spite of the greatness of their disbelief, died, was crucified, and was killed, and that the world He remained for three days without a mastermind, and the ark was without a mastermind, then he rose up and returned as he had been, and God Almighty returned as a newly created person, and the newly created person returned as ancient. And God Almighty was in Mary’s womb carrying him, and they were in the lands of Egypt and all of Nubia and all of Abyssinia, and the kings of the two nations. The two mentioned.

I said: The most knowledgeable of people about their articles is he who is one of their scholars, and the one who is most knowledgeable after having had experience with their books and articles, like Al-Hassan. Ibn Ayyub, who wrote a letter to his brother Ali Ibn Ayyub, in which he mentions the reason for his conversion to Islam and cites the evidence of the invalidity of the Christian religion. And the validity of the religion of Islam, he said in his letter to his brother when he wrote to him asking him about the reason for his conversion to Islam after he mentioned his engagement:

“Then I inform you, may God guide you, that the beginning of my matter was the doubt that entered me in what I was upon and the rejoicing in saying it from more than Twenty years ago, I was contemplating the corruption of the monotheism of God Almighty due to what was introduced into it, such as the statement of the Three Persons. And other things included in the Christian law, and the establishment of arguments that are neither pure nor proven in establishing that, and when I investigated it And I postponed thinking about it, because I had its faults, and I repulsed myself from accepting it, and when I thought about the religion of Islam that God had bestowed upon me, I found Its roots are firm, its branches are upright, and its laws are beautiful.

The origin of this is what no one of you who knows God Almighty and Majestic, whether among you or others, disagrees about, which is belief in God, the Living, the Ever-Subsisting, the Hearer. The One and Only Seeing One, the Holy King, the Generous and Just, the God of Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the tribes, and the God of Moses. And Jesus and the rest of the prophets and all of creation, who has no beginning or end, no opposite or equal, and did not take a companion or a child, who created All things, not from a thing or after an example, but as He willed and by saying to them:

“Be” and it was as He destined and willed, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Mighty, the Compassionate, the Merciful, to whom nothing is similar, and He is the One who conquers and cannot be defeated. And the horse is not stingy, he never misses what he wants, and nothing is hidden from him. {He knows the deceitful eyes and what the breasts conceal} [Ghafir: 19], and what enters. In the earth and what comes out of it and what descends from the sky and what ascends therein, and everything mentioned or imagined is from it, and all that is through Him, and all He has a law, then we believe that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. He sent him with guidance and the religion of truth. To make him prevail over all religion, even if he dislikes it.

The polytheists, and we believe in Moses and Jesus and the rest of the prophets, may blessings and peace be upon them. We do not differentiate between any of them, and we believe in the Torah. And the Gospel, the Psalms, the Qur’an, and all the other books that God Almighty revealed to His prophets, and that the Hour is coming about which there is no doubt, and that God will raise those who are in the graves, and that the righteous will be in bliss and the ungodly will be in hell. They will reach it on the Day of Judgment. That is for what you have earned. Their hands, and that God is not unjust to His servants.
He said:

I was carried away by the familiarity of my religion, the long period of time, the covenant with it, and the gathering with fathers, mothers, brothers, sisters, and relatives. And the brothers, neighbors, and people of friendship to procrastinate with the resolve, and to delay in concluding the matter, and with that he refuses to think carefully. insight and increase in insight, for I have not left any book of the prophets of the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, the books of the prophets, and the Qur’an except I looked at it and browsed through it, and there was not one of the Christian articles that I did not consider, but I did not find a defense for the truth, nor a place for doubt in it, nor any For the sake of patience and tarrying face, I left as a migrant to God Almighty with my soul, fleeing my religion from the blessings and people of a stable, a place, and honor. And I acted in an action, and I demonstrated what I demonstrated of sound intention, sincere conduct, and firm certainty. Praise be to God who has guided us to this. And we would not have been guided had God not guided us. Indeed, the messengers of our Lord have come with the truth.
We ask Him, the Almighty, not to deviate our hearts after He has guided us, and to grant us mercy from Himself. Indeed, He is the Granter.

He said: When I looked at the articles of the Christians, I found a group of them known as Arianism, who deny the monotheism of God and acknowledge the servitude of Christ. Peace be upon him, and they do not say about it anything that the Christians say about divinity, special sonship, or anything else, and they adhere to the Gospel of Christ. Acknowledging what his disciples brought with him and those who carried on his authority, this class was close to the truth, differing from some of it in denying the prophethood of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. May God bless him and grant him peace, and grant him what he brought of the Qur’an and Sunnah.

He said: Then I found a group of them known as the Jacobites, who say: Christ is one nature out of two natures: one of them is the nature of humanity. The other is the nature of divinity, and that these two natures were combined just as the soul was combined with the body, so they became one human being and one essence. And one person, and that this one nature and one person is Christ, who is wholly God and wholly man, and who is one person. One and one nature out of two natures.

And they said: Mary gave birth to God, exalted be God above what they say, and that God died, suffered, was crucified incarnate, was buried, rose from the dead, and ascended. To the heaven, so they came from the saying that if it had been shown to the heaven, it would have split, or to the earth, it would have split, or to the mountains, it would have sighed, but it was not There is a reason to argue with these people, since their disbelief in what they declared was too clear for any doubt to fall into it, and other Christians were like the Malikis. The Nestorians bear witness to this.
He said: Then I looked into the saying of the Melkites, who are the Romans, and they are the majority of the Christians, and I found them saying:

The eternal Son, who is God the Word, was incarnated from Mary in a complete incarnation like all the bodies of men, and in that body he composed a complete soul. With reason, knowledge, and knowledge, like the rest of people’s souls, and that he became a human being with a soul and body, which are of the essence of people, and a god. In the essence of divinity, like his father, he did not cease, and he is a human being, in the essence of humanity, like Abraham and David, and he is one person who did not increase. His number, and the essence of divinity was confirmed for him, just as the essence of humanity that he wore from Mary is still true for him, and he is one person, and no more. His number and two natures, and each of the two natures has a perfect will. He has in His divinity a will like the Father and the Spirit, and He has in His humanity A will like the will of Abraham and David.

They said: Mary gave birth to God, and that Christ, which is a name that combines divinity and humanity, died. They said: God did not die, and the One whom she gave birth to Mary died in the essence of his humanity (he is a perfect God in the essence of his divinity, and a perfect human being in the essence of his humanity, and he has the will of the divinity And the will of humanity, which is one person. We do not say two persons, lest we be forced to say four persons.

He said: These people brought about that the same as what the Jacobites brought about Mary giving birth to God. God is exalted above what the wrongdoers say, and they said: Indeed Christ, which is a name that the Christian community does not doubt, refers to divinity and humanity. He died, and that God did not die, so how could He be dead if He did not die? And standing and sitting in the same situation? Is there any difference between the two articles, except for what they differ in of nature?
He said: Then I looked into the words of the Nestorians and found that they said:

Christ is two persons and two natures with one will, and that the nature of Christ’s divinity is other than the nature of his humanity, and that the nature of Divinity, when it was united with humanity through its person, the Word, by which the two natures became in one direction and one will, and theology does not accept There is no increase or decrease, and it is not mixed with anything, and humanity accepts increase and decrease. Thus, Christ was both God and man, so he is God. With the essence of divinity that neither increases nor decreases, and He is a human being with the essence of humanity that is capable of increase and decrease.
They said: Mary gave birth to Christ in his humanity, and that divinity has never left him since she became united with his humanity.

And he said: We found that the Jacobites declared that Mary gave birth to God, exalted above what the false describe and the just say, and that He suffered. He was crucified and died, and after three days he rose from the dead. This is disbelief to which all the Christian sects and others bear witness against them, and we found The Melkites deviated from this statement to what is apparently less than it, and they said: Christ is one person and two natures, so each has one Of the two natures there is a will. In his divinity he has a will like the Father and the Spirit, and in his humanity he has a will like the will of Abraham and David.

They misled the one who was making their statement that, with this choice they invented, they had differentiated between divinity and humanity, and then they returned to saying The Jacobites, and they said: Mary gave birth to a God, and that Christ, which is a name that combines divinity and humanity, according to their group, they do not doubt that. He died in the flesh, and God did not die, and the one whom Mary gave birth to died in the essence of his humanity, so how can he be dead who has not died? Is there any difference between the two articles, except where they differ in nature?

And if they acknowledged that Mary gave birth to God, and that the one whom Mary gave birth to, who is Christ, is the unifying name for the two essences of divinity. And humanity has died, so did birth, death, and all the other actions that Christians say were done by Christ happen except to them?
How can it be right for a rational person to worship someone born of a human woman who has died and has been afflicted by illnesses and afflictions?

I said: What explains their contradiction is that they say: Christ, who is divinity and humanity, is one person and one hypostasis, according to their statement. They are two substances with two natures and two wills, so they confirm that the two substances are one hypostasis, and they say: He is one person. Then they say:

Indeed, the Lord of the worlds is one God, one hypostasis, and one essence, and He is three persons, so they confirm to the one essence three Hypostases, and the two united substances have one hypostasis, even though the will of the three hypostases is one for them, humanity and divinity. They confirm that they have two wills and two natures, and yet they have one person, one hypostasis, and this requires the utmost contradiction. Whether they interpreted the hypostasis with the attribute, or the person, or the essence with the attribute, or anything they said.
It shows that those who spoke these words did not imagine what they said.

Rather, they were misguided and ignorant. Contrary to what the prophets say, it is true. For this reason, there is nothing found about Christ or any other of the prophets. It agrees with what they say about the Trinity, hypostases, union, and other such things that they invented without hearing or reason. Rather, they made contradictory statements. For the law and reason.

Then Al-Hasan bin Ayyub said: Then we found the Christians known as Nestorianism had disagreed with the Jacobites and the Melkites in their statement In two people who have one will, and that the two natures were united and became in one direction, then they returned to what they said in that Mary gave birth to Christ. If she gave birth to Christ, then they are bound and obligated to acknowledge that she gave birth to this divinity and humanity. The United.

The meaning was traced back to the words of the Ya’qubiya, but for this they chose words that they embellished and used to confuse the listener, and they did not They express the statement like the statement of Al-Yaqubiyyah; Because what is united with a thing is what is mixed with it and combined with it until what is combined with it becomes one thing, then they confirmed the saying. By their acknowledgment that since humanity was united with divinity, it has not separated from it, so as long as it does not separate from the thing, is it merely running its course in all its various aspects of Harm and benefit, good and evil, need and wealth?

He said: As for their saying: Mary gave birth to Christ through his humanity, this is an error. Otherwise, how can a child be born united with anything else? He has something other than that? How can that be when they say that he never left him? Is this true according to theorists? Isn’t it the ruling of every observer and of every rational person that birth must be based on divinity and humanity together? In the sense of union and in the meaning of the name that unites divinity and humanity, which is Christ, as well as pregnancy with both of them, and that the womb How about them?
He said:

If they resort to falsehood and defend the ugliness of this article, and tend to improve it with the questionable camouflage of those whose knowledge is limited, We will raise up against them a witness from within themselves that they cannot reject, and that is because the law of their faith which their leaders composed for them from The patriarchs, bishops, bishops, pontiffs of their religion, and those with knowledge among them, in the presence of the king when they meet from far away The land was in the city of Constantinople, and they were three hundred and eighteen men. They describe that they spoke it with the Holy Spirit, and it was not Their groups differ when they differ regarding the matters concerning it, and no offering is complete for them except with it in this manner that we explain:

We believe in God the Father, the Owner of all things, the Maker of what is seen and what is unseen, and in one Lord Jesus Christ, the only Son of God, the firstborn of all creation. All of them, and not by made, true God from true God, from the essence of his Father, by whose hand the worlds were formed and all things created for us. Human beings, and whoever

For the sake of our salvation, He came down from heaven, was incarnated by the Holy Spirit, became a human being, was conceived and born of the virgin Mary, and suffered and was crucified for days Cetus the son of Pilate, and was buried, and rose again on the third day, as it is written, and ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of his Father, being prepared. To come another time to judge between the dead and the living, and we believe in the one Holy Spirit, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from his Father, a spirit. And his coming, and with one baptism for the forgiveness of sins, and with one Catholic saintly group, and with the resurrection of our bodies, And to everlasting life forever and ever.
He said: This is the Sharia. People agree to believe in it, to put one’s enthusiasm in it, and to remove the masses from the monarchy without it. And the Jacobites and Nestorians.

And they all acknowledged that the Lord Christ, whose description we have extracted from it, is the true God from the true God, came down from heaven. He was incarnated by the Holy Spirit, became a human being, was conceived, and was born of the virgin Mary. He suffered and was crucified.

He said: Is there any doubt in this statement or any connection to the stubbornness of the person defending the argument? So consider this saying, O Christians, for it is not possible for any of you to deviate from it, nor to repel what he declared, for you If you say: The one who was killed and crucified is God, then according to your statement, Mary gave birth to God, Glory be to Him and Most High above what they say. And if you say: He A human being, so Mary gave birth to a human being, and in that is the complete invalidity of the law of your faith, so choose whichever of the two statements you wish, for it nullifies the religion.
He said:

It may be necessary for rational people to have their minds discourage them from worshiping a God whom Mary gave birth to, while she was a human woman, and then he remained The earth is for thirty years, and the provisions of human beings are applied to it, such as food and upbringing, health and sickness, fear and security, learning and education, not It is easy for you to claim that there was anything theological in him during that period, and that he had nothing to do with the conditions of all human beings. Their needs, necessities, worries, tribulations, and behavior were a way out. Then, after this long period of time, he brought about Explaining the command of God Almighty, the prophecies, and the brilliant, miraculous signs by the power of God Almighty, and he was among other prophets. The like of it and what was higher than it. His period in that period was less than three years, then his matter ended in what they describe as ending it. They attribute to him imprisonment, beatings, slander, crucifixion and murder. Do the minds accept what they say about
That a god attained His servants from Him, just as you remember that it was attained from Him?

If you interpret that this occurred by the body, and not by analogy, then this is plausible because of what we have explained regarding the meaning of divinity being united with it, then has it not occurred? With a body with which divinity was united, and the soul dwelt in it, and God gave birth to it, as you claim and describe, for the salvation of creation, and entrusted to it judgment among the servants on the day in which the first and the last will gather for reckoning, and we have found you influencing the news of a people who have turned away from The coffins therein are witnesses for you, that the hands that were stretched out to them have dried up, or has anyone suffered from fear, panic, grief, and anxiety. And supplicating to God to remove what befell him, such as what is said in the Gospel that he attained it, and we found the books predicting that he was afflicted by Jorges is one of those who followed the religion of Christ, may God bless him and grant him peace, who was subjected to severe torment by killing, burning, and being sawed with saws unless he was heard. Like him in one of the people, and he also inflicted severe punishment on many of his students.

And it was said: When the kings who were warring with them used to label them as a result of them returning from their religions to the disbelief that those kings adhered to. So they were patient with that and took care of themselves. They did not escape from death, and they were able to flee from one country to another and seek refuge. And concealing their persons, and in any of those situations they did not show alarm or panic, and they were some of the humans subordinate to him, because he reduced From them what they used to achieve with the support of God Almighty.

He said: Then we say something else: We may infer the validity of this law from its infirmity in four ways, in none of which there is any doubt or doubt. stabbing, neither addition nor subtraction, and it is the origin of Christ’s command to you: the first of which is the good news that Gabriel, peace be upon him, brought. The second: The saying of Yahya bin Zakariya, to whom Christ bore witness, that no women rose up like him.
The third: the call heard from heaven.
And the fourth: What Christ said about himself when Yahya asked him about his business.

And what Gabriel said, according to what was proven in your Gospel, to Mary when he gave her the good news: (Peace be upon you, you full of blessings. Our Lord is with you, O Blessed among women. When Mary saw him, she was terrified of him, and he said: Do not be afraid, O Mary, for you have won a blessing from your Lord, so here you are. You will conceive and bear a son, and you will name him Jesus. He will be great, and he will be called the Son of the Most High God. And the Lord God will give him the throne of his father David, and he will be king. On the family of Jacob forever. Then Mary said: How can I have this, since no man has touched me? The king said to her: The Holy Spirit is coming to you, or he said:
He will dwell within you, and the power of the Most High will conceive you. For this reason, he who is born of you will be a saint, and he will be called the Son of God Most High.

He said: We did not see the angel. He said to her: Indeed, the one you are giving birth to is your Creator, and He is the Lord, as you have called Him. Rather, he removed the doubt about that by saying: Indeed, God The Lord will give him the throne of his father David, and will choose him and honor him, and that David the prophet is his father, and that he will be called the Son of God, and what he also said: (that He will be king on earth.) But the kingdom was assigned to him only over the children of Israel, and you know that those who are called the Son of God are many who cannot be numbered. From that is your acknowledgment that you are all children of God through love, and Christ said:

(My father and your father, and my God and your God), in more than one place in the Gospel, then God naming Jacob and others his sons in particular, so the way is in Christ, if you do not attach him to this name with the general public, let this designation follow the course of the group to which they were singled out from among The prophets and the righteous, and the lineage of his kingship to his father David proves that his father was David, and that the first name was on the side of Selection and love, and that the Spirit descended upon him in the manner that “Matthew,” the disciple, said to the people about Christ in the Gospel:
(It is not you who speak, but the Spirit of God comes to you and speaks in you.)

So he was informed that the spirit would dwell among all the people and speak among them, and the king said in his good news of the Messiah, peace be upon Mary, to Mary: He will be king. On the family of Jacob. So he singled out the family of Jacob by ruling over them to the exclusion of other people, and did not say that he would be a god for the creatures. The meaning of Gabriel’s statement, peace be upon him, is For Maryam 74: (Our Lord is with you) is similar to the meaning of what God Almighty said to Moses and other prophets: (Indeed, I am with you). He said to Joshua bin Nun:

(Indeed, I will be with you, as I was with My servant Moses.) So all the Christians say, in the context of their language and the meanings of their words, that God Almighty and Spirit Jerusalem is with every preacher, monk, and virtuous person in his religion on this path.

He said: As for the call that Yahya bin Zakariya heard from heaven in Christ, and Yahya’s testimony to him, “Matthew” said in his Gospel: (Indeed When Christ, peace be upon him, left the Jordan, the sky opened for him, and Yahya looked at the Holy Spirit descending upon Christ in the form of a dove. And he heard a call from heaven: “This is my beloved son, whom I have chosen.”

We have known, and you have known, that the Chosen One is an object, and the object is a created being, and Christ, peace be upon him, did not refrain from acknowledging that. Acknowledging this in all his words, and he still says: (My God, and your God, and my Father, and your father), and whenever he confirms it, he is a servant sent and wanted. An envoy is ordered to carry out what he hears, and does what is prescribed for him, and we will explain this in its appropriate place in this book, God Almighty willing.

Then he said: We found that the Messiah, peace be upon him, needed to complete his matter with the baptism of Yahya for him, so he went to him for that and asked him about it, The level of the intended person is not lower than the level of the intending one. Luke, the disciple, said in his Gospel: (Indeed, Yahya the Baptist was sent to the Messiah. After he baptized him and asked him: “Are you the one who is coming, or do we expect someone else?” Christ’s answer to his apostles was: “Go back and tell him.” Because of what you see, the blind can see, and the deaf can hear, and the deaf can hear. Blessed is he who is not deceived by me or humiliated by my command.)

He said: We found Yahya with his place and the majesty of his destiny in the sight of God Almighty, then what he testified to Christ about was that the women did not stand up. About someone like him, he had doubts about it, so he needed to ask him about it, and then Christ’s answer to him was nothing of what you describe. Divinity, nor did he say: I am your Creator and the Creator of everything, as in the law of your faith. Rather, he warned of error in his matter and deception, and it was not from his saying More than what was mentioned, he demonstrated these signs with his prophecy, the likes of which were preceded by most of the prophets.

He said: We did not see that Yahya increased his condition of it when he taught him and spoke highly of him, despite his doubts about his matter and his need to ask him about it. His condition is that he said: (He is stronger than me, and I do not deserve to untie the knot of his socks) and he did not say that he is my creator, and a good man might say Among those who are lower than him, such as the one whom Yahya said about him, out of humility before God and humility, just as Christ said about Yahya: (Indeed, the women did not stand up from the Like him).

He said: So you abandoned what the apostles and prophecies brought in Christ, which is your origin upon which your building took place, and you made for yourselves a law. Others, and the example of those who established this law for you is like someone who believes in the prophecy of a man who is denied prophethood, because Christ, peace be upon him, says: He is expected to be sent, and Gabriel says: He is honored and chosen, and that his father is David, and that God has made him king over the family of Jacob, and a herald calls From the sky like that, and Yahya bin Zakariya bears witness to something like that, and you say: Rather, He is an eternal Creator except that He conceals Himself. And he says:

Christ and others whom we have named say that he is given and that God is his giver, and you say: Rather, he is the Provider and Giver of blessings, and he says: Indeed, God sent him, And you say: Rather, He is the one who came down to save us, and you believe that the reason for His coming down from heaven is that He wanted to save you and bear sin. And Satan binds! We have found salvation

It did not happen, and the sin is still present and has not disappeared, and Satan is the most powerful of all. He was not bound, but rather God gave him power over him, as you say, and confined him to He tested it on the mountain for forty days, and said to it in some of its conditions with it: “If you are the Son of God, tell these rocks to become bread.” And he said He has Christ as his answer: It is written that man’s life does not consist in bread, but in every word that proceeds from God. Then Satan led him away To the city of Jerusalem, and made him stand at the corner of the temple, and said to him:

If you are the Son of God, throw yourself from here, for it is written, The angels are entrusting you, lest your foot stumble against a stone. Jesus said: And it is written again: Do not put the Lord your God to the test. Then he led him to a high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their adornments, and said to him: If you fall down on your face and prostrate to me, I will make this You see, it's all yours. Christ said to him: Go away, Satan, for it is written: Worship the Lord your God, and serve no one but Him. Then God Almighty sent an angel who uprooted the enemy from his place, threw him into the sea, and cleared the way for the Messiah.

And he said: Doesn’t he who has the slightest problem in his mind know that this act does not come from a devil to a god? If he were a god, he would remove it. On his own behalf, before the angel came to him from his Lord, and when he said: (We are commanded not to tempt God, and to prostrate to the Lord, and not to worship Nothing else.) How could Satan not be bound from himself before he was bound from his nation? He said: These are matters that, when the meditator contemplates them, are very ugly, their differences are many, and their contradiction and confusion are intense.
He said:

What is astonishing about it is that you believe that the Eternal Son was united with Christ, and they were in one place, and never separated from Him since they were united. With it, he remained in that state in his mother’s womb for nine months, then he raised a newborn who was nourished with milk, and was raised as a child nourished with food. Until he reached thirty years of age, nothing of the instrument of divinity appeared from him, nor did anything necessitate this position, nor did anything occur between him and his counterparts from among Human beings are a group, and no light shone from him, nor did tranquility appear to him, nor did the angels surround him with rejoicing, nor did the people suffer from him after that above that. There were no prophets before him. God spoke to Moses from the brambles as He wished, so he illuminated all around it with light, and He spoke to him from Mount Sinai. Then the flames burned in the mountain, and his face was covered with a bright light, so that he was covered with a veil when he sat with the children of Israel after that, because they They were unable to look at him, then Moses asked his Lord, the Almighty and Majestic, when he approached.

From him, he said: Lord, show me that I may look at You. He said: You will not see me, but look at the mountain. If it stays in its place, you will see me. When his Lord appeared to the mountain, He caused it to collapse, and Moses fell down in shock. He recovered from his shock. He asked forgiveness from his Lord and He turned to him. And the glory of God was revealed to a group of prophets, and they saw countless numbers around his glory. Angels.

And David said: (O Lord, when you passed through a country for years, the earth shook because of you and was overwhelmed by your awe). He also said, as one addressing the sea and the mountains and marveling at them: (Why are you running away, O sea, and why have you, O River of Jordan, turned away? Returning, and what is the matter with you, O mountains, that move forth like mountains? Then he said as the one answering them: (At the presence of the Lord the lands shook.)
He said: If Christ is the Eternal Creator or was united with Him, then how come the mountains did not tremble before Him and did not turn away from His will? Rivers and seas?

Or how come no dazzling signs more glorious than the signs of the prophets before him appeared from him, such as walking on the flats of the air, and lying on the shoulders of winds, abstaining from food and drink, and burning the devils and jinn who were close to him, just as Elijah burned whoever was close to him. King Ahab's army, and he protects the human beings from himself, and what they did to his body, as you claim, so that the people would know that he is their creator or that he is a temple. The Creator?

He said: And we found you saying: The Son is only called the Son of God and His Word, because he was born of the Father and emerged from him, so we did not understand the meaning. This is because the law of your faith says: The spirit also proceeds from the Father. If the matter is as you say, then the spirit also is a son, because it is It departs from God Almighty, otherwise what is the difference between them?

He said: We also did not understand your statement: That the Son was incarnated by the Holy Spirit, and that the Holy Spirit led him to righteousness to be tested by Satan, so what? The son’s need was for the spirit, and it is like what you say, to manage it and change it from one state to another. Did you not know that the other The preceding and directing is a subject, and the preceding and directing is an object. Therefore, the Son is without the Spirit and is not like Him, because the Eternal does not cease from The Eternal One, and He is like Him.

He said: And if the Messiah was from the Holy Spirit, as the angel Gabriel said to his mother Mary, then why did you call him the Word of God and His Son, and you did not call him His spirit. The king said to her: What you give birth to is from the Holy Spirit. The Spirit is other than the Son. If the meaning were the same, the law would not have said that he was incarnated by the Holy Spirit, and that the Holy Spirit led him to righteousness. The Holy Spirit descended upon him, and why do you triangulate him in your faith, saying: We believe in the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit?
He said: We found you saying, O Nestorian:

God has eternal knowledge and wisdom, which is the Son, and life, which is the Spirit, and His knowledge and life have the same essence as God’s, and that is because God’s knowledge has Knowledge and life, and His life, which is His spirit, is knowledge and life, and God the Father did not see the enemy’s control over His creation and the neglect of the prophets. On his opposition to him, he sent him his only son and his beloved and made him a ransom and fulfillment for all mankind, and that his son came down from heaven and was incarnated from The Holy Spirit and became a human being, then he was born, grew up, and lived for thirty years moving among the children of Israel as one of them, praying

in their churches, and he follows their traditions, does not claim a religion other than theirs, and does not claim a message, prophecy, or sonship, even when that period ends. The years. He made the call apparent and brought brilliant signs and famous proofs, so the Jews denied him, killed him, and crucified him, then he ascended to The sky.

And you believed in the law of faith and declared disbelief to those who violated it, and then you did not soon remove it and separate yourself from it and say: Indeed, the Messiah Two essences and two hypostases, an ancient essence and a modern essence, and every essence has its own hypostasis, and God is an ancient essence that has two meanings. It is one and has three meanings, and three have one meaning, like the sun, which is one thing and has three meanings: disk and heat. And the light. Christ is God, and he is a messenger, but he is not to be worshiped.
So the meaning of your saying was this:

The Messiah was born, but he is not an object. He is an envoy sent, but you are ashamed to call him a messenger, since you do not differentiate. between God and Him in any of the things, and you accepted Melkism and Jacobism by declaring infidelity and cursing them for saying that God and the Messiah are One thing, then you did not take long to present Christ before God, Blessed and Most High, and began to glorify him, and raised your praises to him. And your desires during the times of sacrifices in particular, which are the most important of your prayers and the best of your gatherings, for the imam among you stands at the altar. From your altars
Its people are terrified, so you expect the Holy Spirit to descend, as you claim, from heaven by calling on him.

Then he opens his prayer and says: (May the grace of Jesus Christ and the love of God the Father be completed upon us and upon you, and the sharing of the Holy Spirit forever. (of the ages). Then he concludes his prayer like that. This is a statement of polytheism, and a belittlement of God’s greatness and glory if you assign blessings and gifts to those who He is without Him, and He is given and authorized by God, as you say, and you made love for God and participation in His Spirit after Christ.

He said: And we found that you had criticized the Yaqubiya for saying: Mary gave birth to God, may God be glorified and exalted in that, and in the law of faith which The unanimous agreement has made it clear that Christ is the true God, and that he was born of Mary. So what is the meaning of discord, and what are the differences, and what do you deny? Their saying: The one killed and crucified is God Almighty. Is that what happened?

And the law of your faith says: We believe in the Lord Christ, who, from His experience and condition, was born of Mary, suffered, and was crucified during the reign of the king.” Pilate of Nabataea, and he was buried and rose again on the third day. Is this not an acknowledgment of what they said? So consider this saying, O people of understanding.
For if you say: The one who was slain and was crucified is God, then Mary among you gave birth to God.

And if you say: It is a human being, because Mary gave birth to a human being, and the law was invalidated, then which of the two statements you chose would nullify your religion, and then you criticized On the monarchy, they say: Christ has only one hypostasis, because He became one thing with the Eternal Creator, with no difference between them. And you said that it has two hypostases, and every essence has its own hypostasis, and then you soon returned to what they said, and you said:

Although Christ was created by Mary and was sent, he is a temple of the eternal Son of God, and we do not differentiate between them, so if the matter is If you have this, what do you resent the ownership of, and what is the meaning of separation? In the union, you have returned to what they said? This matter is confusing.

If the Sharia in the sense of trust is true for you, then what Jacob said, and that is if we begin from the Sharia in mentioning Christ, then we coordinated the meanings in one way and went down to the end, and we found that the people who presented it to you confirmed that Jesus Christ is the Son of God, and He is the firstborn of all creation. He who was born of Mary was not made, and He is a true God from a true God from The essence of His Father, and He is the one who perfected the worlds and created all things by His hand, and He is the one who came down to save you. He was incarnated, and Mary carried him and gave birth to him. He was killed and crucified. Whoever denies the saying of the Yaqubiyyah must deny this law, which testifies to the validity of their saying, and cursed are those who He composed it.

He said: But that sect, meaning those who put the trust in words and stated that they found problems in the Gospel that were interpreted In it, what happened to her liking, and she left the clear and clear words in the Gospel that testify to the servitude of Christ and his testimony to that. himself and the testimony of his disciples against him, so she took the simple problem, gave it whatever interpretation she liked, and eliminated the obvious. Much that does not need interpretation.

He said: As for your argument against the sun, that it is one thing with three meanings, and your likening of what they say about the three hypostases to it, This is an incorrect camouflage, because the light of the sun is not limited by the limit of the sun, and likewise its heat is not limited by the limit of the sun, since the limit of the sun is a body. Circular, luminous, heated, circulating in the midst of the spheres permanently, and its light and heat are prepared to be defined in this manner, and it is not said:

Its light or heat is a round, luminous, heated body that is constantly rotating. Even if its light and heat were a true sun from a true sun from the essence of the sun, As the law said in Christ: He is a true God from a true God from

The substance of his father, then what you said of him would be a perfect example, but the matter is the opposite of that, so he does not resemble him and cannot be measured against him, and the argument from you in it is Invalidity.
He said:

We found you mentioning that Christ came down from heaven and by his descent abolished death and sins. The astonishment of this statement continues. Even more astonishing than this is those before him who did not think about it, and those who did not find it objectionable to believe in a religion for God, Blessed and Most High, like this. The impossible statement is clear from what the minds bear witness to and what the sightings foretell, and which people are called to, for it is not far from a contract. More permissible and more vain than these, for if sin was made useless by his coming, then those who killed him are neither sinners nor guilty, because no A sinner after his coming and no sin.

And likewise those who killed his disciples and burned his books were not sinning, and likewise those whom we see among your community from that age until This is a time when he kills, steals, commits adultery, commits sodomy, gets drunk, lies, and commits all the sins that are forbidden from him and other things. Sinners, not guilty.
Whoever denies that, let him return to the tasbih that is recited after every offering, which is: (O our Lord, who has overcome the overwhelming pain of death).

And in the other, which is said on the second Friday of Easter: (Indeed, we are proud of the cross, by which the power of death was abolished, and we reached safety. And salvation because of it). And in some hymns (through the prayers of our Lord Jesus Christ, death has been abolished, the temptations of Satan have been extinguished, and their effects have been studied). What sin has been made void? And what temptation of Satan was extinguished? Or has any of the things that people were doing before his coming of forbidden acts and sins changed?

He said: If camouflage occurs in what everyone attaches to knowledge and clarification, then it applies to matters that are more ambiguous and is done with interpretations. What those interpreters interpreted is more correct.

And if you have accepted this apparent impossibility which is not hidden from the children, then you are in for something greater than the impossibility. I accept, and this Gospel of yours belies this saying, as Christ says in it: (How many will say to me on the Day of Resurrection: O our Lord, will not In your name we cast out Satan, so I say: Depart from me, you ungodly and deviant, for I never knew you.) This is contrary to what your scholars say. They said, “And He will assign to you what they have assigned, and a similar example is His saying: (Indeed, I will gather the people on the Day of Resurrection from my right and my left, and I will say to the people of the easy way):
