Saeed bin Al-Batriq said: I thought I would respond to the Nestorians in this matter and show the falsehood and corruption of their opinion. Because the Nestorians in our time contradicted the ancient saying of Nestorius, and claimed that Nestorius was saying: Christ is of two essences. And two hypostases: a God, complete in His hypostasis and essence, and a human being, complete in His hypostasis and essence.

And Mary gave birth to Christ in terms of his humanity, not in terms of his divinity. Because according to them, the father gave birth to a god and did not give birth to a human being, and Mary gave birth to a human being and did not give birth to a god.

Then it will be said to them: If the matter is as you say, then Christ is two Messiahs and two Sons. The Messiah is a God and the Son of a God, and the Messiah is a man and the Son of Man. Because Mary must have given birth to Christ or not.
If she gave birth to him, it must be a spiritual or physical birth.
If he is corporeal, then he is not the one begotten by the Father, and that necessitates that he be a Messiah.
And if it is spiritual, then Christ is one Son, one hypostasis, one Christ.
The evidence for this is the iron plate with which the fire is united, for it is one sword that burns, prevents, cuts, and illuminates.
It is not permissible for the illuminated burnt offering to be from the iron side other than the fire side, since it was something that did not contain iron fire. Not burning.
The fiery side is not the decisive factor, since the matter of fire was to illuminate and burn, not to cut.
Thus, what the monarchy believed that Christ is one hypostasis was proven and corrected, and the Nestorian saying that Christ was two hypostases was proven false.

I said: It may be said to this: The saying of Nestorianism and the monarchy, even if they are false, then the statement of the monarchy is even more false and greater in disbelief and contradiction. What this man mentioned is false.
As for his saying: If the matter is as you say, then the Messiah is two Messiahs.

It is said to him: This only necessitates that if divinity alone were to be called Christ, then the Nestorians agreed upon a falsehood, which is that the Lord was born God, and this is false, and none of the prophets ever said, neither in the Bible nor elsewhere: The attribute of God that exists in Him is born, nor that The Lord has an ancient and eternal begotten.
But if it is assumed that this is the case, then no one would call the attribute of God Christ.

If it is assumed that divinity and humanity are two substantive substances without a unity between them, then it is not necessary for the divinity to be Christ, nor is there a Christ who is God, and there is no Christ who is the son of God.

It was mentioned on the authority of Nestorius that he was saying: This is the man whom we say is Christ, united in love with the Son of God, and it is said He has a God and a Son of God, not in reality, but His gift.
He declared that Christ is only man and not divinity, and that Christ is neither God nor the son of God in reality.
So what he imposed on him, that there must be two Christians here, is invalid.
As for his saying: Mary must have given birth to Christ or not.

It is said: Rather, she gave birth to Christ, and he is man, and he is not the divinity that you claim that the Father begot, and there are not two Christs in that, but one Christ. A created human being.

And also His saying: If she gave birth to him, then it must be a spiritual or physical birth. If it was a spiritual birth, then Christ is one Son. One hypostasis, one Christ - a false division and a corrupt and refuting argument.

For Mary did not give birth spiritually, but rather the child came out of her vagina just as women’s children come out of their private parts, regardless of whether she was virgin. Whether it remains or not.

As for what he mentioned about the representation with an iron plate, if it was assumed that it was an identical example, it would not indicate the validity of their statement, but rather its purpose is that it indicates As much as he can.

Where is the evidence that this is the reality? There is nothing in it that indicates the validity of the statement of ownership and the corruption of the statement of their opponents, so how can it be when it is an inconsistent representation?

For if iron is united with fire, the iron would have changed its quality and would not remain pure iron, and it is not pure fire, and wood If anything else is burned and becomes fire, it is not pure wood and it is not pure, simple fire.

It is the case of the two things, if they are united, that each of them transforms into a third essence and a third nature that is neither one nor the other, like water. And when the milk is united, it becomes a third essence and a third nature, neither pure milk nor pure water, and so is fire with iron. Or wood or anything else, for that becomes a third essence, which is neither pure iron nor pure wood nor pure fire, but iron. Cold is iron, but its reality has changed. The fire softens it and takes away its impurity, and it does not remain as it was before after its union with fire. Wood becomes charcoal, which is a third essence, since it is the nature of fire that it affects every body according to it, so it affects iron. According to him, and in wood according to him.
And every two things united, they become a third essence, a third hypostasis, and a third nature.

If divinity and humanity had united - as they claimed - then the attribute of divinity would have been impossible and the attribute of humanity would have been impossible, then theology would not remain theology or Humanity is humanity. Rather, they became a third essence, neither divinity nor humanity. They deny this saying, and it is false.

For the Lord of the worlds does not change, and His attributes are not transformed by the attributes of newly created things, and the ancient is not overturned, nor is any of His attributes changed, nor is The Ancient Lord, the Creator, and the newly created creation transform into a third thing.
Rather, the attributes of the Lord, with which He has always been described and continues to be described, do not change, cannot be reversed, or transform, let alone transform into a matter. Third.
Then this third, if he was an ancient creator, became two ancient creators here.

If it were a newly created creature, then the Creator would have become a newly created creature, and it is known that the transformation of the Creator to another Creator or to A created being, abstaining and apparently abstaining.

What clarifies this is that what they represented of iron heated by fire is a third essence, and the same thing that occurs over its iron applies to its fire. If it is knocked, then the striking applies to its fire as it applies to its iron, and the same applies if it is extended, and the same applies if spitting is done on it. The same applies if it is thrown into water.
If this representation is consistent, then what happened to humanity must also happen to divinity.

So the Lord of the Worlds is the one who eats, drinks, urinates and defecates, and it is he who was slapped by them, spit in his face, and made thorns On his head, he was beaten with whips, he was crucified, he died, and he suffered, as something similar is said about the Jacobites.
This is necessary for everyone who said about unity, even the Nestorian ones who said: They are united by will, meaning that the will of this person is The will of this.
Unlike when they say: His will is in accordance with His will, it is not the same, and for this reason the Almighty said:

{Indeed, those who say, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, son of Mary” have disbelieved. And the Messiah said, “O Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord. Indeed, it is he who associates others with God.” By God, God has forbidden to him Paradise, and his abode is the Fire, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. - Indeed, those who say that God is the third of three have disbelieved, and there are no There is no god but one God, and if they do not desist from what they say, a painful punishment will certainly befall those who disbelieve among them - so will they not repent to God? And they seek His forgiveness, and God is Forgiving, Merciful - The Messiah, the son of Mary, is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and his mother is a truthful one. They used to eat Food: See how We make clear to them the signs, then see how they are led away.} [Al-Maidah:

72 - 75]. So God Almighty mentioned: They were eating food; Because that is one of the clearest pieces of evidence that they are created beings who are to be raised, since the Creator is one who is steadfast and does not eat or drink.
He mentioned Mary with Christ; Because among the Christians were those who took it as another god and worshiped it as they worshiped Christ.

And those who do not say this - many of them ask her for everything that is asked of God until He says to her: Forgive me and have mercy on me, and other than that, Based on the fact that she is interceding on this matter with her son.

Sometimes they say: O Mother of God, intercede for us to God, and sometimes they ask her the needs that are asked of God, but they do not mention intercession, and others worship her as they worship Christ.
Saeed bin Al-Bariq mentioned this about them, when he mentioned their meeting with Constantine in Nicaea.
He said: They had different opinions and different religions.
Among them are those who say: Christ and his mother are two gods besides God, and they are the Maryamani and they are called the Maryamaniyyah. This is what Ibn Hazm said, And God Almighty said:

{And when God said, “O Jesus, son of Mary, did you say to the people, ‘Take me and my mother as two gods besides God?’” He said, “Glory be to You. It is not for me to say what.” I have no right. If I said it, you already knew it. You know what is in my soul, and I do not know what is in your soul. Indeed, you are the Knower of the unseen - I did not say to them except what You commanded me thereby to worship God, my Lord and your Lord, and I was a witness over them as long as I lived among them. When You caused me to die, you were the watcher over them and you were over all Something is a witness} [Al-Ma’idah: 116-117]. And He - Glory be to Him - did not narrate this on behalf of all Christians, but rather asked
Christ is a question by which he will condemn those who consider him and his mother to be gods besides God.

Ibn Penguin said: It is also said to the Nestorians: Tell us about the humanity with which divinity was united and he was called the Messiah. Did he still A Messiah from the time he was in Mary’s womb until she gave birth to him and nursed him and he grew up and was crucified and killed? Or was he one of the people for thirty years, and then after that, divinity was united with humanity and he was a Christ?

If they say: There was no Christ while he was in Mary’s womb, but rather Mary gave birth to a man who was thirty years old and he was one of the people, then he was united After that, divinity and humanity became Christ. They abandoned what they said and denied the Gospel, Paul, and all the books of the church, and departed from Christianity article.

And if they say: Divinity was united in humanity at conception, and that He was the Messiah while He was carried, born, and breastfed until He was crucified and killed - then They acknowledged that Mary gave birth to one God, one Christ, one hypostasis.

It is said to him: This division indicates the invalidity of the Christians’ statement which was invented by their three sects and others, for the union claims that it From the time Mary conceived him, he grew little by little like the growth of the body of Christ.
The union is invalid, as has been stated more than once, and if it had been estimated that it was possible, the effect of that would have been evident.
When God spoke to Moses from the tree, signs and greatness appeared that indicated that. That is why when he spoke to Moses, he would reveal the signs of that.

Likewise, what was told about him in the Torah and elsewhere about his companionship with the Children of Israel, and this is what his effect became clear, even if he was not united or Immediately in some of that.

And when it appeared from Mount Sinai and rose from Seir and was revealed from the mountains of Paran with what He revealed from His books, the effects of that became apparent, even if it did not Let his soul be united and not separated by Paran or Tur Sinai, by the agreement of the nations.
How could His essence be united with what was in Mary’s womb, or a state therein, and no effect of that would appear?
And also it is said to him: The Nestorians may say to him: His humanity was Christ from the time of conception, meaning that He was pure and holy, not in the sense of a union. Divinity in Him.

Even if they say: Christ is the name of divinity and humanity altogether. It is said: There is nothing in the books of the prophets that requires this, and the Nestorians accept that, but they may say: Christ is a name for them, just as Man is a name for the soul and body.

Then the body of a dead person may be said: This human being, while it was in the womb of his mother Mary before the soul was breathed into it, it may be said: This fetus. And this pregnancy. Likewise, if it is said to him: Christ without divinity.

Also, the Nestorians may say that theology is united from the time of conception, and it is not necessary that she gave birth to a god, as they did not say about the union, but rather They said: They are two hypostatic essences, one of them was born and the other was not, just as the monarchy says with them: One of them was crucified and was not. The other, and one of them died but the other did not, and one of them suffered but the other did not.

So how can ownership be permitted at the time of death, when death, crucifixion, eating, drinking, and all other human affairs are permissible in one of the two substances without The other, and did they not allow - at the time of childbirth - for Mary to give birth to one of the two gems and not the other? Is this nothing but their contradiction? As they all say: He ascended to heaven and sits at the right hand of His Father, along with their saying: Divinity, along with humanity, sits at the right hand of the Father.

They say, however: The divinity sitting at the right of the other is that other, and they are one essence and one God, with his saying: He is a true God from a true God, so there is much contradiction with them.

There is no doubt that the Nestorian saying is also contradictory, but it is not possible to correct the statement of ownership without their statement. Rather, the statement of ownership is greater. Corruption and contradiction.
The Nestorians say: God was neither born nor crucified.
And the Jacobites say: He was born and crucified.
And the monarchy say: He was born but not crucified.

Whenever it is permissible for Him to be born, it is permissible for Him to die and be crucified, but if it is not permissible for Him to be crucified and die, then it is not permissible for Him to be born.
Permitting one of them and prohibiting the other is a contradiction.

And it is said of the kingdom: You say: Divinity was united with humanity at conception, and He was Christ while He was struck, crucified, and dead. And in pain. And you say: This was due to humanity rather than divinity, so this contradiction is of the same type as the Nestorian contradiction.
Ibn Penguin said: It is also said to the Nestorians: When was the word united with man? Before birth, or during birth?
So if they say: Before birth, we say to them: Before birth, before pregnancy? Or before birth during pregnancy?

If they say: before birth and before conception, then they claim that he was united before he was a human being and before he was formed. If that were so, then the Nestorian saying would be invalidated: that the Ancient One was united with a partial human being. Because the partial human being was only a partial human being when it became human.
It is said to him: This question is relevant to the three sects, for they say that unity is greater than the Nestorians.

If it is said: They say: He united with a universal human being, then this is one of the most corrupt statements, for Christ is a specific and partial human being, which prevents His perception of the company being in him was that he was not a complete human being.

Then he said: They must claim that divinity resided with humanity for nine months or the like from the beginning of conception, residing with Him in The place in which the fetus is carried, then they are born together. This is contrary to their saying: Mary gave birth to Christ in terms of his humanity, not in terms of His theology.
It is said: They may say: He gave birth to humanity without divinity, just as the monarchy says: He created humanity without divinity.
If this is contradictory, then the Nestorians are less contradictory. Because the monarchy says: They are one person, one hypostasis, and one of them has united with the other.

If, in addition to this, it is permissible for them to separate from each other in eating, drinking, crucifixion, and death, then whoever says: They are two subsistence essences, It is more appropriate to say that one of them was born and not the other.
Then he said: Even if they say: It is united with Him, and it bears a complete form.
We said to them: God was a pregnancy before birth, and if it is permissible for him to be conceived, then it is permissible for him to be born.
It is said: They do not say that they became one person, one hypostasis, but rather they say: two hypostatic essences, and in that case they do not say: She became pregnant by a god,
Nor did it give birth to a god, just as the monarchy does not say: Divinity was crucified and divinity died, even though they say that divinity and humanity are united.
He said: If they say: The union was at the time of birth.
We said: Mary gave birth to the Word, therefore, with man, and to us and to them the Word is a god, so Mary gave birth to a god.

If they say: Yes. We said: If it is permissible for a child to be born, then why is it not permissible for it to be a pregnancy? If they allow that, they abandon their statement, and if they do not allow it, we say: What is the difference between being born and being carried? If they say: God is not begotten, and the union did not occur before birth, which is to be conceived, nor in the case of His being a child in a state Childbirth.
We said: This contradicts your statement: Mary gave birth to Christ. Because Christ - with you - is not the only man, and Mary - with you - only gave birth to the human being.

And if Christ is not the only man, and you gave birth to the man alone before the union, then you have given birth to something that is not With Christ, since he was only Christ by union, and the union occurred after birth, so he was Christ after birth.

If this - with you - is corrupt, and Mary gave birth to Christ, then Mary did not give birth to man alone, and this necessitates that she had God was born with man, and it is necessary that the union occurred before birth.

He said: It has become clear that the Nestorian belief that Mary gave birth to Christ was false in terms of his humanity, not in terms of his divinity, and it is true that Mary gave birth to one God, the Messiah.

He said: And it will be said to them: If you claim that Christ is of two essences, an ancient essence and a new essence, and then you claim that Mary gave birth to Christ, You have declared that Mary gave birth to these two substances, which are Christ, and if she gave birth to them and one of them was a god, then she gave birth to a god. In the past, it was not permissible for her to give birth except to something that was pregnant, as this necessitates that she was pregnant for that god.

It became clear that what the Nestorians believed was false, that Mary did not bear or give birth to a god, and what the monarchy believed was true, that Mary She gave birth to one God, one Christ, one Son, one hypostasis.

It is said to him: This contradiction of Nestorianism is not greater than the contradiction of ownership, for - despite their claim of the unity of divinity and humanity, And they are one person - they say: One of them was eating, drinking, fasting, praying, and behaving, and that he was taken, slapped, and put thorns on his head, and he was crucified, suffered, and died without the other.

If the Nestorian statement was contradictory, then the statement of ownership is an even greater contradiction, since they prohibited a woman from becoming pregnant and giving birth to humanity without Divinity: For the sake of the union between them, they must prevent one of them from eating, drinking, being crucified, and killing the other, for the sake of the union. In the first way.
The fact that crucifixion and murder were greater in opposition to divinity than Mary’s pregnancy and birth to him does not prevent all of this from being impossible to God.

And whoever makes it possible for him to believe that the Lord of the Worlds came out of Mary’s vagina while she was a virgin, then He has made the Lord of the Worlds come out of a small hole. This is the greatest form of abstinence.

And whoever considers this permissible, it is permissible for him to come out of every hole like that hole or larger than it, and it is permissible for the Lord to come out of it. The worlds are from the mouth and anus of every animal, and from the cracks in doors and other holes.

Even if they say: That is a pure place. It was said: The mouths of the prophets and righteous people are purer than every private parts in the world, so it is permissible for it to come out from the mouth of every prophet and guardian of God, and from his ear. And from his nose, these punctures and holes are better than women’s private parts. God is great above what the wrongdoers say.
These Christians say: The fact that God was born from Mary’s vagina is not the fact that He was born in eternity from the Father, but rather they are two births. Spiritual and physical.

When they are asked to understand what they are saying, and they are told: This is inconceivable; That the Lord of the Worlds emerges from a narrow hole, without a vagina, mouth, ear, or other such openings. They said: This is beyond the mind, and they admitted that this is not conceivable by the mind.

Then it will be said to them: These words were not said by any of the prophets, nor was any of the prophets uttering them, that Mary became pregnant with the Lord. of the worlds and gave birth to him. Indeed, no prophet among the prophets ever uttered that God was begotten, nor was any of His attributes begotten, neither His knowledge, nor His life, nor Other than that.
Not one of the prophets, neither Christ nor anyone else, ever said that God united with any of the creatures.

There is nothing of that in the Gospel or anything else that is transmitted from the prophets. Rather, most of what is in it are general, similar words, such as His saying: (I and my father are one) just as God said to Muhammad: {Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you are only pledging allegiance to God} [Al-Fath: 10] and His saying: {Whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed God} [An-Nisa: 80] So if some of the atheists of the Muslims, whether Shiites, Sufis, or others, say: God is united with Muhammad; Because of his saying: {Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you only pledge allegiance to Allah} [Al-Fath: 10] This was of the same type as the saying of the Christians.
The verse does not indicate that, but rather pledging allegiance to the Messenger is pledging allegiance to God. Because the Messenger commanded what God commanded, and forbade what God forbade.

It is not in the words of the prophets that God, nor any of His attributes, is born through the birth that they call an intellectual and spiritual birth, nor is it in their books that None of the attributes of God are called the Son of God, nor is the Divinity the Son of God, let alone saying that God was born of a woman by birth. And he came out of her vagina, so he was born physically.

For this reason, when the Christians disputed over it, the one who claimed it against the one who denied it had no proof from the texts of the prophets. Their ultimate goal was to adhere to By using similar words and changing clear and precise words, it is clear that the newborn is a human being.

So if they say regarding similar words: We do not know what the Messenger meant by them, then this is something they may be excused for, because similar texts do not Only God and those well-grounded in knowledge know its interpretation.

So if they said: We are not among those firmly rooted in knowledge who know its interpretation - they were witnessing against themselves their lack of knowledge, and the testimony of It is acceptable for a person to treat himself.

Contrary to what they themselves spoke, and they claimed that its meaning was indicated by the words of the prophets or indicated by reason, then they must They must explain what they meant by it, and they must explain that this was indicated by law or reason.
So if they said: We cannot imagine the meaning of the same words that we said, they would be admitting that they are saying about God what they do not know, and this is forbidden. On them.

And if they say: The words of the prophets indicate that, their ultimate goal is to cling to what is similar, and then they demand an explanation. The similar, and combining it with the decisive in a correct and known way. Otherwise, if they say: This is beyond reason, we do not understand it, it is said To them: Leave aside what is similar and do not use it as evidence, and do not mention a meaning that you claim you do not understand.
So when a saying is proven from the prophets and some people say: We do not understand it - then they are telling the truth about themselves.

But if they interpreted the words of the prophets with a statement in which they expressed the intention of the prophets and said: This is what they wanted, even though they expressed it with expressions. Other - they were asked to explain that meaning, and they were told: If you understand what you said, explain it, and if you do not understand it, then do not speak without it. Science.

Sa`id ibn al-Batriq said: The imams of misguidance - I mean, “Nostorius,” “Artius,” “Dioscorus,” “Saurus,” and “Yaqoub al-Baradei.” And their followers - those who wanted to establish falsehood and impossibility, and did not return to the fear of God, and deviated from the path of truth due to their bad opinion, They were entangled in a sea of misguidance.

In their misguidance, they - all of them - harbor ignorance of the unity of the divinity of our Lord Christ with his humanity, and everyone is involved. One of them is in some aspect of the mixture, and he clings to it.
So I thought I would clarify the aspect of the mixture, and explain that; To understand the corruption of their statement:

Indeed, among the greatness of God’s plan, the perfection of His justice, and the magnificence of His mercy is that He sent His creative word, by which all things were created, and it is the one who His essence is not created, but born of Him before all ages, and God was never without His Word nor His Spirit, nor was the Word Absolutely free from him, nor from his creative spirit, nor from his essence, so the creative word of God descended with its standing, permanent and stable structure, which has not It will continue and will continue, so she was united with the virgin Mary while she was a pure slave.

Chosen from the seed of David, God chose her for this purpose from among the women of the world, and purified her with the Holy Spirit, his essential spirit, so that He made it worthy of the immanent word of God entering into it, so the creative word was hidden by a created human being, which it had created for itself, with its pleasure. The Father and the support of the Holy Spirit, a new creation without human sperm upon which sin occurred, and without human intercourse or separation. The virginity of that holy maid, he is a complete human being with his body, his bloody soul, and his verbal spirit, which is from the image of God in man. And similar to it, it was a dwelling place for God in His presence and withholding His kindness from all the kindness He bestowed upon all creatures.

And know that a gentle person is not seen except in a harsh person, and a gentle person is not seen except in the presence of a person who is harsher than him. He appears to people of burdens due to his harsh character.

Indeed, we found the rational, verbal human spirit to be kinder than the mild-mannered one. For this reason, it was the first of God’s creation to be veiled by God, so it was A veil for her and for those who are gentler than her, and the bloody soul was a veil for her and the coarse body was a veil.

Accordingly, the word of God, the Creator of the perfect human soul, was mixed with its body, blood, and rational, verbal spirit, and became The Word of God, with its structure, is a form of the trinity of humanity, whose essence is completed by establishing the texture of the Word of God; Because she was not created, nor was she anything, except with the strength of the Word of God, who created her and formed her, not from anything, not preceded before that in the womb. Mary, nor did she have anything of sperm, or anything else, except the substance of the creative word, which is one of the divine trinity, so that is The strength is numbered and known to the people, because of what was added to it and created for it; He was united to Him from the essence of man, for He - through the unity of that one substance - is the foundation of the creative word of God, one in the Trinity. By the essence of his divinity, he is one in men, by the essence of his humanity, and not in two, but one with the Father and the Spirit, and he is one with all men. With two different essences of the essence of the Creator Divinity and the essence of created humanity, with the unity of one substance, the texture of the word which is The Son who was born of God before all ages, and he is the same who was born of the Virgin Mary at the end of time, without separation from the Father or From the Holy Spirit.

I said: These are the words of Sa`id ibn al-Batriq, with which he approved the religion of the Christians, and there is falsehood in it that would take a long time to describe, but we will mention some of the aspects of that.

The first aspect: His saying: It is the greatness of God’s plan that He sent His creative word, by which everything was created from its essence. It is not Created, but born of him, the creative word of God descended with its standing and everlasting structure, and was joined to the Virgin Mary.

So it is said: You have made the Creator the Word, and you said - after this -: And the Word was not free from him, nor from his creative spirit, and you said - After that -: The creative Word was hidden by a created human being, whom she created for herself with the pleasure of the Father and the assistance of the Holy Spirit, creating New.
So it is said to them: The Creator of the world - with you - one Creator and He is one God, or does the world have three creator gods? .
If they say: The Creator is one, and they are three creator gods, just as in many of their words they declare three gods, and three Creators, then they say: One God and one Creator.
It is said: This is an apparent contradiction, so it is either this, or that.
And if you say: The Creator is one, He has three attributes, we will not dispute with you that the Creator has attributes, but is not specific to three.

If they say that there are three creator gods, as many of them have said in many of their words, then their disbelief and the greatness of their polytheism is clear, and it is clear that their polytheism It is greater than every polytheism in the world, for the goal of the Magi is dual - to prove two, light and darkness, and these prove three.

Then the auditory evidence in the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the rest of the words of the prophets, along with the rational evidence that clarifies the existence of the Creator. One, too many to list here.

And if they say: The Creator is One, and He has attributes, they will be told: This contradicts your saying: He sent His creative word, and your saying: (And The Word was not from Him nor from His creative spirit) and your saying: (Then the creative Word descended), and your saying: (Then the Word was hidden The Creator, through a created human being, created him for herself with the pleasure of the Father and the assistance of the Spirit.) This implies that the word is a creator and that the spirit is a creator, and that it was created with the pleasure of the Creator Father and the assistance of the creative spirit, and this The Creator descended, but the Father did not descend.
If the Creator is one and has attributes, then there is only one Creator here.

The second aspect: Your saying: (He sent His creative word by which everything was created), and the scriptures have stated that God creates things. With His words, He says to it: (Be and it is), like this in the Qur’an, the Torah, and elsewhere.
But the Creator is God Almighty. He creates with His words, not the words of a creator.
No one should ever say: The Word of God created the heavens and the earth.

The Torah is the word of God, and the Gospel is the word of God, and no one says: He created the heavens and the earth at any of that, and no one says: Oh the word of God. Forgive me and have mercy on me.
The words of these people: His word is the Creator and that He was created by it - are contradictory statements.
For if She is the Creator, she would not be the One created by Him, for the One created by Him is not the Creator.

The third aspect: That it may be said: Is your statement: (the creative word of God) the entire word of God, or is it some of the word of God, or is it the existing meaning? By the essence, the ancient and eternal, which Ibn Kilab confirms, or is it letters and sounds, ancient and eternal, as some people say, or is it the essence? The speaker? .

If it is the entity that speaks, then it is the Father and the Lord, and it is the one described with life, then there will be no words of a being born, nor a word It was sent, and nothing else of what he mentioned, and this is contrary to all of their words, for the Word united with Christ is not the Father. With them.
And if they say: Rather, it is the entire word of God.
It was said to them: Then the Messiah is the Torah, the Gospel, the Qur’an, and the rest of the words of God, and this they do not say, and no one has said it nor does he say it. Sane.
And if they say: It is the one, ancient and eternal meaning, or the ancient and eternal letters and sounds.

It was said to them: These two statements, even if they are false, then if you say them, you are bound to believe that Christ is the entire word of God, for these two - According to those who speak of them - they are all the words of God.

The Torah, the Gospel, and the rest of the words of God are an expression of that meaning existing in the essence of God, which is the ancient letters and sounds existing Especially with those who say these two things.

If you say: Christ is part of the words of God, then God has other words other than Christ, so make every word a creation, just as you made the word United to Christ as Creator, since you used to say: (The Word is the Creator and it is through her that is created), so say about the rest of the words of God. It is a Creator created by it, and in that case the Creator is multiplied by the multiplicity of the words of God.
If the words of God have no end, then the creation is creators who have no end, and this is the goal of falsehood and disbelief.

In short, anything with which they interpreted the word makes clear the falsity of what they said, but they speak what they do not understand, and they say Lying and contradictory disbelief. Rather, with them is imitation of those who led them astray, as God Almighty said: {Say, O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion. other than the truth, and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before, and had misled many, and had gone astray from the straight path.” [Al-Ma’idah: 77].
The fourth aspect: that it is said to them:

Unless it is known by reason, there is nothing in what is reported to indicate it, and you do not claim that you knew it by reason, but by what was reported from The prophets, and you have interpreted his word with his knowledge and wisdom, and the Holy Spirit with his life, so from which prophet can you say that God knew And His wisdom is born of Him, and that He is called Son, and that His knowledge or wisdom created everything, and that His life created everything, and that His knowledge Creator, God and Lord, and His life is Creator, God and Lord, and there is not among the prophets anyone who names any of the attributes of the Lord as His son, son, or male. That God generated something of His attributes.

So your claim that His nature, ancient and eternal, was born twice, once an ancient and eternal birth, and a new birth from Mary’s vagina - is a lie. It is known to the prophets, none of them said that God was born, nor that any of His attributes begot Him, neither a spiritual birth, nor a birth. Physically.

Although this invalidates the statement of ownership, it is even more invalid according to the view of the Jacobites, and it also invalidates the opinion of the Nestorians, for they They say of the faithfulness in which He was born, ancient and eternal, for their three sects agree on the faithfulness that they invented at a certain time.” Constantine “more than three hundred years after Christ.

The fifth aspect: Your saying: He sent His creative word, and the creative word of God descended, by which all things were created. It is not a created thing. But it was born of him, and God was never without his word or his spirit.
Who among the prophets said that he was never without his spirit, or that his spirit is an ancient attribute of him, or that it is his life?

And all the words of the prophets indicate that the Spirit of God, the Holy Spirit, and the like is what He sends down to the prophets, like a revelation. As for support, or angels, the spirit of God is not an attribute inherent in Him or anything else, but it is something distinct from Him.

The sixth aspect: If He had sent His creative word and it descended and was joined to Mary, then He Himself, the Lord of the worlds, descended. And he joined with Mary, or did the Lord of the Worlds himself not descend and join with Mary, but rather descended and joined with the word that he sent?

If you say: He Himself descended and was joined together, then it was the Father who begot the Word. He was the one who descended and was joined, and the Father was the Word. This contradicts your statements.

And if you say: The descending, joined messenger is not the Father, but rather the word of the Lord, then you have made him the Creator, and there will be two Creators, A Creator was sent and it descended and joined together, and a Creator sent that and it did not descend or coalesce, and you have established a third Creator, which is the Spirit, and this A statement of three creator gods.

The seventh aspect: That he said: God sent His creative word by which everything was created, so despite the fact that He made it a creator, He made it so that by it He created Everything, and the one who created everything through it is a creator, so He made it a creator, and He made another creator, and He made one of the creators create the other through Him, everything. And He caused this Creator to have sent that Creator through whom He created all things, and He caused the creative word to be hidden by a created human being whom it created. Through the pleasure of the Father and the support of the Holy Spirit, a new creation for herself.

And if she was the Creator through the pleasure of the Father, the Creator, over creation, then the Father did not create it, but rather was pleased with that, and the Holy Spirit sustained that. And the Creator created creation.
It is known that if the Creator had someone to support him in creation, he would not be independent in creation, but would have a partner in it.

This word, sometimes they say: it is the Creator, and sometimes they say: the Creator created it and it was created, and sometimes they say: the Holy Spirit sustained it. Regarding creation, these are four statements that contradict each other.
If God is the Creator of everything, then the Creator is one, then there is no other Creator and no partner with Him in creation.
And when the Creator created things by saying: (Be), his words would not be creative, and if every word were a creator God, then the gods would be the creators. Many have no end.
Then he said: She is not a created being, but was born of him from before all ages.

It is said: Who among the prophets named any of the attributes of God as being born, ancient and eternal? How can He be born ancient and eternal? Is a newborn conceivable except one who has been born? .
Also, if it is possible that the word that they interpret as knowledge or wisdom was born of him, then so is his life. From Him, and if His life emanates from Him, then His word emanates from Him.

So He made one of the two eternal attributes born from eternity and not emanating, and the other was not born from eternity, but rather emanating - Although it is false, it is contradictory, and a distinction between two things that are similar.
For if it is permissible to say of the ancient and eternal attribute: It is born from Him, then life is born.
If it is permissible to say: it is emanating, then the word is emanating.
Also, the fact that the attribute is a creator god, and proving three creator gods while saying: The Creator is one - is another contradiction.

Also, his saying: (And God was never without His Word nor His Spirit) if He intended life with His Spirit, then this is true, but who among the prophets? He called the life of God His Spirit? And who made God an ancient and eternal spirit? Is this nothing but a slander against the prophets?

No one can say: This is a verbal dispute, so it should not be taken into consideration. Because this is an interpretation of the words of the prophets, for they are the ones who spoke by the Spirit of God and the Holy Spirit and the like, and no one wanted to live by that. God never.
Calling the life of God a spirit, and interpreting the meaning of the prophets by that - is a slander against God and His messengers.

The eighth aspect: His saying (Then the Creator’s Word descended with its firm, permanent, and steadfast structure that has not moved and will not fade away, so it was joined to The Virgin Mary, a pure maid, chosen from the seed of David, God chose her for this plan from among the women of the world and purified her with the spirit of The Holy Spirit, his essential spirit, which he made worthy of the immanent word of God dwelling in it, so the creative word was veiled by a man. A created being that she created for herself, with the pleasure of the Father and the assistance of the Holy Spirit, a new creation).

It is said: The Scriptures indicate that Christ was incarnated by the Holy Spirit and by the Virgin Mary, and this is how he is in the trust that was given to them. And in this way the Qur’an has stated, as it has mentioned in more than one place, that He breathed His Spirit into Mary, while also informing that He sent His Spirit to her.
God Almighty said:

{And mention in the Book Maryam when she withdrew from her people to an eastern place - and she took a veil from other than them. Then We sent to her Our Spirit, and she appeared. She has good tidings. She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you if you are pious.” He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.” She said, “How?” I will have a boy, and no human being has touched me, nor have I been a transgressor - He said, 'Thus said your Lord, 'It is easy for me, and We will certainly make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us.' And it was A decided matter - so she carried him and retreated with him to a far away place - and labor brought her to the trunk of the palm tree. She said, “I wish I had died before this.” And I was forgotten, forgotten} [Maryam:
And the Almighty said: {And she who has maintained her chastity, so We have breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to the worlds} [Al-Anbiya’: 91]

And God Almighty said: {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and she was of The obedient ones} [Al-Tahrim: 12]
The divine books confirm one another.
But your claim is that the Holy Spirit, the essential Spirit of God; (That is, His ancient and eternal life) - something that is contrary to all the books of God and His prophets.
None of them interpreted the Holy Spirit as an attribute of God, neither essential nor non-essential, nor ancient nor non-ancient, and by that they did not want a life God.

So your saying this is a change in the word of God and the words of His prophets and messengers, just as you are saying: The word of God or His knowledge or His life was born of Him, and His ancient and eternal character is His Son - which is what you distorted the words of the prophets, so none of them wanted to This is the meaning of this word at all, and in all the books that you have, the word “the begotten son” has never been applied except to a newly created creature, not to a created being. Something old and eternal, without description, description, knowledge, speech, wisdom, or anything else.

And every birth in the divine books that you have and elsewhere is a birth that occurred in time, and every child is a newly created creation. Temporally, there is no birth in the Scriptures that is ancient and eternal, nor is there a generation that is ancient and eternal, as you mentioned that in your trust and elsewhere.
If what you mentioned were possible in minds, it would not be permissible for you to make it a reality and say: The prophets wanted that, unless They have made it clear that this is what they want.

If their words were clear that they did not want that, and what is reasonable and clear contradicts that, then what you said was a lie to God and to His prophets, His messengers, and His Messiah, and it was false in reason, and you were among those about whom it was said: {And they said, “If only we had heard or reasoned, we would not have been.” Companions of the Blaze} [Al-Mulk: 10]

Then it is said: You said: (Indeed, the Creator Word descended and was joined to Mary, and was hidden by a created human being whom she created for herself) And you said: (Indeed, Mary conceived by the Creator God and gave birth to Him, who is the Son).

So if you allow Mary to be the mother of the Creator, who is the Son, whom she bore and gave birth to - why is it not permissible for her to be the Creator’s wife? Who is the Father, even though the Creator joined with Mary? And you said: God was never without His Word nor His Spirit, nor was the Word ever free from Him, nor from His creative spirit, nor from Its essence.

So you made the Spirit a creator, and God who is the Father a creator, and Christ was incarnated from the creative spirit and from Mary, just as Mary was his mother. The creative spirit is in the same position as its father.
Also, Mary has a connection with the Father and the Holy Spirit, and both of them are fathers to Christ, as you mentioned.

So if Mary was related to every one of those whom you made the father of Christ, and you said: The Creator joined hands with Mary, then this is more eloquent. It will be the Creator’s appointment of Mary’s husband.

No matter how you explain the union of divinity with the humanity of Christ who was created from her, the explanation for the union of divinity with the humanity of Mary so that he becomes a husband Mary is better and more worthy, and there is no deficiency or defect in that except in the fact that divinity is the son of Mary, which is more glaring in its deficiency and defect.

It is known that a man’s mother is more important to him than his wife, and that his authority over his wife is greater than it is over his own mother. He is the owner of the wife, takes care of her, and the woman is a prisoner of her husband, unlike his mother.

So if you make the eternal Creator Godhead the son of Mary’s humanity by virtue of the union with Him being the creator of her through His Godhead and the son of her By his humanity, and this was not objectionable to you nor objectionable, for Mary to be his companion, wife, and wife by virtue of union. With humanity is better and more appropriate.
If this is impossible and reprehensible, then this is even more impossible and reprehensible.
For this reason, groups of Christians said that Mary was the wife of God and his wife, and they said, “More eloquent than that,” until they mentioned his desire for it. To have sex.

Some of the greatest wise kings who were Christians said: When they were alerted to their saying: Jesus is the son of God, they did not understand who That is, except that God’s mother conceived and bore him the Messiah, his son, just as a man causes a woman to become pregnant and bear him a child, so he was separated from God. A part in Mary after He had intercourse with her, and that is the part that is from God and from Mary. Mary gave birth to him, just as a woman gives birth to a child from her. And from her husband, and the believing jinn said: {And indeed, the Almighty is the grandfather of our Lord. He has not taken a companion or a son} [Al-Jinn: 3]
So they kept him away from this and that, and these believing jinn are more perfect in mind and religion than these Christians.
And God Almighty said: {Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He has no companion? And He created all things, and He is All-Knowing of all things} [Al-An’am: 101]
So his saying: (How will he have a son) is his meaning from where will he have a son? So (how) in the language means: where is that from? This is a question of denial.

So, Glory be to Him, made it clear that He is forbidden from having a son, and not having a female companion, even though He is the Creator of everything, and that this child is forbidden. That it is, and that this abstention is established in the clear sense of reason.

Then, when the Word, which is the Creator through whom He was created, dwelt in the womb of Mary and joined itself with Mary, and created from her a man who is She created Christ for herself and was hidden by him and united with him. Was her creation of this man before the union and veilment, or when? That?
After that, it is apparent that there is an absence. It is impossible that she created him after being veiled by it and uniting with him. Rather, she must have created him before him. Or with him.
If it is with Him, then the created thing must always be united with the Creator. Not a moment passes without it being united with Him.

If it is possible for a creature to be compared to its Creator - and according to them, He lived for nine months as a burden like the common people. This was mentioned by Sa’id ibn This penguin - if that were so, then the Lord was united with the embryo and the inanimate object that has no soul.

If this is permissible for him, then it is permissible for him to unite with all inanimate objects, and this is according to the opinion of most who say: The spirit was only breathed into him. After four months, and whoever says: It was breathed into him from the time the body was taken from Mary, and this is similar to the saying of the majority of Christians who They say: Christ died and was crucified, and the speaking spirit that was breathed within him departed from him, and the God united with him never left him. They say:

Since he was united with the humanity of Christ, it has not separated from him. Rather, he is now united with him, and he is in heaven, sitting at the right hand of his Father, and that seat He is the ancient Creator, and the Father is the ancient and eternal Creator God, and yet they are one God.

What is meant here is that they say about the union of divinity with a soulless body before breathing and after death until he rose from his grave. The spirit returned to him, and at that time nothing of the miracles emerged from that embryo.

They prove the divinity of Christ through miracles, even though God was united with him before he showed the miracles, and then there was no The absence of miracles from something requires the assertion that the Lord was not united with it despite the possibility of union.
It is necessary that every inanimate or living thing from which miracles appear must be evidence that the Lord has united with it.

At that time, the calf worshipers are more excused than the Christians, and if there is one among the idol worshipers who says: The idol created the heavens and the earth, then he is more excused. From the Christians; Because the appearance of miracles from foreign animals and inanimate objects is greater than their appearance from a speaking human being, especially the prophets and apostles. For the prophets and apostles are known for the appearance of miracles at their hands, so if they appear at the hands of someone who says: I am a sent prophet, they are proof. On his prophecy, not on his divinity.
And Christ used to say: I am a prophet sent, as was mentioned in the Gospel in more than one place. As for foreign and inanimate animals, they do not He may be a prophet.
If it is permissible to unite the embryo and a grave body that has no soul, then its union with the calf and the idol is better, and in that case he will bellow. The calf is amazing.

The evidence of the worshipers of the calf, that it is a god, is better than the Christians’ reasoning for the divinity of the embryo, if it is destined that some of it appears. The wonders that they may use as evidence.

Even if that only indicates his prophecy - may God bless him and grant him peace - the ninth aspect: His saying: (Then the word was hidden The Creator created a created human being for herself. And he said: “So she was a dwelling place in his coming and withholding her kindness from all that he was kind to.” Of all creatures.)

It will be said to them - first -: From where did you get that the human spirit is gentler than all creatures, and that it is gentler than the angels and the spirit, which God said In it: {The Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in array. They will not speak except to whom the Most Gracious has permitted} [Al-Naba’: 38] And it is gentler than the Spirit which He breathed into. Adam from him by saying: {And I breathed into him of My Spirit} [Al-Hijr: 29] And by desiring to be kinder, you do not say: The veil and union was With the abstract human spirit, but with the thick, bloody human flesh, and it says:
(Indeed, the Creator was joined from the flesh of Mary, and from her womb, which is flesh and blood.)
These are dense bodies. Rather, their majority says: He was united with a body without a soul before the blow, after death, and before he was resurrected. From his grave.

At that time, your saying: (She was a dwelling place for God in His abode and withholding His kindness from all the kindness He bestowed upon all creatures) - is a forbidden description. The reasoning for it is false, for if it were a dwelling place for kindness, it would not be permissible for it to reside except in the gentle soul, since it has proven its union with the body. The dense one, your saying: (He united himself with man because of his kindness) is invalid.
The tenth aspect: Your saying: (And know that nothing of gentle character is seen except in harsh character, and what is gentle of gentle is not seen except with What is more wrong than him?)
It is said to them: Either when God united with Christ among you, people saw him and witnessed him, or no one saw him.
If you say: People saw it and witnessed it, then this is contrary to common sense, law, and reason.

As for the senses, no one who saw Christ saw anything that distinguished Christ from other human beings other than the miracles that appeared on Him. Other than that, some of them were greater than what appeared on them. He only saw the outward body of Christ. He did not see his inward part, nor his heart, nor his liver, nor his spleen. In addition to seeing his own soul, in addition to seeing the angels who inspired him, in addition to seeing God, if it were assumed that he was united With it or immediately in it.
The plaintiff’s claim is that whoever saw Christ has seen God with his own eyes - in the utmost arrogance, arrogance and falsehood, if it were assumed that God resides in it, or is united with it.

It is known that angels descend upon Christ and others and are connected to their spirits, and people do not see angels, but rather jinn. You enter among the children of Adam and people do not see them, but they see the body of the epileptic.
And every human being has with him a companion from the angels, and a companion from the jinn, and he himself does not see that, nor does those around him see it.

And the angels attend him at the time of death, and those around him do not see them, even though he sees them. The Almighty said: {If it had not reached the throat - And you will then look - and We are nearer to it than you are, but you will not see - and unless you are not debtors - you will return it if you are. truthful} [Al-Waqi’ah: 83-87]. If these are the creatures that the people of religion have agreed are related to humans and are in contact with them, and that seeing them is possible, - People do not see it, so how can it be said:

The Messiah is the one whom people have not seen except what they saw of similar messengers like him, such as Abraham and Moses, and he never had anything that distinguished him from The type of apostles, so how can it be said: Those who saw him saw God with their eyes?
As for the law, Moses, Christ, and other prophets told that no one will see God in this world.
As for the mind, seeing some of God’s angels, or some jinn, shows to its seer signs and conditions that would take a long time to describe, so how? In whom did God see?

And those who saw Christ, their condition was only like the condition of all those who saw the messengers, among them was the one who disbelieved in him, and among them was the one who believed in him. Indeed, they mention insulting his humanity that is not known about his counterparts among the apostles, such as beating him and spitting in his face. And putting thorns on his head, and crucifying him, and so on.
Also, it is known that whoever sees God either knows that he is God, or does not know.
If he knew that he had seen God, then those who saw Christ would have known that he was God, and if they had known that, they would have been greatly disturbed. Al-Khattab narrated it.

And if they did not know him, then this is extremely impossible, as the Lord of the worlds did not distinguish between him and other of his creatures, but rather he was As one of them, and one distinguishes between him and them, and the person seeing him does not know that this is God.
The implications of this corrupt statement are very many.

And if they say: God was not seen when he united with Christ, but rather the body of Christ was seen, in which God was hidden. So their saying after that: (And know that nothing of gentle character is seen except in harsh character, and what is gentle among gentle people is not seen except with what It is harsher than him) - useless talk. Since this was a proverb they presented to God to show that it would be seen.
If they accept that he was not seen, then there is no benefit in this proverb, but rather this is evidence of something they know to be false.

Also, what they mentioned - that gentleness is only seen in something thick - is false, for gentleness, like a human soul, cannot be seen in this world, even if its existence is known. A person feels his soul and its attributes, but seeing them with sight is different from this. This is explained by: The eleventh aspect: Their saying: (And indeed, We found the rational, verbal soul of man - they mean the speaking soul - the kindest Of gentle character), and for this reason it was the first of God’s creation to be veiled by God, so it was a veil for Him, and the bloody soul was a veil for it. And the thick body is a veil.

Accordingly, the creative word of God mixed with man’s soul, complete with its body, blood, and rational, verbal spirit, and became The Word of God, with its structure, is a form of the trinity of humanity, whose essence is completed by establishing the texture of the Word of God; Because she was not created, nor was she anything, except by a word from the Word of God who created her and established her, not from anything that preceded that in Mary’s womb. There is no reason for it other than that other than the strength of the creative word, which is one of the divine trinity.
It will be said to them: This statement implies that the Creator was hidden by the rational soul, and the rational soul was hidden by the body.

And you declare that the same Word that is the Creator, and He is God with you, created for Himself a human being with whom it veiled itself, And you said: He is a complete human being with his body, his bloody soul, and his verbal soul, that is, his speaking soul, which is the image of God in man. And the like, it was a dwelling place for God in His abode and concealment.

So you declared that the body and the soul are a dwelling place for God in His abode and concealment, and that He is the one who created that body and the soul, and you said: This is the Creator and Hidden Word, which you said is God, fused with the Virgin Mary.
So if God the Creator was joined to the Virgin Mary, then it is known that that was before the breathing of the speaking soul, which you called the Spirit. Calmanism in Christ.

And if the Creator - the Almighty - joined with a body that had no soul in it, and his joining with it was more effective than his dwelling in it, then he took the body as a veil. Before the verbal spirit was breathed into him, how can it be said: He only resided in the spirit and not in the body, and he joined the body and took a part of it? A dwelling place for him and a veil before the spiritual spirit is breathed into him?
And you also said: Accordingly, the word of God, the Creator of the perfect human soul, was mixed with its body, blood, and rational spirit. Al-Kalamaniyya.
This is a statement that the Creator mixed man with his body, blood, and spirit.
So how do you say: She was veiled by the gentle spirit, even though you declare that the Creator was mingled with flesh and blood?
This also contradicts the statement of those who said: He united with Him in a pure union through mingling.
You have stated here that he was mixed with it, and parallels to this will come in their speech in which they declare the mixing of divinity with humanity.
The twelfth aspect: your statement:

(Other than the entity of the Creating Word, which is one of the divine trinity, that entity is numbered and known to people, because it was joined to it and created for it. He was united to Him from the essence of man, for through the unity of that one substance, He is the substance of the creative word of God, one in the Trinity in essence. His divinity, one of men in the essence of his humanity, not two, but one with the Father and the Spirit, and he is one with all men. With two different essences, from the essence of the Creator Divinity, and the essence of created humanity, with the unity of one substance, the substance of the Word, which is The Son who was born of God before all ages, and he is the same who was born of the Virgin Mary at the end of time, without separation from the Father, nor From the Holy Spirit.

It is said: In this speech, and even in what was mentioned above, there is a lot of contradiction and corruption, and false speech, and speech that The one who said it spoke of it, and he could not imagine what he was saying despite the poor expression of it, such as his saying: (And it is him),

So he places the separate pronoun in the place of the connected pronoun, and attaches one to the other without the conjunction “waw,” and other such things whose meanings are too long to mention. This is because their statement in itself is false and has no truth, and they did not imagine a reasonable meaning and then express it so that it is said: They fell short in Expression: Rather, they are in error and ignorance. They do not think rationally, and they do not know what they are saying. Indeed, they have no belief to stand upon in Christ. Rather, whatever they said about their innovations was false, and they admitted that they did not understand what they were saying.

That is why they say: (This is beyond reason). And they say: (Mankind has united with it without understanding it), so what is not comprehended and what is beyond the mind, no one has the right to believe in it or say it with his opinion.

But if you tell truthful messengers about what man’s mind is incapable of, their truthfulness will be known, and if a transmitter quotes from them what is known frankly The mind is false, it is known that it lies to them, either in wording or meaning, or in one of them.

But if he is saying the statement that he mentions that he knew to be true, or that he interpreted the words of the prophets with it, and he does not imagine what He says it, but does not understand it. This is someone who says against God and His Messengers what he does not know, and this has committed the greatest of forbidden things. The Almighty said: {Say, “Only My Lord has forbidden immoral acts, whether apparent or hidden, and sin and transgression without right, and that you associate with God unless He has sent down any authority for it. And that you say about God what you do not know” [Al-A’raf: 33]
And God Almighty said about Satan: {He only commands you to do evil and immorality and to say about God what you do not know} [Al-Baqarah: 169].
And the Almighty said:

{O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion, and do not say about God except the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is the Messenger of God, and His word which He delivered to Mary and a spirit from him. Believe in God and His messengers, and do not say: “Desist is better for you.” Indeed, God is one God. Glory be to Him, to have a son from Him. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and God suffices as a disposer of affairs. The Messiah will not refrain from being a servant of God, nor will the angels who are close to Him and others. If he refrains from worshiping Him and becomes arrogant, then He will gather them all to Himself - but as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full. And He will increase them of His bounty. But as for those who disdain and were arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will find for themselves, besides Allah, no guardian or helper.} [Women:

The people of religion have agreed that speaking about God without knowledge is forbidden, and God - Glory be to Him - has forbidden them from saying anything about God except the truth. This was a prohibition against them saying falsehood, whether they knew it was false or not.

For if they did not know that it is false, they did not know that it is true either, since falsehood refuses to know that it is true, even if it believes Believing with a corrupt belief that it is the truth, that is not knowledge, so do not say about God what you do not know.
And if they know that it is false, it is better that they not say it.
The majority of Christians are misguided. They do not know that what they say is true. Rather, they say about God what they do not know.
What is meant is that there is a lot of falsehood in their words, such as their saying: (It is through the unity of that one foundation - the foundation of the creative word of God).

For them, Christ is a name for all divinity and humanity, a name for the Creator and the created being, and one of them is united with the other, so by uniting that Strength, strength for the creative word of God.

Whether what is meant by that is that humanity and divinity are the components of divinity, or that humanity is the basis of divinity, and they represent that with the spirit and the body. And fire and iron, so it would be as if it were said: The body and the soul, or the body - are the sustenance of the soul, or fire and iron, or the iron - are the sustenance of For fire.

It is said: The Eternal Creator, who has not ceased and continues to exist. Would the newly created created being be His resurrection? So the newly created created being that lacks God in every way is a support for the Creator who needs Him in every way? Is this just one of the manifestations of the abstaining role?

For it is known, with clear reason and the agreement of wise people, that created beings have no sustenance except through the Creator, and if the Creator is their sustenance With the created thing, it is necessary that both the Creator and the created thing be the other’s sustenance, so each of them is in need of the other, since they are Something is sustained by it, for it needs it.

Although this implies that the Creator needs his creation, which is clear disbelief, his refusal is clearly demonstrated. Reason, and this is necessary for the Christians, whether they say in unity, or in solutions without unity, even if their three groups say in a kind of Union, because with union, each of the united people is necessary for the other, for he is in need of him just as they are represented by him in the spirit and the body. And fire with iron.
The soul that is in the body needs the body, just as the fire in iron needs iron.
The same applies to the solutions, for every situation needs a solution, and it is clear disbelief, as its abstention is demonstrated by a clear mind.

If that created being is determined to exist by itself, it is ancient and eternal, then it is not a created being. However, it is impossible for everyone to exist. The two eternal beings are in need of the other, whether it is determined that he is its agent, the complete agent of it, or he lacks it in some way. faces; Because if it lacked it in any way, it would not exist without it.

An existing thing cannot exist except through the existence of what is necessary for it, and its existence is not complete except through it. Everything that was determined to be in need of it did not exist. It exists only through Him.

If each of the two ancients is in need of the other, it is necessary for this to not exist except by the creation of that by which the need of the other is fulfilled. And this does not exist except by creating something through which the need of the other is fulfilled.

The Creator cannot be a Creator until He exists, and He does not exist except by the necessities of His existence, so it is necessary that this does not exist until The other makes it exist, and that does not exist until the other makes it exist, since his making of what did not complete its existence ceases. His existence is upon Him, so He cannot exist except through Him, so there is no difference between one of them needing the other in His existence, or in what His existence is not complete without Him. With it, and this is the tribal role that is abstained by the agreement of wise people.

As for the specific role, it is that this does not exist except with this, and this does not exist except with this, like fatherhood with sonship, and as the attributes The Lord is one with another, and His attributes are with Himself, for He is not a Knower except with the fact that He is All-Powerful, and He is not a All-Knowing and All-Powerful except with the fact that He is alive. He is not alive except with the fact that He is All-Knowing and Powerful, and His attributes do not exist except by Himself, and His essence does not exist except with His attributes, so this It is permissible in the two creatures that lack the Creator who creates them all, such as fatherhood and sonship, and it is permissible in the everlasting Lord. Because of His attributes.

But if two eternal beings, masters and agents, were created, then it would be impossible for one of them to be in need of the other, since its existence could not be complete except through what Its existence requires it, and it cannot be the agent of anything if its existence is not complete, so with the deficiency of each of them it is impossible for its complete existence to be. Providing for the sake of something else the entire existence of that other, and for this reason none of the nations said this.
But what the Christians said is that they made the Creator - the Almighty - the creation.

It will be said to them: This too is more impossible in clear reason than the refusal of each of the creators to support the other, even if this is also the case. Abstaining, because the created being lacks the Creator in all its affairs, so it is abstaining, despite its poverty in its existence and the completeness of its existence, from the Creator. The Creator’s sustenance is through him; Because that requires that it be its subsistence, and that the completeness of its existence be through Him, so that nothing of it exists except through the Creator.

The destiny by which it is said: the Creator resides with it - is from the Creator, and the Creator is his Creator and the Creator of every created being, so there is no existence or resurrection for him except By the Creator, so how can the Creator be established through him?

This is not like substance and its necessary symptoms, or like matter and form according to those who claim that form is substance if they are connected. This is out of the context of the role of God, like prophecy with paternity, and this is permissible as mentioned above, since the Creator of them all is God.
As for the fact that each of them is the Creator, it is impossible, and with the fact that one of them is the Creator and the other is a creature, it is even more impossible.

And the Lord - the Almighty - is self-sufficient in every way, and everything else is in need of Him in every way, and this is the meaning of His name, “the Eternal One.” The steadfastness to which everything endures; Because of his lack of it, and he is rich in everything, he does not endure anything, and he does not ask it for anything - Glory be to Him, the Most High - so how can he be sustained by anything? Of the creatures?

This special union of Christians is similar - in some ways - to what the people of unity and the general union say, who say as he says Ibn Arabi, author of “Al-Fusus” and “Al-Futuhāt al-Makkiyya”: The essence of created beings are fixed in nothingness, and the presence of the Truth overflows upon them, so they are It lacks it in terms of general co-existence, which is its existence, and it lacks it in terms of objects fixed in nothingness, which is what It is unique to every eye, so it makes each of the Creator and created beings in need of the other.
They say: Existence is one, then they prove the multiplicity of entities, and they say: They are appearances and spheres.

If the appearance and appearance are not apparent, then multiplicity is established, and if it is it, then there is no multiplicity, and for this they are forced into contradiction as Christians are forced to do this, as they affirm unity with multitude, and chant: (He will worship Me, and I will worship Him, and He will praise Me, and I will praise Him). These people based their statement on two corrupt principles.

One of them: that the essence of possible things is fixed in nothingness, as those of the theologians say: The non-existent is something fixed in nothingness, and this The saying is corrupt according to the masses of rational people.

The reality of the matter is that the non-existent is intended to be created, imagined, informed of, and written down before its existence, so it has existence in science. And speech and writing, and as for the outside, it does not exist.
Existence is stability. There is no proof of it in external concrete existence, but rather its proof is in knowledge. That is, the world knows it before it exists.

The second principle: They made the very existence of the Lord of the Worlds, the Creator, the Ancient, Eternal, and Necessary, the same as the existence of the Lord. The created thing is possible, as Ibn Arabi said: And whoever knows what we have established in numbers, and that negating them is the same as proving them, knows that the truth The exalted is the likeable creation. So the matter belongs to the Creator, He is the created thing, and the created matter is the Creator, all of that is from one eye, nay, it is the one eye, It is the many eyes, and it is: (O my father, do as you are commanded). Until he said: And he slaughtered no one but himself: And he slaughtered no one but himself.

And he said: Among His beautiful names is Al-Ali, the Most High, over whom is He Most High, and who is He but Him? Or about what is Ali, and there is no one but Him? His sublimity is due to Himself, and from the standpoint of existence He is the essence of existing things, so what are called created things are causality in and of themselves and are nothing other than Him.
It was reported on the authority of Abu Sa`id al-Kharraz that he was told: How did you know your Lord?
He said: By combining opposites, and he read his saying: {He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is Knower of all things} [Al-Hadid: 3].
What he meant by that is that He unites in His right - Glory be to Him - what is contradictory in the right of others, for the created being is not first and last, hidden and apparent.

It has been proven in the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he used to say: “You are the first, so there is nothing before you, and you are the last, so there is nothing after you.” “You are the Manifest, and there is nothing above You, and You are the Hidden, and there is nothing below You.”) Then this atheist came and explained Abu Sa’id’s saying that The created thing is the Creator. He said:

Abu Sa`id said: It is one of the faces of truth, and one of its tongues. He speaks on his own authority that God is not known except by combining Opposites in judging him by them, he is the first and the last, the apparent and the hidden, so he is the same as what is apparent and he is the same as what is hidden in a state.
