His appearance, and no one else sees it, and no one is hidden from it except Him, so He is apparent to Himself but hidden from Himself, and He is called Abu Saeed Al-Kharraz, and other names of hadith scholars, and for this reason some Christians said to someone who says something like this and narrates it on the authority of his sheikhs: And he says:
He is a Muslim (You have declared us unbelievers because we said: God is the Messiah, and your sheikhs say: God is Abu Sa’id al-Kharaz. And the Messiah is better than Abu Saeed.)
These people answer the Christians with an answer that makes it clear that they are greater atheists than the Christians.
So they say to the Christians: (You have identified it with Christ, and we say: He is the existence of everything. We do not specify Christ.
That is why some of them said to Ahdhaq, “Al-Tilmisani,” nicknamed Al-Afif: You are a Nusayri.

He said: Nusayr is a part of me. The Nusayris, the followers of Abu Shuaib “Muhammad bin Nusayr,” say about Ali bin Abi Talib the same as what the Christians say about the Messiah. All the extremists regarding Ali, or one of his family members, or among the Ismailis, Banu Ubaid, who are affiliated with Muhammad bin Ismail bin Jafar, like Al-Hakim and others,
Or in Al-Hallaj, or in some of the sheikhs who say about one of these that theology is united with it or is absorbed into it, in accordance with what you say. Christians in Christ.
These people say that the solution and union are created, and that the ancient was dissolved or united with the new, after they were not united.

As for those who say of absolute unity, their investigators say: It is the existence of everything. They do not say of the union of two existences, nor do they say of the existence of everything. By substituting one into the other.
Rather, they may say: Existence is the confirmation of the existence of truth and the stability of things, united, and each of them lacks the other.
When the truth appears, it is a slave, and when the slave is hidden, it is a master.

And they say: If self-transfiguration occurs to you, which is this, then idol worship or anything else will not harm you. Rather, they declare that it is the same. Idols and equals, and that no one worshiped anyone but Him, as Ibn Arabi says, correcting Noah’s unbelieving people: And they plotted a great plan. He said: Because the call to God is deceitful to the one who is called, because he was non-existent from the beginning, so he is called to the end (invite to God), so this is the same. Deception, so they answered him (deception), just as he called them (deception), so they said in their deception: {Forsake not your gods, nor forsake Wad, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq. And an eagle} [Noah:
23] If they abandon them, they will be as ignorant of the truth as these people have neglected.

For the Truth has a face in every deity, which is recognized by whoever knows it, and whoever is ignorant of it is ignorant of it, as He said regarding the Muhammadans: {And your Lord has decreed that you should not worship Him. Except Him} [Al-Isra: 23]. ; That is to say, God has not judged anything but it happens. The one who knows knows who he worshiped, and in what form he appeared as a servant, and that separation and multiplicity are like members in the tangible form. Like the moral powers in spiritual forms, no one is worshiped except God in every deity.
This atheist corrected Pharaoh when he said: I am your Lord, the Most High.

He said: Since Pharaoh was in the position of ruler at the time, and he was the caliph by the sword, even if he adhered to legal custom, that is why he said: I Your Lord is the Most High. ; That is, if all are lords to a certain degree, then I am superior to them because of what I have been given in the apparent sense of ruling over you.

He said: When the magicians learned that Pharaoh was telling the truth in what he said, they did not deny it, but they acknowledged that to him and said to him: This life will only be spent. The world. So judge as you are able to judge. The state is yours.
He said: Pharaoh’s statement was correct: I am your Lord, the Most High. Even if Pharaoh is the eye of truth.

He also corrected the people of the calf in their worship of the calf, and claimed that Moses was satisfied with that, and he said: And since Moses knew about the matter from Aaron Because of his knowledge that God had decreed that we should worship none but Him, and that God had not decreed anything but it happened, his censure was on Aaron for denying him and not Its breadth, for the knower is he who sees the truth in everything, but rather he who sees it with the eyes of everything.
Among these is a group who do not say that objects remain in nothingness, but rather they say: There is no existence except the existence of the Truth.

But they differentiate between the absolute and the specific, and they say: It is the absolute existence prevailing in specific existents, such as the constant animality in all An animal, and the constant humanity in every human being, and this is called the natural whole.
They call this existence: encompassing, and they say: it is absolute existence, either on the condition of being free from any restriction, and this is called universality. The mental.

According to most wise people, this only exists in the mind and not externally, but it is said about the Shiites of Plato that they proved this. Universalities that are abstract from external objects, and they said: They are ancient, eternal, absolutely human, and absolutely animal, They call them Platonic ideals and suspended ideals.

Their brothers, Aristotle, his followers, and the majority of wise people responded to this, and explained that this is only imagined in minds, not Existing in objects, as the mind imagines, as absolute numbers and absolute quantities, such as a point, a line, a surface, and an educational body. And other such things that the mind can conceive, but nothing of that applies to fixed existing things outside.

These people believe that this absolute condition is external, and they may call it envelopment, which is existence devoid of meaning. All restrictions, then after it is absolute existence without condition, which is the general thing that is divided into obligatory and possible.
To old and new and the like, like the division of an animal into speaking and non-speaking.

This absolute noun is not subject to a condition that exists outside, for the singular noun is applied to it, so it is said: This is an animal, this is a human being, even if it is The general name includes its types and people, but it is not found outside except a specific name.

Whoever says: It exists completely outside, has made a mistake, because the universal is never universal except in minds, not in objects, and not in The outside world, except for a specific thing. If he imagines, his very imagination prevents the company from taking place in it, but the mind assumes the overall common destiny. Between the specifics, it is completely shared in the minds.
These people consider this necessary existence, and they may make it after this, so they say: This is the difference between the necessary.

This is total existence when it is said: There is nothing outside except a specific entity, so there is nothing outside except specific existents. The person is diagnosed, including the characteristics that are present in her.
If its presence is estimated outside, then it is either a part of the aids, or an attribute of them.
In the first place, there is no one outside who is the Lord of specific entities.
According to the second, the Lord of existing beings is their part or attribute.

It is known with clear reason that the attribute of a thing that is based on it does not create the thing described, and that a part of a thing does not create the thing, but rather a part A thing is a part of something.
If He is the Creator of the whole, then He is the Creator of Himself, and He is the Creator of all of something.

Among these people are those who say: The Lord is in the world like butter in milk, fat in sesame, and the like, so they make Him a part of the world. The creature. The same perception of this is sufficient to know that it is corrupt.

But these people say to those who follow them: If you do not abandon reason and transmission, you will not have achieved the realization and manifestation that happened to us. And they say: We have proven in revelation what contradicts clear reason.

So I said to some of them: The prophets - may God’s prayers and peace be upon them - are the most complete people in revelation, and they tell what people’s minds are unable to comprehend. Knowing Him, not by what is known in their minds to be false, so they are informed of the puzzles of minds, not of the impossibility of minds.
If someone less than them tells about witnesses and a revelation, he knows with a clear mind that it is false - he knows that his revelation is false.
But if it is not known that it is false, then this may be correct, or it may be wrong. Because none other than the prophets are infallible.

These people heard the name of God and intended to worship Him and know Him, and they followed Him in His works, so they thought that it was He who had heard By the sun, when he saw the ray spread out in the air and the earth, he thought that it was the sun, and his sight and insight did not ascend to The sun in the sky.
Likewise, these people did not direct the visions of their hearts to the Lord of the worlds, who is above all things and distinguishes between His creatures.

The secret of this is that they witness with their hearts an absolute, simple existence that has no special name, such as the Living, the All-Knowing, and the Almighty. It has no characteristic, and nothing is distinguished from anything else, and this is common existence.

But this witness is in their souls, it has no reality on the outside, and many of those he addresses cannot imagine what they are witnessing, so they think Because he did not understand what they witnessed.

I addressed more than one of them, and explained to him that this they are witnessing is in the mind, and is destined to be present in The outside, it is a characteristic of existing things, or a part of them, and they think, despite their belief that it exists outside, that it does not remain in outside what they have witnessed, for they are absent from the sense that perceives the objects, and they are absent from their minds from imagining them, so that they do not distinguish Between existing and existing, and they say:

There is separation in sense, then they witness this absolute existence despite their isolation of sense, and they think that this absolute is the same. The specifics, and that it does not exist at all.

It will be said to them: If it were decreed that total existence is completely constant outside, and that you witnessed that, then it is known to every rational person that The existence of the common universal does not contradict the existence of the specific specific.
Animality and absolute common humanity do not contradict the features of animals and the features of man, and in that case the features of animals are proven. Assets acquired abroad.
Suppose that you were absent from this and did not witness it, then absence from the witnesses of a thing does not necessitate its absence in itself.

So if the servant did not witness a thing, or did not want it, or did not know it, or it did not occur to his heart, or he failed to witness it, or It became non-existent, or was absent. It does not necessitate that the thing in itself became non-existent, mortal and has no reality. Rather, the difference between non-existence and non-existence is constant. The thing is in itself, and it decays and disappears, and between the absence of man's witnesses to it, his remembrance, and his knowledge.

And these people - out of their misguidance - think that if their witnesses to existing things cease to exist, then they themselves would perish, so there is no existent except What they imagined of absolute existence.

They say: Multiplicity and division are in the senses. If the heart’s witnesses cease from the senses, then neither division nor multiplicity will remain. They think that The sense witnesses in that case are wrong, and the mind is the one who witnesses universals and absolutes without the sense, so if they invalidate what the sense has witnessed, Nothing remained with them except total existence.

Then they think that He is God, and the Lord remains with them an illusion and a fantasy in their souls, with no reality on the outside, as he said. Some of their clever people are Al-Tustari, the companion of Ibn Sab’een: (And your concern is to identify what is beneath it as something) and he said: You see existence as one and you That...and there is nothing more on you than you. And I said to some of their clever people: Suppose that this absolute existence is constant outside, and that it is a certain entity. The things that are witnessed, so how do you know that this is the Lord of the worlds who created the heavens and the earth and everything?
He admitted this and said: This is a trick.

And the inner or apparent sense, if it is not coupled with the mind that distinguishes between the sensible and other things, and unless error of some kind enters into it. He enters upon the sleeper, the one who is passing by, the one who is in mourning, and others who judge by mere sense, which has no reason.

And the animals may be better guided than these, as God Almighty said: {And We have created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts that cannot They understand with it, but they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. They are like cattle, nay, they are more astray. It is they who are The heedless} [Al-A’raf: 179].

These people clearly reject hearing and reason, so they included in his saying: “Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are only Like cattle, nay, they are more astray from the path} [Al-Furqan: 44]. They commit themselves to being absent from the mind, the apparent sense, and the law. That is why the most intelligent of them, Al-Tilmisani, says: So say to your senses that they are absent. Find yourself and melt joyfully... in it and say, when the mind is gone, do not be still and be silent until you see it speaking in you...

If you find someone saying, then say, “And these people,” to extend the speech to another place. What is meant here is that the Christians claimed that theology needs To the humanity with which He was united, and these people claimed that the Lord of the Worlds needs all other entities fixed in nothingness.

For everyone who says: The Lord of the worlds is united with others, each of those united lacks the other, despite the impossibility of each of them, and the change in Its reality, nor are the reasonable solutions, for the solutions are not reasonable unless the situation exists and the place needs it, whether that is what is intended. The solutions of attributes and symptoms in descriptions and essences, or by that I mean the solutions of entities.
The fact that one of the two bodies is a substitute for the other, like the solution of water in a container, necessitates its lack of it.

Whatever dwells in the hearts of believers of knowing the Lord and believing in Him is present in their hearts and is in need of it, and so is what philosophers prove of Cytoplasm and the image, and they say: The cytoplasm is a place for the image, and they acknowledge - however - that the image needs the cytoplasm.

Those who believe in the unity of existence may place the Creator with created beings like the image with matter, as Ibn Sabi’ refers to and says: There is water in water, and in fire there is fire, and in everything there is the form of that thing, as the words have been extended to these people in places other than this. The book.

And when they say: The Lord has dwelt in Christ as He has dwelt in others, and this is the solution found in the words of David among them, where they said: You dwell in the hearts of the saints, for it is known that this is the solution of faith in Him, knowledge of Him, guidance, light, and scientific example, as was explained in a place Another, and for this reason it is called radiance, and the ray that is on the earth and the air is a width based on that, and it lacks the earth and the air.

And the Messengers - may God’s prayers be upon them - told that God is above the world in various expressions. Sometimes they say: He is the Most High and He is the Most High. And sometimes they say: He is in heaven, as in His saying: Or do you believe that He who is in heaven will send against you a reaper?

What they mean by that is not that God is in the depths of the heavens, or that God is confined by any of the creatures. Rather, all of the words of the Messengers confirm one another. As the Almighty said: Glory be to your Lord, Lord of glory above what they describe, and peace be upon the messengers, and praise be to God, Lord of the worlds. The Almighty said: {He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of all things} [Al-Hadid: 3].

It is proven in the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “You are the first, so there is nothing before you, and you are the last, so there is nothing after you. And You are the Manifest, and there is nothing above You, and You are the Hidden, and there is nothing below You.” So he informed that nothing would be above Him.

For this reason, more than one of the imams of the predecessors said: He descends to the lowest heaven, and the throne is not devoid of Him, so He does not become below the creatures and in He has never been inside it, but being high above it is an attribute necessary for Him wherever a created being is found, so the Lord can only be high above Him.

And when the Messengers said: (in the heavens), that is, in the height, they do not mean that it is in the interior of the spheres, but rather the heaven is the height, and when it is above the throne, He is the Most High, the Most High, and there is no created being so that the Lord is confined to any of the created things, nor is He in an existing region. Rather, He is not Existing except the Creator and the created being, and the Creator is separate from His creatures, He is superior to them, so He is not in any created thing at all, whether it is called that. The creature is a direction, or it is not named a direction.
Whoever says: It is in an existing area that towers over it, surrounds it, or needs it in any way, is wrong.

Just as whoever says: There is no Lord above the heavens, nor is there a god on the throne, and Muhammad will not be taken up to his Lord, nor will the angels ascend to him, nor The scriptures come down from it, and nothing comes near it, and it does not approach anything - so he too is a sinner.

And whoever calls what is above the world a region, and makes pure nothingness a region, and says that he is in a region - in this sense - that is, he himself is above everything; This is a correct meaning.
Whoever denies this meaning by saying: Not in any direction has made a mistake.
Rather, the way to be firm is that what the Messengers confirmed to God is confirmed to Him, and what the Messengers denied to God is denied to Him.

And the words that the Messengers did not utter in denial or affirmation, such as the words “direction” and “space” and the like, do not refer to negation or affirmation. Except after clarifying what is intended.
Whoever intends by what has been proven to be a correct meaning, then he is correct in the meaning, even if there is a mistake in the pronunciation.
Whoever intended a correct meaning by what he denied, then he was correct in the meaning, even if there was a mistake in his wording.

As for the one who confirms with his words a truth and a falsehood, or denies with his words a truth and a falsehood, both of them are correct in what they meant by the truth, and wrong in what they meant. From falsehood, he mixed truth with falsehood, and combined truth and falsehood in his words.
And all the prophets agree that He is on high.
There is nearly a thousand evidence of this in the Qur’an and Sunnah, and in the words of the previous prophets there is countless.
[Chapter: Continuing the story of the penguin’s words about the Christians and discussing it in that]

Sa`id ibn al-Batriq said: This is like the ray born from the eye of the sun whose light fills what is between the sky and the earth with light, and in A house in which there is radiance with its light without any comparison to the eye of the sun from which it was truly born; Because He was not cut off from the eye or from the light, so God dwells in humanity without the Father separating from Him. He is with humanity, and He Truly with the Father and the Holy Spirit.

It is said: This representation, even if it is assumed to be correct, is similar in some ways to the statement of someone who says: It is by itself in every place. Like a ray of the sun that appears in the air and the earth.

As for the Christians, they characterize him as the humanity of Christ to the exclusion of all other humanities, even if this is represented by someone who says: He is in Himself in every place - It would have been false, so what about the Christians? Light only exists in the air and the surface of the earth, not under ceilings, roofs, or the interior of the earth.

Then this representation is false from several aspects: One of them is that the ray is not generated from the body of the sun, nor is the ray of fire generated from the body of fire, but rather it is an accident. It is not clear from the sun's body, but it is a cause of its occurrence.
For this reason, it is likened to the knowledge that occurs in the heart of the learner as a result of learning knowledge without it being of the same knowledge as the scholar.
For this reason, the knowledge of the scholar is likened to a lamp whose light everyone receives, and it has not diminished.
In contrast to the newborn being born from his father, he is born from his eye.
The beam that exists in the air and the earth is not the same as the sun and fire, but rather it is a width that exists in another place, and a single width does not It is in two places.

And the Christians say: The word, which is God’s knowledge or wisdom, is generated from Him, and it is ancient and eternal, and the attribute is eternal. By what is described, the attribute is like the roundness and light that surrounds the sun itself, so that is an attribute of it, and it is not the ray that is in the air. That is clear from it, so how can this be made this?
If they say: What we mean is that God’s wisdom, knowledge, and light sent it down to Christ and poured it out onto Christ, just as a beam spills over The sun.
They were told: This is a common destiny between Christ and the other prophets, so Christ has no jurisdiction over this.

The second aspect: Their saying: The one whose light fills what is between the sky and the earth with light, and in any of the houses there is truth in it without comparison. To the eye of the sun from which he was truly born.
Then it will be said to them: The ray that is between the sky and the earth is the light, and it is the light.

So your saying: The ray of light fills what is between the sky and the earth with light, implies that it is a ray and the light of a ray, and light occurred from that, This is a mistake. Rather, there is nothing here except the body of the sun that is in the sky and its rays, which is the light and the light that is between the sky and the earth.

Third: Your saying: (without departing from the eye of the sun) implies that this ray is the same as what struck the sun, and this is an exaggeration of the sense. And the mind, rather, the ray that created the air and the earth is an accident that did not originate with the sun only.

Every ray is a spot, so it is not the same as the ray in the other spot, even though it is its counterpart and like it, and the type of ray brings them together. Just as the ray of this lamp is not the ray of this lamp, even if they are mixed together to make the light stronger, nor is the movement of this air the same. The movement of this air, and there are many analogues of this.
Fourth: Your saying: (Likewise, God resides in humanity without the Father separating from Him) is a false representation.
For the sun itself was not in the air or the earth, but its rays remained still.
It is appropriate to say: Thus did God’s light, His proof, His guidance, and His Spirit dwell.
And if you say this, it is transmitted from the prophets, whose books say that the light, spirit, and guidance of God are in the hearts of believers, but Christ has no authority in this matter.

God Almighty said: {Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth. The likeness of His light is like a niche in which is a lamp. The lamp is in a bottle. The glass is as if it were a star. Pearly} [An-Nur: 35].
Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: Like his light in the heart of the believer.

And in Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Abu Saeed, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “Fear the eyes of the believer, for he sees with the light of God, and then He read his saying: “Indeed, in that are signs for those who seek success” [Al-Hijr: 75] »
Fifth: If you make God Himself dwell in Christ, then His weight is for the sun itself to be dwelling in a small place in the world. The earth.

This representation invalidates your statement: God is the highest, the greatest, the most exalted, and the greatest. God is the Most Majestic, the Greatest, and the Greatest of all things, and the sun is one of His signs and one of His creatures. And despite this, if someone said: The sun It resided in the womb of a woman and came out of that woman’s vagina. Every rational person would know the immorality of his statement and attribute it to ignorance. The great or the crazy, whether he said: The sun itself descended or it did not descend.
And you say: Indeed, the Lord of the Worlds resides in the womb of Mary, and most of you say - such as the Mulkiyya and Al-Yaqoubiyyah - that He emerged from her vagina. Maryam.

And if someone were to say about what is one of the smallest of God’s creatures, such as one of the planets, or one of the mountains, or a great rock: that is It was in the stomach of a woman and came out of her vagina - people laughed at what he said, so how about someone who claims like that in the Lord of the worlds? !

And if they say: God descended to the lowest heaven, or descended to the mountain and spoke to Moses from the bush or in the pillar of clouds, and the like - then it is not in Something of this is that he was united with a created being, neither a sky nor a bird nor a tree, nor was his speech based on anything created, not a tree or anything else.
According to them, he was united with Christ, and the voice of Christ speaking to him was the voice of the Lord of the worlds, without intermediary.

chapters.title: Chapter responding to the Christians’ comparison of the Word of God’s presence in humanity to writing on paper
paragraphs: [Chapter: The response to the Christians’ comparison of the Word of God’s incorporation into humanity by writing on paper.]

Saeed bin Al-Batriq said: And just as a person’s word born from his mind is written on paper, in the paper it is all truly from Unless it separates from the mind from which it was born, and the mind from which it was born does not separate from it. Because the mind is known by the word; Because it is in Him, and the whole word is in the mind that gave birth to it, and all of it is in itself, and all of it is in the paper with which it is bound, and so it is. The word of God is wholly in the Father from whom it was born, and wholly in itself and in the Spirit, and wholly in the humanity in which it dwelt and was joined to Him. It is said:
This representation is an argument against you and the corruption of your speech, but there is no proof for you, and this appears in many ways.

One of them: That it be said: If the indwelling of the Word of God, which is Christ, is in humanity, like writing the words on paper, then Christ is one of them. All of the words of God, such as the Torah, the Psalms of David, the Gospel, the Qur’an, and other things, for this is all the word of God, and it is written in The writings are by the agreement of the people of religion. Rather, all of creation is agreed that the words of every speaker are written on the writings. And God Almighty said in the Qur’an: {Rather, It is a glorious Qur’an - on a preserved tablet} [Al-Buruj: 21-22].

And God Almighty said: {Indeed, it is a noble Qur’an - in a hidden Book - which none shall touch except the purified} [Al-Waqi’ah: 77-79]. And he said: {He recites purified pages in which are valuable books} [Al-Bayyinah: 2] And he said: {No, it is a reminder, so whoever wishes may mention it in honorable, raised pages. Purified by the hands of honorable and righteous travelers} [Abs: 11] And God Almighty said: {And the Mount and a Book written on parchment spread out} [At-Tur: 1]

And if the Word which is Christ is like this to you, then it is known that the word of God written on the papers is not a Creator God, but He is A lot of words that are not limited to one or two words.
And if someone said: O Word of God, forgive me and have mercy on me, or O Torah,
Or O Gospel, or O Qur’an, forgive me and have mercy on me. He had spoken falsehood in the eyes of all people of religion and rational people.
And you say: Christ is a Creator God, and He is called and worshipped, so how do you liken Him to the word of God written on papers?
Second: Written speech is an attribute of the speaker. It is performed and written on calligraphy by the predecessors of the people of religion and their audiences.
For some of them, it is a created accident, which they create in others.
Everyone agrees that speech is an attribute that exists on its own, not an essence that exists on its own.
And Christ - with you - his divinity is an essence existing in itself, and he is a true God from a true God, and he - with you - is a perfect God and a perfect human being.
So how do you make God who is an eye that exists by itself like an attribute that does not exist except by something else?
Third: Your saying: (A person’s word is born from his mind), if it were true, then generation would only be an accident.
And you say: The ancient and eternal Word of God came from Him before the ages, and you say - along with this -: He is God.

This, as its invalidity is known to a clear mind, is an innovation and a misguidance in the law, for none of the prophets named any of the things. The attributes of God are His son, and He does not say: His attribute is generated from Him. The word “Son” is not found among you regarding the prophets except as a name for created humanity, not for the ancient attribute of God, for you have changed the words of the prophets. With this slander.

Fourth: Your saying: (born from his mind), if you mean (with his mind) the eye existing by itself, which he calls heart, soul, and soul, or A speaking soul is created by meanings, while words are created by his mouth and tongue.

And if you want (with his mind) a source of intellect that intellects intellect, then the source is an incident that subsists with the intellect, and it is an incident of the same type as knowledge and the word. And good deeds.
And if you mean by reason the instinct that is in man, then it is also a symptom.

Fifth: That your calling “man speaking in meaning or wording by birth” is something you invented. It is not known about any of the prophets, nor A nation among the nations, nor in any of the languages.
But you invented this to say: If the speech of man is generated from him, then the speech of God is generated from him.
None of the prophets said that the word of God was generated by him, nor that he was his son, nor that his knowledge was generated by him, nor that he was his son.

Sixth: Your saying: (The word of a person born from his mind is written on paper, so it is on the paper entirely in truth, without It separates from the mind from which it was born), until you say: (The entire word is in the mind that gave birth to it, and all of it is in the paper with which it was bound) - Clear arrogance, known corruption in the clear mind, for the presence of speech in the heart and tongue is not the same as its presence written in Not the paper, but rather the one standing in the heart of the speaker. Meanings:

Seeking, news, knowledge, and will, and what exists in itself are composed letters that are disjointed sounds, or they are the boundaries of disjointed sounds, and it is not in the heart. Man does not have ink in his mouth like the ink on paper.

The words are written on the paper, according to the agreement of the wise people, even though they know that there is no existing knowledge, request, or news on the paper, as you do. In the hearts of the speaker, and there are no disjointed, composed sounds in it, nor letters like the sounds in the speaker’s mouth. Rather, the wording of the letter is said according to The written letter: either the pictured ink, or the image and shape of the ink. It is said about the spoken letter: either the dissociated sound, or the pitch of the sound, its syllable, and its form.

Every rational person distinguishes with his senses and reason between the sound heard from the speaker and the ink that is visible with sight, and no rational person says: This is It is this, and it is not said: This and this is the same meaning that resides in the heart of the speaker. So how can you say: The word is in all of the paper? And it is all in the mind that generated it, and it is all in itself?
Seventh: The letter (fi), which grammarians call an adverb, is used in every place with the meaning appropriate to that place.
If it is said: Taste, color and smell are present in the fruit, or knowledge, power and speech are present in the speaker, then this is a reasonable meaning.
If it is said: This is present in his house, or that the water is present in the circumstance, then this has another meaning.

This is the occurrence of an attribute in its description, and this is the occurrence of an existing entity called a body and a substance in its place. From it, the place of the people is called: the camp, and it is said: so-and-so lived in such-and-such place.

And if it is said: The sun and the moon are in the water, or in the mirror, or the face of so-and-so in the mirror, or the words of so-and-so on this piece of paper, then this is his. A meaning that people can understand. They know that the sun, the moon, and the face appeared in the mirror and were seen in it, and that no soul came to it. That is, but there is a radial example in it for those who say that.

Likewise, if a speech is written on paper, people know that it is written on it, read on it, and seen on it, and they say: I looked at it. So-and-so’s words, and I read them, and contemplated them, and understood them, and saw them, and the like, as they say: I saw his face in the mirror and contemplated it, and the like. That.

In all of that, they are truthful and know what they say, and they know that the same body of the sun, the moon, and the face does not appear in the mirror, and that The meanings and sounds that he did were not done by the paper, rather the mirror was an intermediary in seeing the face, so that is what is meant. By seeing, and the paper was a mediator in knowing the words, so it is what is meant by seeing, and they know that the sense of sight perceived what is in it. A mirror is a part of the reflected ray, but what is meant by vision is the sun, and the sense of sight perceives the written ink on the parchment. But what is meant by the vision is the written word.

They know that the same likeness that is in the mirror is not the face, and that the same ink with which it is written is not the written word, but They differentiate between them, as God Almighty said: {Say, “If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We have brought the like of it as a reinforcement.} [Al-Kahf: 109]
So, Glory be to Him, differentiated between the words and the ink with which the words are written.
So how can it be said: This is that, when the word is in the entire piece of paper, and it is in the speaker in its entirety?

Eighth: The word has a meaning in the speaker, which is expressed by his word, and the word is written on the paper, so what is written on the paper is the word. What matches the meaning, the meaning is not written without writing the word that was written in calligraphy; So that what was written might be known.
These people claimed that the same meaning that is in the whole heart is in all the paper - making the same meaning the calligraphy, and this is false.
Ninth: There is no doubt that the speaker’s words are said to be based on them.

It is said - however -: It is written on paper, and it is said: These are the words of so-and-so in particular, and this is that, and similar things. Phrases that show that this written on the paper is the exact words that the speaker spoke, and he did not add anything to it or add anything to it. It decreases, no words other than it have been written.
They do not mean by this that the same handwriting is the same sound, or the same meaning, for no rational person would say this.

If it is said: Then among Muslims there are those who say: The Word of God, the Ancient and Eternal, or the Word of God who is not a created being, is present in the breasts and the Qur’an. Without paradox.
Among these are those who say: He hears from man the ancient voice, or the voice that is not created.
Among them are those who say: The ancient letter, or the letter that is not created, is in the paper, and it was reported that some of them say that in the ink.
Among these people are those who say: The ancient has been found in the Qur’an, and so on.
So the Christians say: We are like these people.
It was said: The answer is in many ways.
One of them: that the purpose is to explain the truth with which God sent His messengers, and with which He sent down His books, and to refute the Christians who differ from that. And others.

We do not deny that among those affiliated with Islam there are sects, some of whom are hypocrites, atheists and heretics, and some of them are ignorant and heretical. And among them are those who say like the Christians, and among them are those who say worse than that, so the response is to all of these, and infallibility is established for the Book of God. And the Sunnah of His Messenger.
And what His faithful servants agreed upon. This is only the truth, and whatever the Muslims dispute about, there is truth and falsehood in it.
The second aspect: That it may be said: These are the ones who said in the Qur’an what they said. Their saying is not like the saying of the Christians.

For the Christians assigned to God an ancient and eternal son, whom they called the Word, and said: He is a God who creates and provides, and that He was united with Christ, so they made Christ - who is the Word to them - is a God who creates and provides.
There is no one among the known sects of Muslims who says: The word of God is a God that creates and provides.
But Muhammad and other messengers - peace be upon them - conveyed to creation the word of God that He had spoken.

The Companions and those who followed them believed that the Qur’an, the Torah, the Gospel, and other than that, the word of God, is the word of God who spoke. With it, and that God sent it down and sent His angels with it, He is not a created being, separated from Him by His creation in something else.

They say: This Qur’an is the word of God that was conveyed by His Messenger, and Muslims read it, and the reader hears the word of God, but They read it with their actions and voices, and they hear it from the reader who reads it in his own voice, for the speech is the speech of the Creator, and the voice The reader's voice.

And they say: God spoke it and spoke it to Moses, and that Moses heard God’s call with his ear, so God spoke to him in the voice that Moses heard, as This is made clear in the Books of God, the Qur’an, the Gospel, the Torah, and other things.

Then there arose after the Companions and the major followers of a disruptive group, saying: God did not speak to Moses directly, nor did He take Abraham as a friend, so he was killed. The Muslims were preceded by "Al-Ja'ad", and they had a predecessor called "Al-Jahm", so the Jahmiya was attributed to them, the negation of names and attributes.
Sometimes they say: God did not speak and He did not speak to Moses, but that is used metaphorically.

Sometimes they say: He spoke and he actually speaks, but what that means is that he created speech in someone else, and Moses heard it, not that he himself spoke it. This is the opinion of those who say it from the Mu’tazilites and their like.

This statement was beautified by some of the people of the emirate, so they called for it for a while and showed it, and they punished those who disagreed with them, then that was suppressed, and it was shown This is what the ancestors of the nation did, that the Qur’an, the Torah, and the Gospel are the words of God, and he himself spoke them. He appeared from Him, and there is nothing evident from Him, and He is not from a created being that He created in anything other than Him.

And when God revealed this, and the people recited the words of God Almighty: {And if any of the polytheists seek protection from you, reward him until he hears the word of God} [Al-Tawbah: 6] Some people of desires began to say: He only heard the voice of the reciter, and his voice is created, and it is the word of God, so the word of God is created.
This did not distinguish between hearing the words from the one speaking them, as Moses heard them from God without an intermediary, and hearing them from the one who reported them.

It is known that if the words of the prophets and other conveyors were heard, the voice of the conveyor would not be the voice of the one being conveyed, even if it was The words are the words of the person being reported, not the words of the informant.
If the word of God is heard from those who convey it, it is more likely that it will be the word of God and not the words of those who convey it, even if they convey it with their voices.
Then a second group came and said: This is what is heard, our words and our voices, and our words are not the words of God. Because this is a creature, and the word of God is not a creature.

The intention of these people was to realize that the word of God is not created, so they fell into denying that this Qur’an is the word of God, and they were not guided to That - even if it is the word of God, then it is the word of God conveyed by Him - it is not His word that was heard from Him, and it is not necessary - if the actions of the servants And their voices are created things and are not the word of God - that the words that they recite with their actions and voices be their words, and that A created being is not the word of God.

And those who said: This is not the word of God, among them were those who said: It is a narration of the word of God, and they dismissed that in everyone who conveyed the words of others. That what was conveyed to him should be a story based on the words of the person being conveyed, not his words.

Among the people of the story are those who say: The word of the Lord includes composed letters, either standing by themselves on what some of them say, or created in Other than it, according to some of them, and what is self-existent has one meaning.

Among these people are those who said: The story is similar to what is being told about, so we do not say: It is a story, but rather it is an expression of it, and the estimate according to them is So reward him until he hears the words of his phrase or his story.

Then a third group came and said: Rather, it has been proven that this what is heard is the word of God, and the word of God is not of a created being, and this what is heard is The sound, the sound is not created.

Then among them are those who say: It is ancient, and among them are those who say: It is not ancient, and among them are those who say: The voice of the Lord and the servant is heard, and among them are those He said: The voice of the Lord is only heard.
Then among them are those who say: It is old, and among them are those who say: He only hears it from the servant.
And these are among them who said: If the voice of the Lord descends upon His servants, then they imitated the Christians.
And among them are those who said: Rather, we say: It appeared without permission. And among them are those who say: Neither this nor that is never used.

All of these sayings are innovated and innovated. None of the Companions nor those who followed them in good faith said anything about them, nor did any imam say anything about them. The imams of the Muslims, such as Malik and Al-Thawri,
Al-Awza’i, Al-Layth bin Saad, Abu Hanifa, Abu Yusuf, and Muhammad,
Al-Shafi’i, Ahmad bin Hanbal, Ishaq bin Rahwayh, Ibn Uyaynah and others.

Rather, all of them agree that the Qur’an was revealed, not created, and that God sent Gabriel with it, so Gabriel revealed it to His Prophet Muhammad - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - so Muhammad conveyed it to the people, and the people recited it with their movements and voices, and nothing from the actions of the servants or their voices. Ancient and not uncreated, but the word of God is uncreated, and the predecessors did not say: The Qur’an is ancient.

And when the Jahmiyah and those who agreed with them from the Mu’tazila and others narrated that it is a creation that is evident from God, the predecessors and imams said: It is speech. God is not created.

None of the predecessors said that God spoke without His power and will, nor that it is a single meaning existing in essence, nor that He spoke By the Qur’an, the Torah, or the Gospel in eternity, with an ancient letter and sound. After that, a group arose and they said: It is ancient.
Then among them are those who say: The ancient is one meaning that exists in and of itself. It is the meaning of all the words of God.

That meaning, if expressed in Hebrew, is a Torah, and if expressed in Syriac, it is a Gospel, and if expressed In Arabic, it was the Qur’an, and the command, prohibition, and news are its attributes, not its types.
Among these are those who say: Rather, it is ancient, and it is letters, or eternal, ancient letters and sounds, and that they are the Torah and the Gospel. And the Qur’an.

So the people said to these people: You violated the law and reason in your statement: It is ancient, and you invented an innovation to which none of the companions preceded you. And the followers and the imams of the Muslims, and you fled from one forbidden to the forbidden, like one who seeks protection from ashes with fire.

Then your statement: It has one meaning - and it is the meaning of all expressions - an arrogance of reason and Sharia; For we know - by necessity - that the meaning of the Throne Verse is not the meaning of the Religion Verse, nor is the meaning of {Abu Lahab’s hands remained firm} [Al-Masad: 1] is The meaning of Surat Al-Ikhlas.
If we translated the Torah into Arabic, it would not be the Arabic Qur’an that Muhammad brought. Likewise, if we translated the Qur’an into Hebrew, it would not be It is the Torah of Moses.

And the statement of those of you who say: It is letters, or eternal letters and sounds, is apparent corruption, for the letters are successive, so some come before them. Some, and what is preceded by something else is not eternal and eternal, and the specific sound does not last for two periods of time, so how can it be ancient and eternal?

And the predecessors and imams, none of them said what you say, but they said: God spoke by the Qur’an and other revealed books, and God He called out to Moses in a voice that Moses heard with his own ear, as indicated by the texts.

And none of them said: That call that Moses heard was ancient and eternal, but they said: Indeed, God continues to speak when He wills and how He wills; Because speech is an attribute of perfection, not an attribute of deficiency, and it is only an attribute of perfection if he does it, not if it is a created being that is indistinguishable from it. The person described - except for what he did - is not characterized by what he clearly is, so the person described cannot be alive, knowing, capable, speaking, merciful, desiring a life that was fulfilled. By other than Him, nor by knowledge and ability that were created by other than Him, nor by words, mercy, or will that were created by other than Him.
Speech according to the will and ability of the speaker is more perfect than speech that is not according to his will and ability.
As for speech that is performed by the speaker himself, without his will and ability, it is either impossible or it is an attribute of deficiency, as something like this is called. In the epilepsy.

And if he is perfect, then the perpetuation of his perfection, and that he continues to be described with the attributes of perfection, is more perfect than the fact that he became a speaker after he did not Yes, if it is determined that this is possible, what if it is impossible?

The imams of the Sunnah and the community, whenever an innovation was introduced into the religion, they denied it and did not approve of it. For this reason, God preserved the religion of Islam, and it continues to exist. In the nation of Muhammad there is a guiding, Mahdi, and victorious sect.

Unlike the People of the Book, the Christians created heresies that contradicted Christ, and they oppressed those who disagreed with them who adhered to the law of Christ until When God sent Muhammad, no one remained who adhered to the religion of Christ, except a remnant of the People of the Book, as the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said in The authentic hadith: (“Indeed, God looked at the people of the earth and abhorred them, both Arabs and non-Arabs, except a remnant of the People of the Book.”)

When a group of the rulers demonstrated that the Qur’an was created, and called the people to that, God confirmed the imams of the Sunnah and the majority of the nation, so they did not They agree with them, and one of the imams referred to at that time was Ahmad ibn Hanbal.

Then this newly invented saying remained apparent for about fourteen years, and the imams of the nation and its masses denied it, until it came from The rulers prevented those from revealing it and speaking about it, so it became hidden like other innovations, and it became widespread among the common people and the elite that the Qur’an is speech God is not created.

Some people wanted to answer the suspicion of those who said: This is the one who takes care of us. He said: The Qur’an is the word of God, not created, but our words in it are created, and our recitation of it is created.

Perhaps they said: This whom we read is a created being, or this is not the word of God, so they meant a correct meaning, which is the existence of the attributes of the servants. Their voices and actions are created.

But they made a mistake when they made the statement, or they made the people understand that this Qur’an which the Muslims read is a created thing, and they were not guided to it. If we refer to the words of a speaker who has been reported from him, we say, for example, what was narrated on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - such as his saying: (“Actions are only With intentions, but each person will have only what he intended.” This is the speech of the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - or to say the poet: “Indeed, everything except God is false -: These are the words of Labid bin Rabi’ah, and the like.
We are referring to the speech itself, its meanings, its structure, and its letters, not to what is specific to the conveyor, such as its movement and sound. The person reported and his action.
The fact that a living person is mobile or vocal is a common feature between a speaker and a non-native person, and this is not an attribute of him.

The speech that distinguishes a speaker from a non-Arab is distinguished by the meanings that are attached to it, and by the pronunciation that matches it from the letters. The system is composed of fragmented sounds.
This is a matter that concerns the speaker of the speech, not the one who communicates it, so the one who communicates it has no choice but to perform that.
For this reason, if someone said to Labid’s poetry: Everything except God is false, and he said: This is my poetry or my words because he recited it with his voice, Because people lied to him.
And if he had said: This what I am saying is like Labid’s poetry, people would have disbelieved him and said: Rather, it is his poetry itself, but you recited it with your voice.

Unlike when someone said something in rhyme or prose, and another said something similar, people would say: This is like what so-and-so said, just as he said God Almighty: {Thus said those before them the like of their words} [Al-Baqarah: 118] And He said about the Qur’an: {Say, “If mankind and the jinn were gathered together, They produce the like of this Qur’an, but they will not produce the like of it.} [Al-Isra: 88] And for this reason, if a reader said: I bring a Qur’an like the Qur’an like the Qur’an of Muhammad, and he followed it. himself and said: This is like it. The people would have denied that and laughed at him and said: This is the Qur’an that he brought, it is not any other speech. Similar to it.

If the Qur’an that Muslims read is the word of God that was conveyed to the Messenger, it is not permissible to say: It is not the word of God, but rather it is A proverb of him, a story about him, or a phrase.

If it is known, it is the word of God, for God - Glory be to Him - spoke it. He did not create it apart from Him, and it is not permissible for it to be said for what These are His words: He is a created being.

So when it is said about what Muslims read: He is a created being, and the created being is separate from God, it is not His word, then He has been made a created being, and it is not Him. By the word of God, so the imams began to say: This is the word of God and this is not a creature. They do not refer by that to any of the attributes of the creature, but rather to The word of God which He spoke and which His Messenger conveyed to him.
The one who conveyed it only conveyed it through the attributes of himself, and the reference in such a context is intended to convey the speech, not what happened. Reporting.

By this, the second, may be meant with restriction, as in the example of a noun, when it is said: I worshiped God and called upon God, then what is meant is not that the one being worshiped is the one who is called. It is the name that is the word, but rather the object of worship that is called is the one named by the word, so some of them began to say: The name is the unnamed thing, until it was said To some of them: I say: I called upon God, and he said: Do not say like that, but say: I called upon God, and this mistaken person thought that if you said Therefore, what is meant is I called this word, and something like this is answered in the second word.

There is nothing that is expressed by a name, unless what is meant by the name is what is named, for names are not mentioned except to explain the names, not because the name Himself is the one named.
Whoever says: The word and the meaning that resides in the heart is the essence of what is called, his mistake is clear.
And whoever says: What is meant by the name is in the example of your saying: I called upon God and worshiped Him,
It is the same wording, so its error is clear, but the two sects are suspicious of what is meant by the name and the same wording.

Likewise, those are suspected of the very words of the speaker being reported, which is what is meant by the pronouncement of the speaker and his writing with the same voice. The informant and his ink.
The difference between this and that is clear to most rational people.

If a writer wrote the name of God on a piece of paper, and said the name of God in his speech, and someone said: I am a disbeliever in this and I believe in this, it would be understandable. His statement is that he is a believer or a disbeliever by what is meant by word and handwriting, not that he believes and disbelieves by voice or ink.
Likewise, he who says, when he hears it from the readers and what is written in the Qur’an, that this is the word of God.

Or he said, when he heard from all the conveyors the words of others, and when it was found in the books: These are the words of Zaid, so they do not mean that voice and ink. Rather, it is the meaning and wording that Zaid conveyed with his voice and written on parchment with ink.
If it is said about that: He is a created being, then it is said: It is not the word of God, and He did not speak it.

Whoever intends the same sound or ink and says: It is created, then he is correct, just as whoever intends the same sound or line and says: It is not This is the word of God. Rather, it is a created thing. It is correct, but His meaning must be made clear in unambiguous words.

For this reason, the imams, such as Ahmad ibn Hanbal and others, denounced anyone who said that the expression in the Qur’an was created, or not. He is a created being, and they say: Whoever says: He is a created being, is a Jahmite, and whoever says: He is not created, is an innovator, and whoever says: He is an innovator. A creature here, they may say: It is not the word of God, and this is contrary to what has been transmitted from the Messenger, and contrary to what is explicitly known about this. The reasonable one.

For people know - with their minds - that whoever conveys the words of another, the speech is the speech of the person conveying it, the one who said it, beginning, enjoining and informing about his matter. By His news, not the words of the one who said it, conveying it, conveying it.

For this reason, “the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - used to say at special occasions: (Is there not a man who will carry me to his people so that I may convey the words of my Lord? For the Quraysh have They prevented me from conveying the word of my Lord.” Narrated by Abu Dawud and others, on the authority of Jabir.
And when God Almighty revealed: {Have you not defeated the Romans in the nearest part of the earth? And they, after their defeat, will be defeated.} [Al-Rum: 1]
Some infidels said to Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq: Are these your words or the words of your friend? He said: It is not my words or the words of my friend, but it is the word of God.

For this reason, the denial of Ahmad ibn Hanbal and other imams of Islam became intense, and some people exaggerated their denial and said: We used the Qur’an to be uncreated, and they used expressions that implied and implied that any of the attributes of the servants were not created, so he denied That is Ahmad and others, just as Ibn al-Mubarak, Ishaq ibn Rahawayh, al-Bukhari, and other imams of the Sunnah denied it. They explained that paper, ink, the voices of the servants, and their actions are created things, and that the word of God, which the servants memorize and recite And they write it as uncreated.
There are many words of the imams of the Sunnah and the community on this subject, in agreement and not in disagreement, and all of them are correct.
But some of them may explain at certain times what others do not explain due to their need to do so.

So whoever is afflicted with someone who says: This is not the word of God, like Imam Ahmad, his words were to criticize the one who says: This is a created being, more than his condemnation. For those who say: verbally created.

And whoever is afflicted with someone who makes some of the attributes of people other than created beings, like Al-Bukhari, the author of Al-Sahih, his words were in condemnation of those who make that something other than More and more, with the text of Ahmad, Al-Bukhari and others, based on the error of the two sects.

chapters.title: A follow-up chapter on Ibn al-Batriq’s words and the response to him
paragraphs: [Chapter: A continuation of the penguin’s words and the response to them]

Sa`id ibn al-Batriq said: The incorporation of the creative word of God and its merging with the essence of humanity is not through transmission, change, or fraud on the part of One of the two essences is due to density, so neither the divine deceives himself from being a Creator God, nor does the forgetful deceive himself from being a created being.

Fraud and change only require the mixture if it is made of two thick, heavy substances, such as water and wine, or water and honey. Or ghee, honey, gold, paper, copper, lead, and the like; Because it is all heavy and thick, and every weight that is mixed with heaviness - inevitably - needs to change until it becomes what the weights were, so it is not Wine is wine, and water is not water after they are mixed, but they have all been separated from their essence, and have turned into a variable matter that is not one of them. In particular, neither of them is free from corruption and fraud in his or her situation.
But if the mixture is of a gentle character and a harsh character, then no change or deception is mixed with that mixture, such as the mixture of the soul. And the body is one human,

One of them is joined to the other without the soul being changed or deceived; That is, it has become impossible from its essence to be a soul known by its actions, nor has the body changed nor been deceived from its state and actions, and such It was a mixture of fire and iron, and they all joined together to form one ember, without the fire having changed to become heavy iron. It splits and cuts, and the iron has not changed and become a fire that burns, so does every mixture composed of two things. They differ, one is spiritual and gentle, and the other is heavy and heavy, like the soul, the body, fire, and iron, and like the mixed sun. For water, clay, and all moisture and sludge, they do not change and do not deviate from their light, purity, and ablution, even though they are mixed with all blackness. Dirty, fetid and unclean.

He said: The mixture has three aspects: One of them: a mixture of the two heavy natures and their deception and corruption, such as A mixture of wine and water, vinegar and honey, gold, paper, lead, and copper. All of that, and anything similar to it, is fraud. And corruption; Because the mixture of wine and water is neither wine nor water; Because each one of them deviates from their nature and is mixed with their corruption and change from their condition.

Likewise, the mixture of vinegar and honey has become neither vinegar nor honey. Because of the fraud of each one of them, and the mixture of gold and paper in this way turned out to be incorrect, neither of the gold nor of the paper. The mixture of paper and copper is incorrect. It is neither paper nor copper. This is one of the three aspects.
And the second aspect:

A mixture of separation of the two heavy natures, and it may be known from that mixture that each of the two natures is stable in the other by its texture. Her face is like oil and water in one lamp, and like flax and silk in one garment woven with linen ribbed with silk, and like A brass idol with a head of gold, and the like, which should not be called a mixture with the two natures and textures being separate, such as There should be a mixture between the water and the mixture in which it is; Because the nature of the few is clay, its strength is the few, and there is no mixture between them and water, but rather the greatest difference.
The same applies to water and oil. Had it not been for the container of the lamp in which they were contained, they would not have come together.

Likewise linen and silk, there is no mixture between them, even if they are in the same garment, nor between gold and copper and they were not alloyed by mixture, even if It was brought together by one idol.
These two mixtures never exist except in heavy physical burdens.

If they are joined to each other, just as gold and copper are melted and emptied together, they will face the mixture of fraud and corruption. Because that click is not made of pure gold, nor of pure copper.
If they are not welded and bound together, like a ring made of brass and gold, then they will fall apart in the sense of the mixture, which is not right. It can be called a mixture.

In these two aspects, Nestorius and his followers committed a mixture of fraud and corruption. They claimed that the divine nature and the Humanity mixed in one Christ, for he is of one substance with one nature mixed from two different divine natures. Forgetting, they admitted that they had committed fraud, and fraud is corruption.
And they imposed calamities and death on this infidel view of the nature of God, and they made Christ neither a true God nor a man, like gold. And copper.

Nestorius and his followers adhered to the mixture of division and disconnection. They claimed that the one Christ had two different natures, the divine one. And forgetful, and with two known textures, divine and forgetful, so they became the group a mixture, like a colored necklace with two halves, one of which is gold and the other. It is made of copper, and the lined garment is made of wicker on the outside and cotton on the inside. There is no mixing between them in nature or texture.
And they do not have the right to believe in one Messiah; Because a colored collar is two collars, and a lined garment is two garments.
Christ - for example - is two Christs, one and divine in his nature and stature, like the gold bar in the colored band, and like the brightness of The prick in the lined garment.
Others are forgotten, such as the copper rod in a collar, and the cotton lining in a garment.
It is astonishing, how did the people of disagreement and discord not separate between both types?

They did not understand that these two creations were created with heavy physical burdens, and that there was nothing of the gentle spiritual creation in them. Light, and therefore heavy weights are not able to emerge from these two aspects of the mixture; Because if they are mixed together, they will become deceit and corruption, and if they remain as they are, they will not join and will not mix. One with another, then they are in the sense of a mixture of separation, and separated from one another, even if they are united by one idol or one garment, For none of the corporeal burdens ever has any aspect of mixing other than these two aspects, either corruption or cessation, unless it is The mixture of two, one of which is heavy physically, and the other is gentle spiritually, is what it is.
The third aspect of the mixture:

It is a mixture of solutions without confusion, fraud, corruption, division, or interruption, but it is the penetration of the spiritual nature into the heavy nature. The lower level, until it spreads throughout all of them and pervades all of them, so that no place of the lower heavy nature remains devoid of the spiritual nature, nor Deviation from the heavy physical nature from its heavy and heavy nature, and there is no change or corruption of either of them, such as a mixture of the soul. And the body, and like the mixture of fire and iron in the consistency of one ember, it is a single ember with the consistency of the nature of fused fire. Mixing with the iron nature without any interruption, without any mixture of fraud and corruption,

The fire spread throughout the entire piece of iron, covering it, and the fire affected the iron of its strength and strength until it illuminated the iron. It was burned, and the fire did not acquire any blackness or coolness due to the weakness of the iron.
In this way, the creative word of God arranged its mixture for human nature.

For he is one Christ, the only-begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all ages, Light from Light, true God of true God, begotten He is not a creature created from his father’s mites, essence, and nature, and he himself is from the Virgin Mary, born of her at the end of time with one substance. The existence of the only-begotten Son of God who combines both natures, the divine one that did not cease to exist in the beginning before every beginning, and the human nature that was created At the end of time, which is determined by the eternal existence.

He is one Messiah with one eternal being, with two divine natures that have not ceased, and a forgetful nature created for him and joined to him by the Virgin Mary. His consistency is that of the divine nature and the human nature, uniting them without mixing, corruption, or separation. The divine nature, then He is the sustenance of the human nature. He created it, formed it, and established it with His sustenance, which has not continued to exist except through Him, and is not known. Except for him.
The answer to this statement - after it has been said: It is a contradiction.

Sometimes he made this a mixture, and at other times he said: It is not a mixture - to say: He - firstly - may make this dissolve and merge. Mixing, and he says: There is no transformation or change in it, and he says: Transformation and change only necessitate the mixture, if it is of Two thick mixtures, like water and wine, but if they are of a thin and dense mixture, no change or fraud is mixed with that mixture - that is, Impossibility - and he says: The mixture is in three ways: Then he says: One of them is like wine and water, and the second is like oil and water, And linen and silk, then he says:
Something similar to that should be called a mixture with the separation of the two natures, so he makes it one of the parts of the mixture, then he says: It should not To be called a mixture.

What is meant is not verbal disputes, rather he says: His claim is that one of the two types of mixing is due to change and impossibility, unlike the type The other, which is the mixing of gentle and heavy - is a forbidden claim, and he did not provide evidence for it. Rather, he says: It is false. Rather, mixing between Two things, except with change and impossibility.

The examples and evidence he mentioned are proof against him. Because he said: (But if the mixture is of a gentle character and a harsh character, then no change or fraud is mixed with that mixture, such as The mixture of the soul and body as one human being, one joined to the other without the soul having changed or being separated from its essence. It is a soul that is known by its activity, and the body has not changed or departed from its state and activity.

It is said: This is a false statement that is apparent to everyone who imagines it, for if the body is devoid of the soul, then it would be like it is before the blowing of The spirit is in him, and he is not after the spirit departs from him at death, but rather Adam - peace be upon him - the father of mankind, was created from dust and water, and became clay. Like pottery, then the spirit was breathed into it, and it became a body that is flesh, bone, sinew, and blood.

Would a rational person say: Adam’s body before and after the soul was of the same quality and did not change or become lawful, and his descendants after him were created? Is one of them from a sperm, then a clot, then an embryo, and it becomes a dead body, then the spirit is breathed into it and the body becomes alive after it was dead?
What change is greater than the transition of the body from death to life?

The difference between the living and the dead is known by sense and reason, as God Almighty said: {And neither the living nor the dead are equal} [Fatir: 22] and the body. If the spirit is not breathed into him, then he is dead. He has no sense, no voluntary movement, no hearing, no seeing, no speech, no reason, and no deliberation. He does not eat, drink, have sexual intercourse, think, love, hate, desire, or get angry.

If the soul comes into contact with it, its conditions change and its attributes become transformed, and it becomes sensitive and moved by the will, then how can such a mixture be said? The soul and body are one human being, one merging with the other without the soul having changed and being separated from its essence, to be. A soul is known by its actions, and has the body not changed or transformed from its state and actions?
Would a rational person who imagines what he says say: The body’s state and effect were the same when the soul separated from it, just as its state and effect were when it was mixed with it?

Would a rational person say: After the body dies and the soul departs from it, its condition and its effects are the same as its state and its effects if the soul were mixed? By it, when he dies, he is like an inanimate object, neither hearing nor seeing, nor speaking, nor walking, nor walking. His blood has congealed and turned black, and it is no longer fluid. The change in appearance and color, and the change of the body with life after death, and with death after life - are among the greatest changes. And the impossibilities?
The same applies to the soul, for the soul - when it is connected to the body - takes pleasure in its pleasure, and suffers from its pain.

So, when the body eats and drinks, has sex, and curses, the soul takes pleasure, and when the body is beaten and slapped, and insulted, and thorns are placed on its head, and it spits on In his face, the soul was hurt by that.

So, when they likened the union of the Lord and Christ to the union of the soul and the body, and they say: When Christ and every person is beaten, slapped, and crucified, So his body suffered, his soul also suffered.

If the suffering is with the soul and body of Christ, just as the soul is with the body, then the Lord must suffer with the suffering of humanity, and hunger with His hunger. He is satisfied when he is satisfied, for the pain of hunger and the pleasure of being full occur to the soul when the body is hungry and full.
Also, for them, Christ is a perfect God and a perfect human being, and God is a God before the union, and the human being is a human being before the union.
They say: After their union, they are a perfect God as they were, and a perfect human being as they were.

An analogy to this is that a human being composed of a body and a soul is a complete soul and a complete body, and that the hot iron is a complete iron. And complete fire, which is false. Rather, man is a compound of a soul and a body, and man is a name for a plural. Man is not a spirit and man is a body.
If the union were true, it would have to be said: Christ is half divinity, half humanity, and he is a compound of this and that.

It should not be said: Christ Himself is a perfect man, and Christ Himself is a perfect God, for conceptualizing this statement in a complete manner necessitates knowledge. Necessary, since they made Christ, who is the beginning, the subject of the story and the one being judged, a perfect man and a perfect God, necessitating that The soul of man is the soul of God.

If this were said about two creatures, and it was said: The soul of the angel is the soul of mankind, then it would be apparent falsehood. So what if it was said about the Lord of the worlds? Especially since many Christians do not say that the body of Christ is created, but rather they describe everything as divine, and this is the meaning of saying Their imams said: Christ is a perfect God, but they contradicted themselves and said - nevertheless -: He is a perfect human being, as if they said:

He is the Creator. He is not the Creator. He is a created being. He is not a created being. So they combined the two opposites, and this is the truth of what the Christians say, especially The union of the Godhead with the humanity of Christ - according to them - is a necessary union that has never departed from it, so this is more eloquent than the accidental union, and that The Lord was united with a body that had no spirit in it, then with the body with the spirit breathed into it, then with the body after the spirit left it, and where He was buried in the grave. And dirt was placed on it.
It is known that if a soul is in a person and is placed in the dust with him, the soul suffers severe pain, then it leaves the body.

Among the wonders is that they say: Christ was crucified and died, so the rational soul departed from him, and the body became without a soul, and the divinity - along with this - He was united and did not leave him while he was in the grave, and the divinity was united with him, so they make his union with him more eloquent than the union of the soul with the body.

The soul - when it is connected to the body - changes and its attributes and conditions are changed, and it takes on attributes and actions that it did not have. Without the body, and when they leave the body, their characteristics and actions change.

If their representation was identical, then it would be necessary for the Lord’s attributes and actions to have changed when He mingled with Christ, just as the attributes of The soul and its actions, and before this mixing, the Lord is like an abstract soul that is not connected to a body.

Also, the soul and the body are partners in good and bad deeds. They are rewarded and punished, and the reward and punishment are for the soul. More perfect than he is in the body. If the Lord is like that, then everything that Christ does by his choice was done by the Lord, just as everything that he does The body chooses the action of the soul over the one that is addressed with commands and prohibitions, so it is said to it: Eat, drink, and marry, and do not eat, drink, or Have sex.

If the Lord is with humanity in this way, then the Lord is the one who commands and forbids what Christ commands, and the Lord is the one who prays, fasts, worshipper, and invites, Their saying: He creates and provides for His divinity, and eats and worships according to His humanity, is false.

When the soul and the body were united, all voluntary actions were for the soul and the body. So if a person prays, fasts, and supplicates, the soul The body is described in this way, but the soul is more specific in this way. Likewise, when He commands or forbids, they are both described in this way. Likewise, if He was beaten, and the pain of the beating reached them just as the pleasure of eating and intercourse reached them.

Rather, what is more eloquent than that is that if a jinn enters the human voice and strikes it and speaks on its tongue, the human voice changes, until the sound remains. The words that are heard from him are not his known voice and words.
