{And they said: The Most Gracious has taken a son - You have indeed come to something terrible - the heavens are almost torn apart by him, the earth is splitting open, and the mountains are falling down - that They prayed for a son for the Most Merciful - and it is not befitting for the Most Merciful to take a son - for everyone in the heavens and the earth does not come to the Most Merciful as a servant - indeed He counted them and numbered them - and they will all come to Him individually on the Day of Resurrection} [Maryam: 88-95].

And in the two Sahihs, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - he said: “God Almighty says: The son of Adam has lied to me. And he did not have that, and the son of Adam cursed me, but he did not have that. As for his cursing of me, he said: God has taken a son, and I am the only one who is steadfast. I did not give birth, nor was I born, and there is no one equal to me. As for his denial of me, he said: He will not return me to the way He created me, and the first of creation is not the most unworthy. I have to return it.”

It was narrated by Al-Bukhari on the authority of Ibn Abbas, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - who said: “God Almighty said: The son of Adam denied me and he had no That, and he insulted me, but he did not have that, so as for his denial of me, he claimed that I am not able to return it to the way it was, and as for his insulting me, So His saying: I have a son, so Glory be to Me that I take a companion or a son.

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Musa, he said: The Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: (No one is patient in the face of harm he heard from God - the Almighty - the He will be associated with Him and He will be made a rival to Him, and He will heal them, provide for them, and protect them from them.”)

The twelfth aspect: That everyone who believes in anthropomorphism what he believes can say as the Christians say, for the Christians intended to do what It is a body of the same type as the rest of the bodies of the children of Adam. They said: He is a complete God and a complete human being, and there is nothing divine in Him, so what remains with this He refrains from believing in his peers what is believed in him.

If someone had said: Moses bin Imran was God, this would not be further from what the Christians say, for Moses’ miracles were greater. His victory over his enemy was evident, and God named him in the Torah as a god for Aaron and Pharaoh.

If it is said about him what they said about Christ: that he demonstrated the miracle through his divinity, and demonstrated slavery through his humanity, then this would not be invalid. It is clearer than the falsehood of the Christians’ statement. Rather, when they allowed the union of theology with humanity, they could not deny that from anyone of whom it is claimed except With specific evidence, and if they were told that it was permissible in many of the prophets and saints, they could not deny that.
And if they say: No one was informed of this, nor was any prophet given good tidings of it, or this is unknown.

It was said to them: The point of all this is that you do not know that, and you have no evidence for it, and lack of knowledge is not knowledge of nothingness. Your knowledge and someone else’s lack of knowledge about something is not knowledge of the non-existence of that thing.

Suppose that this is what we are permitted to say in language, but it is not permissible for us to speak a language other than the language of the prophets, and carry the words The prophets, for this is a lie to them.

Rather, all nations call the one who did the attributes. As for the rational investigation in this matter, we have explained it elsewhere, and explained that what these philosophers call a synthesis, Such as their saying: A thing is composed of existence and essence, and their saying: Species are composed of genera and classes, is false according to all The mass of rational people.

There is nothing outside except an essence that is characterized by attributes. There is not the existence of the One who exists outside Himself, nor any essence other than this existing, existing thing. By himself, for example.

However, the term “essentiality” may mean what is imagined in minds, and by existence what exists in objects, and in that case this essence is different from this. The existing, and then it is said: This essence is other than this existence.
Likewise, they say: The person who exists outside is a combination of gender and class, for the person who exists is a distinct self. With the attributes of Himself and other existent things.

But one can imagine in the mind something that is a combination of an animal and a speaker, just as one can imagine something that is a combination of an animal and a laugher, and this is a combination. Mentally, there is no external composition, and this has been expanded in other than this place.

It became clear that what they made of the attributes is part of essence, and what they made outside of it is necessary for it, and what is the sum of the parts of essence, When investigated, it returns to what is signified by inclusion, commitment, and correspondence.
This includes the composition of the body from individual substances, or from matter and form.
Most rational people deny that the body is composed of this and that, as has been explained in another place.

What is meant here is that the words of the prophets are not permissible to be interpreted except in their language in which they are accustomed to address people. It is not permissible to That a language other than theirs is spoken, and their speech is interpreted based on it.

Rather, if some people have a habit and a language in which they address their friends, and it is determined that this is permissible for them, then it is not for them to carry that language. The Prophet, and the Prophet’s words are based on that.
And from this is the telling of the prophets that God says and speaks and calls and converses, and that He said such-and-such and spoke such-and-such, and called to Moses and the like. That.

What is known in their language and the language of other nations is that the speaker is the one to whom the words are spoken, even if he is speaking by his ability and will, it is not known In their language, the speaker is the one who speaks a speech separately from it, and the speaker is the one who speaks to it without his ability and will.

No one - if he makes the name of the speaker of the one who utters a speech identifiable from him, or the one who did it without his ability and will - has no right to carry the words. The prophets are on this.
Rather, the speaker - in general - is the one who spoke by his ability and will, with the words being carried out by him.
This is what is known in the language of the prophets and other nations at the beginning, and there are many parallels to this.
Whoever interprets the words of the prophets in a language other than their known language, then they are among those who changed and distorted their words, and the Christians are among them.

Likewise, the name of the just and the unjust and the like, for what is known from the words of the prophets and others is that the just is the one who upholds justice and does justice. Justice is by His will and power.

And the oppressor is the one to whom injustice was done, and he did it with his ability and will. They do not call the one who did not commit injustice to him, but did it with someone else, because he has He made that the one who did it for him, and they do not call the one who did not do the wrong - but someone else did - an unjust.

So who makes the unjust, the infidel, and the immoral person the one who did not do any of that but someone else did it, or the unjust the one who did not commit any injustice? He did it, but he made someone else do it unjustly - so he departed from what was known from the words of the prophets and others.

What is more eloquent than that is that in the language of all nations, the newly created and the created are only called what was after it did not exist, and the created being. What is meant here is that knowing the language in which the prophets addressed us and carrying their words according to it is a certain obligation, and whoever follows other than This behavior has distorted their words from their intended meanings, lied to them and slandered them.

Eternity.
